44BatchPotential ownedEvaluation(const BatchPotential &fallback,
45 const RateInstantonOptions &options,
46 long scratch, long beadCount = 0) {
47 if (!options.ownedPotential)
48 return fallback;
49 return [owned = options.ownedPotential, scratch,
50 beadCount](const std::vector<VectorXd> &q, std::vector<double> &v,
51 std::vector<VectorXd> &g) {
52 std::vector<long> owners(q.size(), scratch);
53 if (beadCount > 0)
54 for (size_t j = 0; j < q.size(); ++j)
55 owners[j] = static_cast<long>(j % static_cast<size_t>(beadCount));
56 owned(q, v, g, owners);
57 };
58}

61double massWeightedDistance(const Matter &a, const Matter &b) {
62 if (a.numberOfAtoms() != b.numberOfAtoms()) {
63 throw std::invalid_argument("the structures hold different atom counts");
64 }
65 const AtomMatrix dr = a.pbc(b.getPositions() - a.getPositions());
66 const auto mass = a.getMasses();
67 double sum = 0.0;
68 for (long i = 0; i < a.numberOfAtoms(); ++i) {
69 if (mass(i) <= 0.0) {
70 throw std::invalid_argument(
71 "every atom needs a positive mass for a mass-weighted path");
72 }
73 sum += mass(i) * dr.row(i).squaredNorm();
74 }
75 return std::sqrt(sum);
76}
77
78std::vector<double>
79massWeightedPath(const std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Matter>> &band) {
80 std::vector<double> s{0.0};
81 s.reserve(band.size());
82 for (size_t i = 1; i < band.size(); ++i) {
83 s.push_back(s.back() + massWeightedDistance(*band[i - 1], *band[i]));
84 }
85 return s;
86}

88Profile::Profile(std::vector<double> s, std::vector<double> v)
89 : s_(std::move(s)),
90 v_(std::move(v)),
91 m_(s_.size(), 0.0) {
92 const size_t n = s_.size();
93 if (n < 2 || v_.size() != n) {
94 throw std::invalid_argument(
95 "a profile needs matching s and V with two points or more");
96 }
97 for (size_t k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
98 if (!(s_[k] > s_[k - 1])) {
99 throw std::invalid_argument(
100 "the path coordinate must increase along the band");
101 }
102 }
103 for (size_t k = 1; k + 1 < n; ++k) {
104 const double h0 = s_[k] - s_[k - 1];
105 const double h1 = s_[k + 1] - s_[k];
106 const double d0 = (v_[k] - v_[k - 1]) / h0;
107 const double d1 = (v_[k + 1] - v_[k]) / h1;
108 if (d0 * d1 <= 0.0) {
109 m_[k] = 0.0;
110 } else {
111 const double w1 = 2.0 * h1 + h0;
112 const double w2 = h1 + 2.0 * h0;
113 m_[k] = (w1 + w2) / (w1 / d0 + w2 / d1);
114 }
115 }
116}
117
118double Profile::operator()(double x) const {
119 x = std::clamp(x, s_.front(), s_.back());
120 auto it = std::upper_bound(s_.begin(), s_.end(), x);
121 size_t k = static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(s_.begin(), it));
122 k = std::clamp<size_t>(k == 0 ? 0 : k - 1, 0, s_.size() - 2);
123 const double h = s_[k + 1] - s_[k];
124 const double t = (x - s_[k]) / h;
125 const double t2 = t * t;
126 const double t3 = t2 * t;
127 return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * v_[k] + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * h * m_[k] +
128 (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * v_[k + 1] + (t3 - t2) * h * m_[k + 1];
129}

131double wellCurvature(const Profile &p, bool leftEnd) {
132 return 2.0 * wellFit(p, leftEnd)[0];
133}
134
135std::array<double, 2> wellFit(const Profile &p, bool leftEnd) {
136 const auto &s = p.s();
137 const auto &v = p.v();
138 const size_t n = s.size();
139 const double top = *std::max_element(v.begin(), v.end());
140 const double floor = leftEnd ? v.front() : v.back();
141 const double half = 0.5 * (top - floor);
142 // Sums for the normal equations of y = a x^2 + b x^3.
143 double s44 = 0, s45 = 0, s55 = 0, sy2 = 0, sy3 = 0;
144 size_t used = 0;
145 for (size_t j = 1; j < n; ++j) {
146 const size_t i = leftEnd ? j : n - 1 - j;
147 const double x = leftEnd ? s[i] - s.front() : s.back() - s[i];
148 const double y = v[i] - floor;
149 if (y > half) {
150 break;
151 }
152 const double x2 = x * x;
153 s44 += x2 * x2;
154 s45 += x2 * x2 * x;
155 s55 += x2 * x2 * x2;
156 sy2 += y * x2;
157 sy3 += y * x2 * x;
158 ++used;
159 }
160 if (used == 0) {
161 // The next image already stands above half the barrier: the parabola
162 // through it is all the band says about this well.
163 const size_t i = leftEnd ? 1 : n - 2;
164 const double x = leftEnd ? s[i] - s.front() : s.back() - s[i];
165 return {(v[i] - floor) / (x * x), 0.0};
166 }
167 if (used == 1) {
168 return {sy2 / s44, 0.0};
169 }
170 const double det = s44 * s55 - s45 * s45;
171 return {(sy2 * s55 - sy3 * s45) / det, (sy3 * s44 - sy2 * s45) / det};
172}
173
174double hbarOmega(double curvature) {
175 if (!(curvature > 0.0)) {
176 throw std::invalid_argument("a well needs a positive curvature");
177 }
178 return kHbar * std::sqrt(curvature);
179}
180
181double wkbAction(const Profile &p, double energy, int points) {
182 const double a = p.s().front();
183 const double b = p.s().back();
184 const double h = (b - a) / (points - 1);
185 double sum = 0.0;
186 for (int i = 0; i < points; ++i) {
187 const double gap = p(a + i * h) - energy;
188 const double f = gap > 0.0 ? std::sqrt(2.0 * gap) : 0.0;
189 sum += (i == 0 || i == points - 1) ? 0.5 * f : f;
190 }
191 return sum * h / kHbar;
192}

194double Splitting::asymmetry() const {
195 return delta + 0.5 * (hwProduct - hwReactant);
196}
197
198double Splitting::tlsEnergy() const { return std::hypot(asymmetry(), delta0); }
199
200Splitting wkbSplitting(const Profile &p, double hwReactant, double hwProduct) {
201 const auto &v = p.v();
202 Splitting out;
203 const double top = *std::max_element(v.begin(), v.end());
204 out.delta = v.back() - v.front();
205 out.barrier = top - v.front();
206 out.hwReactant = hwReactant;
207 out.hwProduct = hwProduct;
208 out.referenceEnergy =
209 std::max(v.front() + 0.5 * hwReactant, v.back() + 0.5 * hwProduct);
210 out.action = wkbAction(p, out.referenceEnergy);
211 const double hw = std::sqrt(hwReactant * hwProduct);
212 out.delta0 = hw / std::numbers::pi * std::exp(-out.action);
213 out.deepWells =
214 (top - v.front()) > hwReactant && (top - v.back()) > hwProduct;
215 return out;
216}

220std::vector<double> arcLengths(const std::vector<VectorXd> &path) {
221 std::vector<double> s(path.size(), 0.0);
222 for (size_t k = 1; k < path.size(); ++k) {
223 s[k] = s[k - 1] + (path[k] - path[k - 1]).norm();
224 }
225 return s;
226}
227
228VectorXd atArcLength(const std::vector<VectorXd> &path,
229 const std::vector<double> &s, double target) {
230 const auto it = std::upper_bound(s.begin(), s.end(), target);
231 const size_t k = std::clamp<size_t>(
232 static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(s.begin(), it)), 1, path.size() - 1);
233 const double seg = s[k] - s[k - 1];
234 const double t = seg > 0.0 ? (target - s[k - 1]) / seg : 0.0;
235 return path[k - 1] + std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0) * (path[k] - path[k - 1]);
236}
237
238// Crossings V(s) = e nearest the barrier top, one on each side.
239std::pair<double, double> turningPoints(const Profile &p, double sTop,
240 double energy) {
241 const double s0 = p.s().front();
242 const double s1 = p.s().back();
243 auto cross = [&](double from, double to) {
244 const int steps = 2000;
245 double a = from;
246 double b = to;
247 for (int k = 1; k <= steps; ++k) {
248 const double sk = from + (to - from) * static_cast<double>(k) / steps;
249 if (p(sk) <= energy) {
250 a = from + (to - from) * static_cast<double>(k - 1) / steps;
251 b = sk;
252 break;
253 }
254 if (k == steps) {
255 return to;
256 }
257 }
258 for (int k = 0; k < 60; ++k) {
259 const double m = 0.5 * (a + b);
260 if (p(m) > energy) {
261 a = m;
262 } else {
263 b = m;
264 }
265 }
266 return 0.5 * (a + b);
267 };
268 return {cross(sTop, s0), cross(sTop, s1)};
269}
270
271// int_{s-}^{s+} ds / sqrt(2 (V - E)). The cosine substitution keeps the
272// integrand finite at the turning points. Optional tables are the running
273// integral and the arc length at the end of each panel.
274double halfPeriod(const Profile &p, double sMinus, double sPlus, double energy,
275 std::vector<double> *cumulative = nullptr,
276 std::vector<double> *positions = nullptr) {
277 const int panels = 4000;
278 const double mid = 0.5 * (sMinus + sPlus);
279 const double half = 0.5 * (sPlus - sMinus);
280 double total = 0.0;
281 if (cumulative != nullptr) {
282 cumulative->assign(1, 0.0);
283 positions->assign(1, sMinus);
284 }
285 for (int k = 0; k < panels; ++k) {
286 const double phi =
287 std::numbers::pi * (static_cast<double>(k) + 0.5) / panels;
288 const double s = mid - half * std::cos(phi);
289 const double under = 2.0 * (p(s) - energy);
290 const double integrand =
291 half * std::sin(phi) / std::sqrt(std::max(under, 1e-300));
292 total += integrand * std::numbers::pi / panels;
293 if (cumulative != nullptr) {
294 cumulative->push_back(total);
295 positions->push_back(
296 mid - half * std::cos(std::numbers::pi * (k + 1.0) / panels));
297 }
298 }
299 return total;
300}

304std::vector<VectorXd> ringFromPath(const std::vector<VectorXd> &path,
305 const std::vector<double> &energies,
306 double betaHbar, long beads,
307 RingSeed *seed) {
308 if (path.size() < 3 || path.size() != energies.size() || beads < 4 ||
309 !(betaHbar > 0.0)) {
310 throw std::invalid_argument(
311 "ringFromPath: a path of at least three points with energies, "
312 "N >= 4 and beta hbar > 0");
313 }
314 const long width = path.front().size();
315 for (const auto &q : path) {
316 if (q.size() != width) {
317 throw std::invalid_argument("ringFromPath: the path changes dimension");
318 }
319 }
320 const std::vector<double> s = arcLengths(path);
321 const Profile profile(s, energies);
322 double sTop = s.front();
323 double vTop = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
324 const int grid = 4000;
325 for (int k = 0; k <= grid; ++k) {
326 const double sk =
327 s.front() + (s.back() - s.front()) * static_cast<double>(k) / grid;
328 if (profile(sk) > vTop) {
329 vTop = profile(sk);
330 sTop = sk;
331 }
332 }
333 const double vLow = std::max(energies.front(), energies.back());
334 if (!(vTop > vLow)) {
335 throw std::invalid_argument("ringFromPath: the path has no barrier");
336 }
337 auto period = [&](double energy) {
338 const auto [sMinus, sPlus] = turningPoints(profile, sTop, energy);
339 return 2.0 * halfPeriod(profile, sMinus, sPlus, energy);
340 };
341 // The crossover along the path from a parabola through the three input
342 // points around the barrier top, not from the interpolant, whose slope is
343 // clamped to zero at the top node.
344 {
345 size_t top = 0;
346 for (size_t k = 1; k < energies.size(); ++k) {
347 if (energies[k] > energies[top]) {
348 top = k;
349 }
350 }
351 if (top == 0 || top + 1 == energies.size()) {
352 throw std::invalid_argument(
353 "ringFromPath: the barrier top is an end of the path");
354 }
355 const double h1 = s[top] - s[top - 1], h2 = s[top + 1] - s[top];
356 const double curvature =
357 2.0 *
358 (h1 * energies[top + 1] - (h1 + h2) * energies[top] +
359 h2 * energies[top - 1]) /
360 (h1 * h2 * (h1 + h2));
361 if (!(curvature < 0.0)) {
362 throw std::invalid_argument("ringFromPath: no curvature at the top");
363 }
364 const double tc = kHbar * std::sqrt(-curvature) / (2.0 * std::numbers::pi);
365 if (!(kHbar / betaHbar < tc)) {
366 throw std::invalid_argument(
367 "ringFromPath: the temperature is at or above the crossover along "
368 "this path");
369 }
370 }
371 // Orbit energies on a geometric grid above the lower end: the period
372 // grows only logarithmically as E approaches a well bottom. The period
373 // need not fall monotonically with E: a shoulder on the path, where V'
374 // nearly vanishes away from a well, makes it spike, and a bisection over
375 // the whole range then converges onto the spike for every beta hbar it
376 // spans. Every crossing of beta hbar on the grid is refined, and the
377 // one kept minimises theta(E) + beta E, theta = 2 x the WKB action: it
378 // dominates the steepest-descent integral the instanton evaluates.
379 const double span = vTop - vLow;
380 const double eBottom = vLow + 1e-14 * span;
381 // Geometric in the distance from the top over the upper half, where a
382 // flat-topped barrier keeps the crossing within a small fraction of the
383 // span, and geometric in the height above the lower end over the lower
384 // half, where the period diverges only logarithmically.
385 constexpr int kHalf = 200;
386 constexpr int kScan = 2 * kHalf + 1;
387 std::vector<double> levels(kScan + 1);
388 std::vector<double> gap(kScan + 1);
389 for (int k = 0; k <= kHalf; ++k) {
390 const double u = static_cast<double>(k) / kHalf;
391 levels[static_cast<size_t>(k)] =
392 vTop - span * std::pow(10.0, -9.0 + u * (9.0 + std::log10(0.5)));
393 levels[static_cast<size_t>(kScan - k)] =
394 vLow + span * std::pow(10.0, -14.0 + u * (14.0 + std::log10(0.5)));
395 }
396 for (int k = 0; k <= kScan; ++k) {
397 gap[static_cast<size_t>(k)] =
398 period(levels[static_cast<size_t>(k)]) - betaHbar;
399 }
400 const double beta = betaHbar / kHbar;
401 double energy = eBottom;
402 double best = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
403 for (int k = 0; k < kScan; ++k) {
404 double a = levels[static_cast<size_t>(k)];
405 double b = levels[static_cast<size_t>(k + 1)];
406 double ga = gap[static_cast<size_t>(k)];
407 if ((ga > 0.0) == (gap[static_cast<size_t>(k + 1)] > 0.0)) {
408 continue;
409 }
410 for (int it = 0; it < 200 && std::abs(a - b) > 1e-15 * span; ++it) {
411 const double m = vLow + std::sqrt((a - vLow) * (b - vLow));
412 const double gm = period(m) - betaHbar;
413 if ((gm > 0.0) == (ga > 0.0)) {
414 a = m;
415 ga = gm;
416 } else {
417 b = m;
418 }
419 }
420 const double root = 0.5 * (a + b);
421 // A bracket around a jump of the turning point refines onto the jump,
422 // where the period is not beta hbar.
423 if (!(std::abs(period(root) - betaHbar) <= 1e-6 * betaHbar)) {
424 continue;
425 }
426 const double w = 2.0 * wkbAction(profile, root) + beta * root;
427 if (w < best) {
428 best = w;
429 energy = root;
430 }
431 }
432 // With no crossing the path does not reach a long enough orbit; the
433 // lowest one it holds is the start.
434 if (seed != nullptr) {
435 seed->energy = energy;
436 seed->period = period(energy);
437 seed->pathLow = vLow;
438 seed->reached = std::abs(seed->period - betaHbar) <= 1e-6 * betaHbar;
439 }
440 const auto [sMinus, sPlus] = turningPoints(profile, sTop, energy);
441 std::vector<double> tau;
442 std::vector<double> pos;
443 const double half = halfPeriod(profile, sMinus, sPlus, energy, &tau, &pos);
444 if (tau.size() < 2 || tau.size() != pos.size()) {
445 throw std::invalid_argument("ringFromPath: the orbit has no length");
446 }
447 // Bead j sits at imaginary time j * beta hbar / N on the way from the
448 // reactant-side turning point to the other side. The return repeats it.
449 std::vector<VectorXd> ring(static_cast<size_t>(beads), VectorXd::Zero(width));
450 for (long j = 0; j <= beads / 2; ++j) {
451 const double t =
452 std::min(half, half * 2.0 * static_cast<double>(j) / beads);
453 const auto it = std::upper_bound(tau.begin(), tau.end(), t);
454 const size_t k = std::clamp<size_t>(
455 static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(tau.begin(), it)), 1, tau.size() - 1);
456 const double seg = tau[k] - tau[k - 1];
457 const double w = seg > 0.0 ? (t - tau[k - 1]) / seg : 0.0;
458 const double sj =
459 pos[k - 1] + std::clamp(w, 0.0, 1.0) * (pos[k] - pos[k - 1]);
460 ring[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = atArcLength(path, s, sj);
461 if (j > 0 && j < beads - j) {
462 ring[static_cast<size_t>(beads - j)] = ring[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
463 }
464 }
465 return ring;
466}

468double wkbLogRateAlongPath(const Profile &profile, double beta,
469 double hwReactant) {
470 if (!(beta > 0.0) || !(hwReactant > 0.0)) {
471 throw std::invalid_argument(
472 "wkbLogRateAlongPath: beta and hbar omega must be positive");
473 }
474 const double vReactant = profile.v().front();
475 const double s0 = profile.s().front();
476 const double s1 = profile.s().back();
477 double vTop = vReactant;
478 double sTop = s0;
479 const int grid = 2000;
480 for (int k = 0; k <= grid; ++k) {
481 const double sk = s0 + (s1 - s0) * static_cast<double>(k) / grid;
482 const double vk = profile(sk);
483 if (vk >= vTop) {
484 vTop = vk;
485 sTop = sk;
486 }
487 }
488 const double barrier = vTop - vReactant;
489 if (!(barrier > 0.0)) {
490 throw std::invalid_argument(
491 "wkbLogRateAlongPath: no barrier above the reactant");
492 }
493 double ds = 1e-3 * (s1 - s0);
494 ds = std::min(ds, std::min(sTop - s0, s1 - sTop));
495 if (!(ds > 0.0)) {
496 throw std::invalid_argument(
497 "wkbLogRateAlongPath: the barrier top is at an end of the path");
498 }
499 const double curvature =
500 std::max(1e-12, -(profile(sTop + ds) - 2.0 * vTop + profile(sTop - ds)) /
501 (ds * ds));
502 const double hwBarrier = kHbar * std::sqrt(curvature);
503 // int P(E) exp(-beta E) dE from the reactant up to where the Boltzmann
504 // factor has died. E is measured from the reactant.
505 const double eMax = barrier + 40.0 / beta;
506 const int points = 600;
507 auto logAdd = [](double a, double b) {
508 if (a == -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity()) {
509 return b;
510 }
511 const double m = std::max(a, b);
512 return m + std::log(std::exp(a - m) + std::exp(b - m));
513 };
514 double logTerms = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
515 double prevLog = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
516 double prevE = 0.0;
517 for (int k = 0; k <= points; ++k) {
518 const double energy = eMax * static_cast<double>(k) / points;
519 double theta = 0.0;
520 if (energy < barrier) {
521 theta = wkbAction(profile, vReactant + energy);
522 } else {
523 theta = -std::numbers::pi * (energy - barrier) / hwBarrier;
524 }
525 const double logP =
526 theta > 20.0 ? -2.0 * theta : -std::log1p(std::exp(2.0 * theta));
527 const double logF = logP - beta * energy;
528 if (k > 0) {
529 const double segment =
530 std::log(0.5 * (energy - prevE)) + logAdd(prevLog, logF);
531 logTerms = logAdd(logTerms, segment);
532 }
533 prevLog = logF;
534 prevE = energy;
535 }
536 const double logFlux = logTerms - std::log(2.0 * std::numbers::pi * kHbar);
537 return logFlux + std::log(2.0 * std::sinh(0.5 * beta * hwReactant));
538}

540Profile bandProfile(const std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Matter>> &band,
541 double referenceEnergy) {
542 std::vector<double> v;
543 v.reserve(band.size());
544 for (const auto &image : band) {
545 v.push_back(image->getPotentialEnergy() - referenceEnergy);
546 }
547 return Profile(massWeightedPath(band), std::move(v));
548}

550Splitting bandSplitting(const std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Matter>> &band,
551 double referenceEnergy) {
552 const Profile p = bandProfile(band, referenceEnergy);
553 return wkbSplitting(p, hbarOmega(wellCurvature(p, true)),
554 hbarOmega(wellCurvature(p, false)));
555}

557bool singleBarrier(const Profile &p) {
558 const auto &v = p.v();
559 long peaks = 0;
560 long valleys = 0;
561 int last = 0;
562 for (size_t k = 1; k < v.size(); ++k) {
563 const int step = v[k] > v[k - 1] ? 1 : (v[k] < v[k - 1] ? -1 : 0);
564 if (step == 0) {
565 continue;
566 }
567 peaks += (last == 1 && step == -1) ? 1 : 0;
568 valleys += (last == -1 && step == 1) ? 1 : 0;
569 last = step;
570 }
571 return peaks == 1 && valleys == 0;
572}
573
574Levels dvrLevels(const std::function<double(double)> &v, double sReactant,
575 double sProduct, double sTop, double hwReactant,
576 double hwProduct) {
577 if (!(hwReactant > 0.0) || !(hwProduct > 0.0) || !(sProduct > sReactant)) {
578 throw std::invalid_argument(
579 "dvrLevels: two wells with positive hbar omega along an increasing "
580 "path");
581 }
582 const double ellR = kHbar / std::sqrt(hwReactant);
583 const double ellP = kHbar / std::sqrt(hwProduct);
584 const double lo = sReactant - kDvrPadLengths * ellR;
585 const double hi = sProduct + kDvrPadLengths * ellP;
586 const long n = std::clamp<long>(
587 static_cast<long>(
588 std::ceil((hi - lo) * kDvrPointsPerLength / std::min(ellR, ellP))) +
589 1,
590 64, kDvrMaxPoints);
591 const double h = (hi - lo) / static_cast<double>(n - 1);
592 const double c = kHbar * kHbar / (2.0 * h * h);
593 MatrixXd hmat = MatrixXd::Zero(n, n);
594 for (long i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
595 hmat(i, i) = v(lo + static_cast<double>(i) * h) + 2.5 * c;
596 if (i + 1 < n) {
597 hmat(i, i + 1) = hmat(i + 1, i) = -4.0 * c / 3.0;
598 }
599 if (i + 2 < n) {
600 hmat(i, i + 2) = hmat(i + 2, i) = c / 12.0;
601 }
602 }
603 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> es(hmat);
604 // The overlaps of the two lowest states on the reactant side; their
605 // leading eigenvector is the rotation onto the reactant-localised state.
606 Eigen::Matrix2d side = Eigen::Matrix2d::Zero();
607 for (long i = 0; i < n && lo + static_cast<double>(i) * h < sTop; ++i) {
608 const double a = es.eigenvectors()(i, 0);
609 const double b = es.eigenvectors()(i, 1);
610 side(0, 0) += a * a;
611 side(0, 1) += a * b;
612 side(1, 1) += b * b;
613 }
614 side(1, 0) = side(0, 1);
615 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<Eigen::Matrix2d> rotation(side);
616 const double cosine = rotation.eigenvectors()(0, 1);
617 const double sine = rotation.eigenvectors()(1, 1);
618 Levels out;
619 out.gap = es.eigenvalues()(1) - es.eigenvalues()(0);
620 out.asymmetry = out.gap * (cosine * cosine - sine * sine);
621 out.delta0 = 2.0 * out.gap * std::abs(cosine * sine);
622 return out;
623}

625namespace {
626
627// The cubic spline through (0, 0) and the given points, flat at 0 and
628// natural at the last point; past it, straight along its end slope.
629class FlatStartSpline {
630public:
631 FlatStartSpline(std::vector<double> x, std::vector<double> y)
632 : x_(std::move(x)),
633 y_(std::move(y)) {
634 const size_t m = x_.size() - 1;
635 for (size_t i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
636 if (!(x_[i + 1] > x_[i])) {
637 throw std::invalid_argument(
638 "a wall needs increasing distances past the minimum");
639 }
640 }
641 // Moments M_0 .. M_{m-1} from the tridiagonal system, M_m = 0.
642 std::vector<double> sub(m, 0.0), dia(m, 0.0), sup(m, 0.0), rhs(m, 0.0);
643 auto h = [&](size_t i) { return x_[i + 1] - x_[i]; };
644 auto slope = [&](size_t i) { return (y_[i + 1] - y_[i]) / h(i); };
645 dia[0] = 2.0 * h(0);
646 sup[0] = h(0);
647 rhs[0] = 6.0 * slope(0);
648 for (size_t i = 1; i < m; ++i) {
649 sub[i] = h(i - 1);
650 dia[i] = 2.0 * (h(i - 1) + h(i));
651 sup[i] = h(i);
652 rhs[i] = 6.0 * (slope(i) - slope(i - 1));
653 }
654 for (size_t i = 1; i < m; ++i) {
655 const double w = sub[i] / dia[i - 1];
656 dia[i] -= w * sup[i - 1];
657 rhs[i] -= w * rhs[i - 1];
658 }
659 m_.assign(m + 1, 0.0);
660 for (size_t i = m; i-- > 0;) {
661 m_[i] = (rhs[i] - (i + 1 < m ? sup[i] * m_[i + 1] : 0.0)) / dia[i];
662 }
663 endSlope_ = slope(m - 1) + m_[m - 1] * h(m - 1) / 6.0;
664 }
665 double operator()(double u) const {
666 if (u >= x_.back()) {
667 return y_.back() + endSlope_ * (u - x_.back());
668 }
669 const auto it = std::upper_bound(x_.begin(), x_.end(), u);
670 const size_t i =
671 std::clamp<size_t>(static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(x_.begin(), it)),
672 1, x_.size() - 1) -
673 1;
674 const double h = x_[i + 1] - x_[i];
675 const double a = x_[i + 1] - u;
676 const double b = u - x_[i];
677 return (m_[i] * a * a * a + m_[i + 1] * b * b * b) / (6.0 * h) +
678 (y_[i] - m_[i] * h * h / 6.0) * a / h +
679 (y_[i + 1] - m_[i + 1] * h * h / 6.0) * b / h;
680 }
681
682private:
683 std::vector<double> x_, y_, m_;
684 double endSlope_ = 0.0;
685};

688
689Levels bandLevels(const Profile &p, const BandWalls *walls) {
690 const std::array<double, 2> fitR = wellFit(p, true);
691 const std::array<double, 2> fitP = wellFit(p, false);
692 const double hwR = hbarOmega(2.0 * fitR[0]);
693 const double hwP = hbarOmega(2.0 * fitP[0]);
694 const double s0 = p.s().front();
695 const double s1 = p.s().back();
696 double sTop = s0;
697 double vTop = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
698 constexpr int grid = 4000;
699 for (int k = 0; k <= grid; ++k) {
700 const double sk = s0 + (s1 - s0) * static_cast<double>(k) / grid;
701 if (p(sk) > vTop) {
702 vTop = p(sk);
703 sTop = sk;
704 }
705 }
706 // Past each end the well's fit, its parabola or its cubic, whichever is
707 // stiffer. A sampled wall adds the residual of its samples, a spline flat
708 // at the minimum: the fit already bends like the potential where the
709 // ground state lives, so the residual is small there and smooth beyond.
710 auto model = [](double u, const std::array<double, 2> &fit) {
711 return std::max(fit[0] * u * u - fit[1] * u * u * u, fit[0] * u * u);
712 };
713 auto residual = [&](const BandWall *wall, const std::array<double, 2> &fit,
714 double floor) -> std::optional<FlatStartSpline> {
715 if (wall == nullptr || wall->distance.empty()) {
716 return std::nullopt;
717 }
718 if (wall->distance.size() != wall->energy.size()) {
719 throw std::invalid_argument("a wall needs one energy per distance");
720 }
721 std::vector<double> x{0.0};
722 std::vector<double> y{0.0};
723 for (size_t k = 0; k < wall->distance.size(); ++k) {
724 x.push_back(wall->distance[k]);
725 y.push_back(wall->energy[k] - floor - model(wall->distance[k], fit));
726 }
727 return FlatStartSpline(std::move(x), std::move(y));
728 };
729 const std::optional<FlatStartSpline> wallR =
730 residual(walls ? &walls->reactant : nullptr, fitR, p.v().front());
731 const std::optional<FlatStartSpline> wallP =
732 residual(walls ? &walls->product : nullptr, fitP, p.v().back());
733 auto outer = [&](double u, const std::array<double, 2> &fit, double floor,
734 const std::optional<FlatStartSpline> &wall) {
735 return floor + model(u, fit) + (wall ? (*wall)(u) : 0.0);
736 };
737 auto v = [&](double s) {
738 if (s < s0) {
739 return outer(s0 - s, fitR, p.v().front(), wallR);
740 }
741 if (s > s1) {
742 return outer(s - s1, fitP, p.v().back(), wallP);
743 }
744 return p(s);
745 };
746 return dvrLevels(v, s0, s1, sTop, hwR, hwP);
747}
748
749BandWalls bandWalls(const std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Matter>> &band,
750 double referenceEnergy, long points) {
751 if (band.size() < 3 || points < 1) {
752 throw std::invalid_argument(
753 "bandWalls: a band of three images or more and a point per wall");
754 }
755 const Profile p = bandProfile(band, referenceEnergy);
756 auto wall = [&](const Matter &end, const Matter &next, double a) {
757 const double ell = kHbar / std::sqrt(hbarOmega(2.0 * a));
758 const AtomMatrix step = end.pbc(end.getPositions() - next.getPositions());
759 const auto mass = end.getMasses();
760 double norm2 = 0.0;
761 for (long i = 0; i < end.numberOfAtoms(); ++i) {
762 norm2 += mass(i) * step.row(i).squaredNorm();
763 }
764 if (!(norm2 > 0.0)) {
765 throw std::invalid_argument("bandWalls: an end segment has no length");
766 }
767 // One unit of mass-weighted length along the end segment, outward.
768 const AtomMatrix direction = step / std::sqrt(norm2);
769 BandWall out;
770 Matter probe(end);
771 for (long k = 1; k <= points; ++k) {
772 const double u = kDvrPadLengths * ell * static_cast<double>(k) /
773 static_cast<double>(points);
774 probe.setPositions(end.getPositions() + u * direction);
775 out.distance.push_back(u);
776 out.energy.push_back(probe.getPotentialEnergy() - referenceEnergy);
777 }
778 return out;
779 };
780 BandWalls out;
781 out.reactant = wall(*band.front(), *band[1], wellFit(p, true)[0]);
782 out.product =
783 wall(*band.back(), *band[band.size() - 2], wellFit(p, false)[0]);
784 return out;
785}

791constexpr long kDenseRing = 4096;
792
794constexpr double kTrackOverlap = 0.3;
797constexpr long kRitzCap = 400;
798
799using ColMajorXd =
800 Eigen::Matrix<double, Eigen::Dynamic, Eigen::Dynamic, Eigen::ColMajor>;
801
802// The open chain J with diagonal blocks A_k, each already holding the bead
803// Hessian plus 2 c I, and -c I between neighbours.
804// Block LU: D_1 = A_1, D_k = A_k - c^2 D_{k-1}^-1.
805class BlockChain {
806public:
807 BlockChain(double c, const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag)
808 : c_(c) {
809 lu_.reserve(diag.size());
810 for (size_t k = 0; k < diag.size(); ++k) {
811 ColMajorXd d = diag[k];
812 if (k > 0) {
813 d -= c_ * c_ * lu_.back().inverse();
814 }
815 lu_.emplace_back(std::move(d));
816 const auto &f = lu_.back();
817 sign_ *= static_cast<int>(std::lround(f.permutationP().determinant()));
818 for (long i = 0; i < d.rows(); ++i) {
819 const double u = f.matrixLU()(i, i);
820 if (u == 0.0) {
821 throw std::runtime_error("instanton: singular chain Hessian block");
822 }
823 sign_ *= u < 0.0 ? -1 : 1;
824 logAbsDet_ += std::log(std::abs(u));
825 }
826 }
827 }
828 double logAbsDet() const { return logAbsDet_; }
829 int sign() const { return sign_; }
830 // x = J^-1 b, b and x stacked by bead.
831 std::vector<VectorXd> solve(const std::vector<VectorXd> &b) const {
832 const size_t m = b.size();
833 std::vector<VectorXd> y(m), x(m);
834 y[0] = b[0];
835 for (size_t k = 1; k < m; ++k) {
836 y[k] = b[k] + c_ * lu_[k - 1].solve(y[k - 1]);
837 }
838 x[m - 1] = lu_[m - 1].solve(y[m - 1]);
839 for (size_t k = m - 1; k-- > 0;) {
840 x[k] = lu_[k].solve(y[k] + c_ * x[k + 1]);
841 }
842 return x;
843 }
844 // Same recurrence, several right-hand sides per bead.
845 std::vector<MatrixXd> solve(const std::vector<MatrixXd> &b) const {
846 const size_t m = b.size();
847 std::vector<MatrixXd> y(m), x(m);
848 y[0] = b[0];
849 for (size_t k = 1; k < m; ++k) {
850 y[k] = b[k] + c_ * lu_[k - 1].solve(y[k - 1]);
851 }
852 x[m - 1] = lu_[m - 1].solve(y[m - 1]);
853 for (size_t k = m - 1; k-- > 0;) {
854 x[k] = lu_[k].solve(y[k] + c_ * x[k + 1]);
855 }
856 return x;
857 }
858
859private:
860 double c_;
861 std::vector<Eigen::PartialPivLU<ColMajorXd>> lu_;
862 double logAbsDet_ = 0.0;
863 int sign_ = 1;
864};
865
866// Spring of every link j (bead j to bead j + 1, the last closing the ring):
867// c, or c / w_j under link weights.
868std::vector<double> linkSprings(double c, size_t n,
869 const std::vector<double> *weight) {
870 std::vector<double> out(n, c);
871 if (weight == nullptr || weight->empty()) {
872 return out;
873 }
874 if (weight->size() != n) {
875 throw std::invalid_argument(
876 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
877 }
878 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
879 if (!((*weight)[j] > 0.0)) {
880 throw std::invalid_argument(
881 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
882 }
883 out[j] = c / (*weight)[j];
884 }
885 return out;
886}
887
888// Block LU of an open block-tridiagonal chain with given diagonal blocks
889// and -c_j I between bead j and j + 1. Solves, and the inertia and
890// log-determinant from the Schur complements (Haynsworth: the inertia of
891// the chain is the sum over its Schur blocks).
892class HaynsworthChain {
893public:
894 HaynsworthChain(double c, const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag, bool spectrum,
895 const std::vector<double> *weight = nullptr)
896 : link_(linkSprings(c, diag.size(), weight)) {
897 lu_.reserve(diag.size());
898 for (size_t k = 0; k < diag.size(); ++k) {
899 const long f = diag[k].rows();
900 MatrixXd d = 0.5 * (diag[k] + diag[k].transpose());
901 if (k > 0) {
902 const MatrixXd inv = lu_.back().inverse();
903 const double ck = link_[k - 1];
904 d -= ck * ck * 0.5 * (inv + inv.transpose());
905 }
906 if (spectrum) {
907 const ColMajorXd sym = d;
908 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(
909 sym, Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
910 for (long i = 0; i < f; ++i) {
911 const double lam = es.eigenvalues()(i);
912 if (lam == 0.0) {
913 throw std::runtime_error("instanton: singular chain Hessian block");
914 }
915 if (lam < 0.0) {
916 ++negative_;
917 }
918 logAbsDet_ += std::log(std::abs(lam));
919 }
920 }
921 lu_.emplace_back(ColMajorXd(d));
922 }
923 }
924 double logAbsDet() const { return logAbsDet_; }
925 long negative() const { return negative_; }
926 std::vector<VectorXd> solve(const std::vector<VectorXd> &b) const {
927 const size_t m = b.size();
928 std::vector<VectorXd> y(m), x(m);
929 y[0] = b[0];
930 for (size_t k = 1; k < m; ++k) {
931 y[k] = b[k] + link_[k - 1] * lu_[k - 1].solve(y[k - 1]);
932 }
933 x[m - 1] = lu_[m - 1].solve(y[m - 1]);
934 for (size_t k = m - 1; k-- > 0;) {
935 x[k] = lu_[k].solve(y[k] + link_[k] * x[k + 1]);
936 }
937 return x;
938 }
939 double closingSpring() const { return link_.back(); }
940
941private:
942 std::vector<double> link_;
943 std::vector<Eigen::PartialPivLU<ColMajorXd>> lu_;
944 double logAbsDet_ = 0.0;
945 long negative_ = 0;
946};
947
948double dot(const std::vector<VectorXd> &a, const std::vector<VectorXd> &b) {
949 double s = 0.0;
950 for (size_t k = 0; k < a.size(); ++k) {
951 s += a[k].dot(b[k]);
952 }
953 return s;
954}
955
956void scale(std::vector<VectorXd> &a, double f) {
957 for (auto &v : a) {
958 v *= f;
959 }
960}
961
962// Point at arc-length fraction f along a polyline.
963VectorXd alongPolyline(const std::vector<VectorXd> &pts,
964 const std::vector<double> &cum, double f) {
965 const double target = f * cum.back();
966 const auto it = std::upper_bound(cum.begin(), cum.end(), target);
967 const size_t k = std::clamp<size_t>(
968 static_cast<size_t>(std::distance(cum.begin(), it)), 1, pts.size() - 1);
969 const double seg = cum[k] - cum[k - 1];
970 const double t = seg > 0.0 ? (target - cum[k - 1]) / seg : 0.0;
971 return pts[k - 1] + std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0) * (pts[k] - pts[k - 1]);
972}
973
974struct ActionEval {
975 double action = 0.0;
976 std::vector<double> v; // interior beads
977 std::vector<VectorXd> grad; // dS/dq over interior beads
978 std::vector<VectorXd> potGrad; // dV/dq over interior beads
979};
980
981ActionEval evaluateAction(const std::vector<VectorXd> &interior,
982 const VectorXd &start, const VectorXd &end,
983 double vStart, double vEnd, double dtau,
984 const BatchPotential &potential) {
985 ActionEval out;
986 potential(interior, out.v, out.potGrad);
987 const size_t m = interior.size();
988 if (out.v.size() != m || out.potGrad.size() != m) {
989 throw std::runtime_error("instanton: potential returned the wrong count");
990 }
991 auto bead = [&](size_t j) -> const VectorXd & {
992 return j == 0 ? start : (j == m + 1 ? end : interior[j - 1]);
993 };
994 double kinetic = 0.0;
995 for (size_t j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
996 kinetic += (bead(j + 1) - bead(j)).squaredNorm();
997 }
998 double pot = 0.5 * (vStart + vEnd);
999 for (double vj : out.v) {
1000 pot += vj;
1001 }
1002 out.action = 0.5 * kinetic / dtau + dtau * pot;
1003 out.grad.resize(m);
1004 for (size_t j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
1005 out.grad[j - 1] = (2.0 * bead(j) - bead(j - 1) - bead(j + 1)) / dtau +
1006 dtau * out.potGrad[j - 1];
1007 }
1008 return out;
1009}
1010
1011double largestBeadNorm(const std::vector<VectorXd> &g) {
1012 double m = 0.0;
1013 for (const auto &v : g) {
1014 m = std::max(m, v.norm());
1015 }
1016 return m;
1017}

1020
1021double pathOmega(const MatrixXd &hessStart, const MatrixXd &hessEnd,
1022 const VectorXd &start, const VectorXd &end) {
1023 const VectorXd d = (end - start).normalized();
1024 const double k = std::max(d.dot(hessStart * d), d.dot(hessEnd * d));
1025 if (!(k > 0.0)) {
1026 throw std::invalid_argument(
1027 "pathOmega: no positive curvature along the path at either minimum");
1028 }
1029 return std::sqrt(k);
1030}
1031
1032Instanton optimizeInstanton(const VectorXd &start, const VectorXd &end,
1033 double betaHbar, std::vector<VectorXd> guess,
1034 const BatchPotential &potential,
1035 const InstantonOptions &options) {
1036 const long P = options.beads;
1037 if (P < 4 || !(betaHbar > 0.0) || start.size() != end.size()) {
1038 throw std::invalid_argument("optimizeInstanton: need P >= 4, beta hbar > 0 "
1039 "and ends of one dimension");
1040 }
1041 Instanton inst;
1042 inst.betaHbar = betaHbar;
1043 inst.dtau = betaHbar / static_cast<double>(P);
1044 const double dtau = inst.dtau;
1045
1046 std::vector<double> vEnds;
1047 std::vector<VectorXd> gEnds;
1048 potential({start, end}, vEnds, gEnds);
1049 if (vEnds.size() != 2) {
1050 throw std::runtime_error("instanton: potential returned the wrong count");
1051 }
1052 inst.asymmetry = vEnds[1] - vEnds[0];
1053
1054 // Beads along the guess (or the straight line) on a tanh kink centred at
1055 // beta hbar / 2 whose width follows the harmonic decay of a well.
1056 if (guess.size() < 2) {
1057 guess = {start, end};
1058 }
1059 std::vector<double> cum(guess.size(), 0.0);
1060 for (size_t k = 1; k < guess.size(); ++k) {
1061 cum[k] = cum[k - 1] + (guess[k] - guess[k - 1]).norm();
1062 }
1063 if (!(cum.back() > 0.0)) {
1064 throw std::invalid_argument("optimizeInstanton: the two minima coincide");
1065 }
1066 const double width = betaHbar / (2.0 * options.betaHbarOmega);
1067 std::vector<VectorXd> x(static_cast<size_t>(P - 1));
1068 for (long j = 1; j < P; ++j) {
1069 const double tau = static_cast<double>(j) * dtau - 0.5 * betaHbar;
1070 const double f = 0.5 * (1.0 + std::tanh(tau / width));
1071 x[static_cast<size_t>(j - 1)] = alongPolyline(guess, cum, f);
1072 }
1073
1074 // L-BFGS with a backtracking Armijo line search.
1075 ActionEval cur =
1076 evaluateAction(x, start, end, vEnds[0], vEnds[1], dtau, potential);
1077 std::deque<std::pair<std::vector<VectorXd>, std::vector<VectorXd>>> pairs;
1078 for (long it = 0; it < options.maxIterations; ++it) {
1079 inst.iterations = it;
1080 if (largestBeadNorm(cur.grad) / dtau < options.forceTolerance) {
1081 inst.converged = true;
1082 break;
1083 }
1084 std::vector<VectorXd> q = cur.grad;
1085 std::vector<double> alpha(pairs.size());
1086 for (size_t i = pairs.size(); i-- > 0;) {
1087 const double rho = 1.0 / dot(pairs[i].second, pairs[i].first);
1088 alpha[i] = rho * dot(pairs[i].first, q);
1089 for (size_t k = 0; k < q.size(); ++k) {
1090 q[k] -= alpha[i] * pairs[i].second[k];
1091 }
1092 }
1093 // Without history, half the inverse spring stiffness 2 / dtau.
1094 double gamma = dtau / 4.0;
1095 if (!pairs.empty()) {
1096 gamma = dot(pairs.back().first, pairs.back().second) /
1097 dot(pairs.back().second, pairs.back().second);
1098 }
1099 scale(q, gamma);
1100 for (size_t i = 0; i < pairs.size(); ++i) {
1101 const double rho = 1.0 / dot(pairs[i].second, pairs[i].first);
1102 const double beta = rho * dot(pairs[i].second, q);
1103 for (size_t k = 0; k < q.size(); ++k) {
1104 q[k] += (alpha[i] - beta) * pairs[i].first[k];
1105 }
1106 }
1107 // q is now the inverse-Hessian estimate times the gradient; step -q.
1108 double slope = -dot(cur.grad, q);
1109 if (!(slope < 0.0)) {
1110 pairs.clear();
1111 q = cur.grad;
1112 scale(q, dtau / 4.0);
1113 slope = -dot(cur.grad, q);
1114 }
1115 double step = 1.0;
1116 ActionEval next;
1117 std::vector<VectorXd> trial(x.size());
1118 bool accepted = false;
1119 for (int ls = 0; ls < 30; ++ls) {
1120 for (size_t k = 0; k < x.size(); ++k) {
1121 trial[k] = x[k] - step * q[k];
1122 }
1123 next = evaluateAction(trial, start, end, vEnds[0], vEnds[1], dtau,
1124 potential);
1125 // Near the minimum the action changes by less than its round-off;
1126 // there a step that shrinks the gradient is progress too.
1127 const bool armijo = next.action <= cur.action + 1e-4 * step * slope;
1128 const bool flat = std::abs(next.action - cur.action) <=
1129 1e-13 * std::max(1.0, std::abs(cur.action));
1130 if (armijo ||
1131 (flat && largestBeadNorm(next.grad) < largestBeadNorm(cur.grad))) {
1132 accepted = true;
1133 break;
1134 }
1135 step *= 0.5;
1136 }
1137 if (!accepted) {
1138 break;
1139 }
1140 std::vector<VectorXd> sk(x.size()), yk(x.size());
1141 for (size_t k = 0; k < x.size(); ++k) {
1142 sk[k] = trial[k] - x[k];
1143 yk[k] = next.grad[k] - cur.grad[k];
1144 }
1145 if (dot(sk, yk) > 0.0) {
1146 pairs.emplace_back(std::move(sk), std::move(yk));
1147 if (static_cast<long>(pairs.size()) > options.memory) {
1148 pairs.pop_front();
1149 }
1150 }
1151 x = std::move(trial);
1152 cur = std::move(next);
1153 }
1154 if (!inst.converged &&
1155 largestBeadNorm(cur.grad) / dtau < options.forceTolerance) {
1156 inst.converged = true;
1157 }
1158
1159 inst.path.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(P + 1));
1160 inst.path.push_back(start);
1161 inst.path.insert(inst.path.end(), x.begin(), x.end());
1162 inst.path.push_back(end);
1163 inst.energies.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(P + 1));
1164 inst.energies.push_back(vEnds[0]);
1165 inst.energies.insert(inst.energies.end(), cur.v.begin(), cur.v.end());
1166 inst.energies.push_back(vEnds[1]);
1167 const double sWell = betaHbar * 0.5 * (vEnds[0] + vEnds[1]);
1168 inst.action = (cur.action - sWell) / kHbar;
1169 double s0 = 0.0;
1170 for (long j = 0; j < P; ++j) {
1171 s0 += (inst.path[static_cast<size_t>(j + 1)] -
1172 inst.path[static_cast<size_t>(j)])
1173 .squaredNorm();
1174 }
1175 inst.s0 = s0 / dtau;
1176 inst.symmetricEnough = std::abs(inst.asymmetry) * betaHbar / kHbar < 0.1;
1177 return inst;
1178}
1179
1180void instantonSplitting(Instanton &inst, const BeadHessian &hessian,
1181 const MatrixXd &hessStart, const MatrixXd &hessEnd) {
1182 const long P = static_cast<long>(inst.path.size()) - 1;
1183 if (P < 4 || !(inst.dtau > 0.0)) {
1184 throw std::invalid_argument("instantonSplitting: no optimised path");
1185 }
1186 const double dtau = inst.dtau;
1187 const double c = 1.0 / dtau;
1188 const long n = inst.path.front().size();
1189 const MatrixXd spring = 2.0 * c * MatrixXd::Identity(n, n);
1190
1191 std::vector<MatrixXd> diag;
1192 diag.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(P - 1));
1193 for (long j = 1; j < P; ++j) {
1194 const MatrixXd h = hessian(j, inst.path[static_cast<size_t>(j)]);
1195 if (h.rows() != n || h.cols() != n) {
1196 throw std::runtime_error("instantonSplitting: bead Hessian size");
1197 }
1198 diag.push_back(spring + dtau * 0.5 * (h + h.transpose()));
1199 }
1200 // The inertia comes from the Schur blocks (Haynsworth), so a path with
1201 // two negative modes is not mistaken for a minimum by the determinant's
1202 // sign.
1203 const HaynsworthChain chain(c, diag, true);
1204
1205 auto wellLogDet = [&](const MatrixXd &h) {
1206 const std::vector<MatrixXd> d(static_cast<size_t>(P - 1),
1207 spring + dtau * 0.5 * (h + h.transpose()));
1208 const HaynsworthChain well(c, d, true);
1209 if (well.negative() > 0) {
1210 throw std::runtime_error(
1211 "instantonSplitting: a well Hessian is not positive definite");
1212 }
1213 return well.logAbsDet();
1214 };
1215 const double logDetWell = 0.5 * (wellLogDet(hessStart) + wellLogDet(hessEnd));
1216
1217 // The zero mode is the kink's translation in imaginary time, along the
1218 // discrete velocity v; det' J = det J (v^T J^-1 v) for v its eigenvector.
1219 std::vector<VectorXd> v(static_cast<size_t>(P - 1));
1220 for (long j = 1; j < P; ++j) {
1221 v[static_cast<size_t>(j - 1)] = inst.path[static_cast<size_t>(j + 1)] -
1222 inst.path[static_cast<size_t>(j - 1)];
1223 }
1224 scale(v, 1.0 / std::sqrt(dot(v, v)));
1225 const double vJv = dot(v, chain.solve(v));
1226 // A zero mode just below zero is one negative eigenvalue the prime
1227 // leaves out; any other negative eigenvalue is a second unstable mode.
1228 if (chain.negative() - (vJv < 0.0 ? 1 : 0) != 0) {
1229 throw std::runtime_error(
1230 "instantonSplitting: the path is not a minimum of the action "
1231 "(a negative mode besides the kink's translation)");
1232 }
1233 inst.zeroMode = 1.0 / vJv;
1234 const double logDetPrime = chain.logAbsDet() + std::log(std::abs(vJv));
1235
1236 // Next eigenvalue: inverse iteration orthogonal to v.
1237 std::vector<VectorXd> w(v.size());
1238 for (size_t k = 0; k < w.size(); ++k) {
1239 w[k].resize(n);
1240 for (long i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
1241 w[k](i) = std::sin(0.7 * static_cast<double>(k) +
1242 1.3 * static_cast<double>(i) + 0.1);
1243 }
1244 }
1245 double lambda1 = 0.0;
1246 for (int it = 0; it < 40; ++it) {
1247 const double proj = dot(v, w);
1248 for (size_t k = 0; k < w.size(); ++k) {
1249 w[k] -= proj * v[k];
1250 }
1251 scale(w, 1.0 / std::sqrt(dot(w, w)));
1252 std::vector<VectorXd> z = chain.solve(w);
1253 lambda1 = 1.0 / dot(w, z);
1254 w = std::move(z);
1255 }
1256 inst.modeSeparation = std::abs(lambda1 / inst.zeroMode);
1257
1258 inst.delta0 = 2.0 * kHbar *
1259 std::sqrt(inst.s0 / (2.0 * std::numbers::pi * kHbar * dtau)) *
1260 std::exp(0.5 * (logDetWell - logDetPrime) - inst.action);
1261}
1262
1263double zeroPointDifference(const MatrixXd &hessStart, const MatrixXd &hessEnd,
1264 long rigidModes) {
1265 if (hessStart.rows() != hessEnd.rows() || rigidModes < 0 ||
1266 rigidModes > hessStart.rows()) {
1267 throw std::invalid_argument("zeroPointDifference: Hessians of one size and "
1268 "a rigid count within it");
1269 }
1270 auto zeroPoint = [&](const MatrixXd &h) {
1271 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> es(0.5 * (h + h.transpose()),
1272 Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
1273 std::vector<double> lam(es.eigenvalues().data(),
1274 es.eigenvalues().data() + es.eigenvalues().size());
1275 std::sort(lam.begin(), lam.end(),
1276 [](double a, double b) { return std::abs(a) < std::abs(b); });
1277 double sum = 0.0;
1278 for (size_t k = static_cast<size_t>(rigidModes); k < lam.size(); ++k) {
1279 sum += std::sqrt(std::max(lam[k], 0.0));
1280 }
1281 return 0.5 * kHbar * sum;
1282 };
1283 return zeroPoint(hessEnd) - zeroPoint(hessStart);
1284}
1285
1286EnergyBias::EnergyBias(const VectorXd &start, const VectorXd &end, double delta)
1287 : start_(start),
1288 d_(end - start),
1289 dd_(d_.squaredNorm()),
1290 delta_(delta) {
1291 if (start.size() != end.size() || !(dd_ > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(delta)) {
1292 throw std::invalid_argument(
1293 "EnergyBias: two distinct minima of one dimension and a finite delta");
1294 }
1295}
1296
1297double EnergyBias::xi(const VectorXd &q) const {
1298 return std::clamp((q - start_).dot(d_) / dd_, 0.0, 1.0);
1299}
1300
1301double EnergyBias::value(const VectorXd &q) const {
1302 const double x = xi(q);
1303 return delta_ * x * x * x * (10.0 + x * (-15.0 + 6.0 * x));
1304}
1305
1306VectorXd EnergyBias::gradient(const VectorXd &q) const {
1307 const double x = xi(q);
1308 return (delta_ * 30.0 * x * x * (1.0 - x) * (1.0 - x) / dd_) * d_;
1309}
1310
1311MatrixXd EnergyBias::hessian(const VectorXd &q) const {
1312 const double x = xi(q);
1313 return (delta_ * 60.0 * x * (1.0 - x) * (1.0 - 2.0 * x) / (dd_ * dd_)) *
1314 (d_ * d_.transpose());
1315}
1316
1317double crossoverTemperature(const MatrixXd &hessSaddle) {
1318 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> es(
1319 0.5 * (hessSaddle + hessSaddle.transpose()));
1320 const double lambda = es.eigenvalues()(0);
1321 if (!(lambda < 0.0)) {
1322 throw std::invalid_argument(
1323 "crossoverTemperature: the saddle Hessian has no negative eigenvalue");
1324 }
1325 return kHbar * std::sqrt(-lambda) / (2.0 * std::numbers::pi * kBoltzmann);
1326}

1328namespace {
1329
1330struct RingEval {
1331 double u = 0.0; // U_N
1332 std::vector<double> v; // V at each bead
1333 std::vector<VectorXd> grad; // dU_N/dq at each bead
1334 std::vector<VectorXd> physicalGrad; // dV/dq without springs or bath
1335};
1336
1337} // namespace
1338
1339void addFrictionBath(const std::vector<VectorXd> &q, double &u,
1340 std::vector<VectorXd> &grad,
1341 const std::vector<double> &eta) {
1342 const size_t n = q.size();
1343 if (n < 2 || eta.empty() || grad.size() != n) {
1344 return;
1345 }
1346 std::vector<double> s(n, eta.size() == 1 ? eta[0] : 0.0);
1347 if (eta.size() == n) {
1348 s = eta;
1349 } else if (eta.size() != 1) {
1350 throw std::invalid_argument(
1351 "addFrictionBath: eta is one value or one per bead");
1352 }
1353 for (double value : s) {
1354 if (!(value >= 0.0)) {
1355 throw std::invalid_argument("addFrictionBath: eta must be non-negative");
1356 }
1357 }
1358 const long f = q[0].size();
1359 std::vector<double> root(n);
1360 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1361 root[j] = std::sqrt(s[j]);
1362 }
1363 std::vector<VectorXd> g(n, VectorXd::Zero(f));
1364 std::vector<double> mid(n, 0.0);
1365 for (size_t j = 1; j < n; ++j) {
1366 mid[j] = 0.5 * (root[j - 1] + root[j]);
1367 g[j] = g[j - 1] + mid[j] * (q[j] - q[j - 1]);
1368 }
1369 std::vector<VectorXd> dUdg(n, VectorXd::Zero(f));
1370 const double scale = 1.0 / std::sqrt(static_cast<double>(n));
1371 for (size_t k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
1372 const double omega =
1373 2.0 * std::abs(std::sin(std::numbers::pi * static_cast<double>(k) /
1374 static_cast<double>(n)));
1375 VectorXd real = VectorXd::Zero(f);
1376 VectorXd imag = VectorXd::Zero(f);
1377 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1378 const double ang = -2.0 * std::numbers::pi * static_cast<double>(k * j) /
1379 static_cast<double>(n);
1380 real += std::cos(ang) * g[j];
1381 imag += std::sin(ang) * g[j];
1382 }
1383 real *= scale;
1384 imag *= scale;
1385 u += 0.5 * omega * (real.squaredNorm() + imag.squaredNorm());
1386 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1387 const double ang = -2.0 * std::numbers::pi * static_cast<double>(k * j) /
1388 static_cast<double>(n);
1389 dUdg[j] += omega * scale * (std::cos(ang) * real + std::sin(ang) * imag);
1390 }
1391 }
1392 for (size_t j = n - 1; j >= 1; --j) {
1393 dUdg[j - 1] += dUdg[j];
1394 if (j == 1) {
1395 break;
1396 }
1397 }
1398 for (size_t j = 1; j < n; ++j) {
1399 grad[j] += mid[j] * dUdg[j];
1400 grad[j - 1] -= mid[j] * dUdg[j];
1401 }
1402}
