1404namespace {
1405
1406std::vector<double> frictionEta(const RateInstantonOptions &options,
1407 size_t beads) {
1408 if (!options.friction) {
1409 return {};
1410 }
1411 if (options.frictionExplicit) {
1412 if (options.frictionEtaBeads.size() != beads) {
1413 throw std::invalid_argument(
1414 "rate instanton: explicit friction needs one eta per bead");
1415 }
1416 return options.frictionEtaBeads;
1417 }
1418 if (!(options.frictionEta > 0.0)) {
1419 return {};
1420 }
1421 return {options.frictionEta};
1422}
1423
1424RingEval evaluateRing(
1425 const std::vector<VectorXd> &x, double c, const BatchPotential &potential,
1426 double energyShift = 0.0, const std::vector<double> &eta = {},
1427 const std::vector<double> &discretization = {},
1428 const std::shared_ptr<const PhysicalQuadraticBath> &physicalBath = {}) {
1429 RingEval out;
1430 std::vector<VectorXd> gv;
1431 potential(x, out.v, gv);
1432 for (double &v : out.v) {
1433 v -= energyShift;
1434 }
1435 const size_t n = x.size();
1436 if (out.v.size() != n || gv.size() != n) {
1437 throw std::runtime_error(
1438 "rate instanton: potential returned the wrong count");
1439 }
1440 out.grad.resize(n);
1441 double spring = 0.0;
1442 if (discretization.empty()) {
1443 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1444 const VectorXd &prev = x[(j + n - 1) % n];
1445 const VectorXd &next = x[(j + 1) % n];
1446 out.grad[j] = gv[j] + c * (2.0 * x[j] - prev - next);
1447 spring += (next - x[j]).squaredNorm();
1448 out.u += out.v[j];
1449 }
1450 out.u += 0.5 * c * spring;
1451 } else {
1452 if (discretization.size() != n) {
1453 throw std::invalid_argument(
1454 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
1455 }
1456 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1457 const double wj = discretization[j];
1458 const double wp = discretization[(j + n - 1) % n];
1459 if (!(wj > 0.0) || !(wp > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(wj) ||
1460 !std::isfinite(wp)) {
1461 throw std::invalid_argument(
1462 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
1463 }
1464 const VectorXd &prev = x[(j + n - 1) % n];
1465 const VectorXd &next = x[(j + 1) % n];
1466 const double cj = c / wj;
1467 const double cp = c / wp;
1468 out.grad[j] = gv[j] + cj * (x[j] - next) + cp * (x[j] - prev);
1469 out.u += out.v[j] + 0.5 * cj * (next - x[j]).squaredNorm();
1470 }
1471 }
1472 if (!eta.empty()) {
1473 addFrictionBath(x, out.u, out.grad, eta);
1474 }
1475 if (physicalBath) {
1476 const auto bath = physicalBath->evaluate(x, c);
1477 out.u += bath.energy;
1478 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j)
1479 out.grad[j] += bath.gradient[j];
1480 }
1481 out.physicalGrad = std::move(gv);
1482 return out;
1483}
1484
1485MatrixXd physicalStaticCurvature(const MatrixXd &h, const VectorXd &q,
1486 const RateInstantonOptions &options) {
1487 if (!options.physicalBath)
1488 return h;
1489 return h + options.physicalBath->evaluate({q}, 1.0, true).hessian;
1490}
1491
1492// Lowest curvature of the ring Hessian over vectors odd under j -> N-j and
1493// orthogonal to the cycle mode x[j+1] - x[j-1], at a mirror-symmetric ring
1494// of even N. A search confined to the even sector cannot see these. The
1495// products move the ring off the mirror, so `potential` evaluates every bead.
1496// Returns +inf when no odd direction is left to probe, or no Lanczos step
1497// is allowed.
1498double lowestOddMode(const std::vector<VectorXd> &x, const RingEval &here,
1499 double c, const BatchPotential &potential,
1500 std::vector<VectorXd> &mode, long steps, double eps,
1501 const std::vector<double> &eta = {}) {
1502 if (steps < 1) {
1503 return std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
1504 }
1505 const size_t n = x.size();
1506 const size_t m = n / 2;
1507 std::vector<VectorXd> cycle(n);
1508 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1509 cycle[j] = x[(j + 1) % n] - x[(j + n - 1) % n];
1510 }
1511 auto odd = [&](std::vector<VectorXd> &q) {
1512 q[0].setZero();
1513 q[m].setZero();
1514 for (size_t a = 1; a < m; ++a) {
1515 const VectorXd half = 0.5 * (q[a] - q[n - a]);
1516 q[a] = half;
1517 q[n - a] = -half;
1518 }
1519 };
1520 odd(cycle);
1521 const double cnorm = std::sqrt(dot(cycle, cycle));
1522 if (cnorm > 0.0) {
1523 scale(cycle, 1.0 / cnorm);
1524 }
1525 auto project = [&](std::vector<VectorXd> &q) {
1526 odd(q);
1527 if (cnorm > 0.0) {
1528 const double p = dot(q, cycle);
1529 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1530 q[j] -= p * cycle[j];
1531 }
1532 }
1533 };
1534 auto hv = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &u) {
1535 std::vector<VectorXd> xp(n);
1536 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1537 xp[j] = x[j] + eps * u[j];
1538 }
1539 const RingEval e = evaluateRing(xp, c, potential, 0.0, eta);
1540 std::vector<VectorXd> out(n);
1541 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1542 out[j] = (e.grad[j] - here.grad[j]) / eps;
1543 }
1544 project(out);
1545 return out;
1546 };
1547 // Start from the bead displacements with opposite signs on the two
1548 // halves: two copies of the turning region moving against each other.
1549 VectorXd mean = VectorXd::Zero(x[0].size());
1550 for (const auto &b : x) {
1551 mean += b;
1552 }
1553 mean /= static_cast<double>(n);
1554 std::vector<VectorXd> q(n);
1555 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1556 q[j] = (j < m ? 1.0 : -1.0) * (x[j] - mean);
1557 }
1558 project(q);
1559 const double qnorm = std::sqrt(dot(q, q));
1560 if (!(qnorm > 1e-12)) {
1561 return std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
1562 }
1563 scale(q, 1.0 / qnorm);
1564 std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> basis;
1565 std::vector<double> alpha, beta;
1566 for (long k = 0; k < steps; ++k) {
1567 basis.push_back(q);
1568 std::vector<VectorXd> w = hv(q);
1569 alpha.push_back(dot(w, q));
1570 for (const auto &b : basis) {
1571 const double p = dot(w, b);
1572 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1573 w[j] -= p * b[j];
1574 }
1575 }
1576 project(w);
1577 const double bnorm = std::sqrt(dot(w, w));
1578 if (!(bnorm > 1e-12) || k + 1 == steps) {
1579 break;
1580 }
1581 beta.push_back(bnorm);
1582 scale(w, 1.0 / bnorm);
1583 q = std::move(w);
1584 }
1585 const long dim = static_cast<long>(alpha.size());
1586 MatrixXd t = MatrixXd::Zero(dim, dim);
1587 for (long i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
1588 t(i, i) = alpha[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
1589 if (i + 1 < dim) {
1590 t(i, i + 1) = t(i + 1, i) = beta[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
1591 }
1592 }
1593 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> es(t);
1594 const VectorXd y = es.eigenvectors().col(0);
1595 mode.assign(n, VectorXd::Zero(x[0].size()));
1596 for (long i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
1597 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1598 mode[j] += y(i) * basis[static_cast<size_t>(i)][j];
1599 }
1600 }
1601 project(mode);
1602 scale(mode, 1.0 / std::sqrt(dot(mode, mode)));
1603 return es.eigenvalues()(0);
1604}
1605
1606// Distance along +dir (sign = 1) or -dir (sign = -1) from the saddle at which
1607// V has dropped by `drop`, from a scan in steps of h; the lowest point found
1608// when V never drops that far.
1609// Energies along +dir (sign = 1) or -dir (sign = -1) from the saddle, in
1610// steps of h.
1611std::vector<double> scanFromSaddle(const VectorXd &saddle, const VectorXd &dir,
1612 double sign, double h, long maxPoints,
1613 const BatchPotential &potential) {
1614 if (!(h > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(h) || maxPoints < 1) {
1615 throw std::invalid_argument(
1616 "rate instanton: the scan from the saddle needs a positive step and "
1617 "at least one point");
1618 }
1619 std::vector<VectorXd> pts;
1620 for (long k = 1; k <= maxPoints; ++k) {
1621 pts.push_back(saddle + sign * h * static_cast<double>(k) * dir);
1622 }
1623 std::vector<double> v;
1624 std::vector<VectorXd> g;
1625 potential(pts, v, g);
1626 if (v.size() != pts.size()) {
1627 throw std::runtime_error(
1628 "rate instanton: potential returned the wrong count");
1629 }
1630 return v;
1631}
1632
1633double turningDistance(const VectorXd &saddle, const VectorXd &dir,
1634 double vSaddle, double drop, double sign, double h,
1635 long maxPoints, const BatchPotential &potential) {
1636 if (!(drop > 0.0)) {
1637 return 0.0;
1638 }
1639 const std::vector<double> v =
1640 scanFromSaddle(saddle, dir, sign, h, maxPoints, potential);
1641 double prevV = vSaddle, prevS = 0.0, best = 0.0, bestV = vSaddle;
1642 for (long k = 0; k < maxPoints; ++k) {
1643 const double sk = h * static_cast<double>(k + 1);
1644 const double vk = v[static_cast<size_t>(k)];
1645 if (vk <= vSaddle - drop) {
1646 const double t = (prevV - (vSaddle - drop)) / (prevV - vk);
1647 return prevS + t * (sk - prevS);
1648 }
1649 if (vk < bestV) {
1650 bestV = vk;
1651 best = sk;
1652 }
1653 if (vk > prevV + 1e-12 && k > 0) {
1654 break; // past the minimum on this side
1655 }
1656 prevV = vk;
1657 prevS = sk;
1658 }
1659 return best;
1660}
1661
1662double sideDrop(const VectorXd &saddle, const VectorXd &dir, double vSaddle,
1663 double sign, double h, long maxPoints,
1664 const BatchPotential &potential) {
1665 const std::vector<double> v =
1666 scanFromSaddle(saddle, dir, sign, h, maxPoints, potential);
1667 double lowest = vSaddle;
1668 for (long k = 0; k < maxPoints; ++k) {
1669 const double vk = v[static_cast<size_t>(k)];
1670 if (vk > lowest + 1e-12 && k > 0 && lowest < vSaddle) {
1671 return vSaddle - lowest; // found this side's minimum
1672 }
1673 lowest = std::min(lowest, vk);
1674 }
1675 return vSaddle - lowest; // still falling: the drop to the last point
1676}
1677
1678struct RingMode {
1679 double theta = 0.0;
1680 double residual = 0.0;
1681 std::vector<VectorXd> vector;
1682};
1683
1684// Lowest Ritz pairs of a symmetric ring operator, full reorthogonalisation.
1685// `steps` at the dimension is the whole spectrum.
1686std::vector<RingMode> lowestRingModes(
1687 const std::function<std::vector<VectorXd>(const std::vector<VectorXd> &)>
1688 &apply,
1689 std::vector<VectorXd> start, long steps) {
1690 const size_t n = start.size();
1691 const long f = start.empty() ? 0 : start.front().size();
1692 const double n0 = std::sqrt(dot(start, start));
1693 if (!(n0 > 0.0) || f < 1) {
1694 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: Lanczos was given a zero vector");
1695 }
1696 scale(start, 1.0 / n0);
1697 std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> basis;
1698 std::vector<double> alpha;
1699 std::vector<double> beta;
1700 std::vector<VectorXd> q = std::move(start);
1701 for (long k = 0; k < steps; ++k) {
1702 basis.push_back(q);
1703 std::vector<VectorXd> w = apply(q);
1704 alpha.push_back(dot(w, q));
1705 for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) {
1706 for (const auto &b : basis) {
1707 const double p = dot(w, b);
1708 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1709 w[j] -= p * b[j];
1710 }
1711 }
1712 }
1713 const double bnorm = std::sqrt(dot(w, w));
1714 if (!(bnorm > 1e-14) || k + 1 == steps) {
1715 break;
1716 }
1717 beta.push_back(bnorm);
1718 scale(w, 1.0 / bnorm);
1719 q = std::move(w);
1720 }
1721 const long m = static_cast<long>(alpha.size());
1722 MatrixXd tridiag = MatrixXd::Zero(m, m);
1723 for (long i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
1724 tridiag(i, i) = alpha[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
1725 if (i + 1 < m) {
1726 tridiag(i, i + 1) = tridiag(i + 1, i) = beta[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
1727 }
1728 }
1729 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> es(tridiag);
1730 std::vector<RingMode> modes;
1731 modes.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(m));
1732 for (long i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
1733 RingMode mode;
1734 mode.theta = es.eigenvalues()(i);
1735 mode.vector.assign(n, VectorXd::Zero(f));
1736 const VectorXd y = es.eigenvectors().col(i);
1737 for (long s = 0; s < m; ++s) {
1738 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1739 mode.vector[j] += y(s) * basis[static_cast<size_t>(s)][j];
1740 }
1741 }
1742 scale(mode.vector, 1.0 / std::sqrt(dot(mode.vector, mode.vector)));
1743 const std::vector<VectorXd> applied = apply(mode.vector);
1744 double residual = 0.0;
1745 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1746 residual += (applied[j] - mode.theta * mode.vector[j]).squaredNorm();
1747 }
1748 mode.residual = std::sqrt(residual);
1749 modes.push_back(std::move(mode));
1750 }
1751 return modes;
1752}
1753
1754// Factored cyclic ring Hessian: the open chain plus the corner coupling
1755// M between bead 0 and bead N-1.
1756// det(H_open + P M P^T) = det(H_open) det(M) det(M^{-1} + P^T H_open^{-1} P),
1757// and |det M| = c^{2f}. A singular ring makes the last factor zero.
1758struct CyclicFactor {
1759 BlockChain open;
1760 Eigen::PartialPivLU<ColMajorXd> cornerLu;
1761 double c;
1762 long f;
1763 long n;
1764 double logAbs;
1765 bool singular;
1766
1767 CyclicFactor(double cIn, const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag)
1768 : open(cIn, diag),
1769 c(cIn),
1770 f(diag.front().rows()),
1771 n(static_cast<long>(diag.size())),
1772 logAbs(0.0),
1773 singular(false) {
1774 const MatrixXd eye = MatrixXd::Identity(f, f);
1775 const MatrixXd zero = MatrixXd::Zero(f, f);
1776 std::vector<MatrixXd> rhs(static_cast<size_t>(n), zero);
1777 rhs.front() = eye;
1778 const std::vector<MatrixXd> fromFirst = open.solve(rhs);
1779 rhs.front() = zero;
1780 rhs.back() = eye;
1781 const std::vector<MatrixXd> fromLast = open.solve(rhs);
1782 MatrixXd corner(2 * f, 2 * f);
1783 corner.topLeftCorner(f, f) = fromFirst.front();
1784 corner.bottomLeftCorner(f, f) = fromFirst.back();
1785 corner.topRightCorner(f, f) = fromLast.front();
1786 corner.bottomRightCorner(f, f) = fromLast.back();
1787 corner.topRightCorner(f, f) -= eye / c;
1788 corner.bottomLeftCorner(f, f) -= eye / c;
1789 cornerLu.compute(ColMajorXd(corner));
1790 logAbs = open.logAbsDet() + 2.0 * static_cast<double>(f) * std::log(c);
1791 const MatrixXd &upper = cornerLu.matrixLU();
1792 // A pivot at round-off of the corner's own scale is a singular ring: a
1793 // zero mode leaves exactly that, never an exact zero.
1794 const double floor = 1e-12 * corner.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
1795 for (long i = 0; i < upper.rows(); ++i) {
1796 const double pivot = upper(i, i);
1797 if (!(std::abs(pivot) > floor)) {
1798 singular = true;
1799 logAbs = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
1800 return;
1801 }
1802 logAbs += std::log(std::abs(pivot));
1803 }
1804 }
1805
1806 std::vector<VectorXd> solve(const std::vector<VectorXd> &rhs) const {
1807 if (singular || static_cast<long>(rhs.size()) != n) {
1808 throw std::runtime_error("cyclic ring: singular");
1809 }
1810 std::vector<VectorXd> y = open.solve(rhs);
1811 VectorXd g(2 * f);
1812 g.head(f) = y.front();
1813 g.tail(f) = y.back();
1814 const VectorXd z = cornerLu.solve(g);
1815 std::vector<VectorXd> bump(static_cast<size_t>(n), VectorXd::Zero(f));
1816 bump.front() = z.head(f);
1817 bump.back() = z.tail(f);
1818 const std::vector<VectorXd> corr = open.solve(bump);
1819 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
1820 y[static_cast<size_t>(j)] -= corr[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
1821 }
1822 return y;
1823 }
1824};
1825
1826// J = T + G K G^T over the chain T: the closure blocks (-c I between the
1827// last bead and the first, c / w_{N-1} under link weights) when `closed`,
1828// and symmetric rank-one terms kappa_i u_i u_i^T. Woodbury gives J^{-1} b,
1829// the determinant lemma ln|det J| and Haynsworth the inertia, all
1830// O(N f^3), so the N f by N f matrix is never formed.
1831class WoodburyRing {
1832public:
1833 WoodburyRing(double c, const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag, bool closed,
1834 const std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> &extras,
1835 const std::vector<double> &kappas, bool spectrum,
1836 const std::vector<double> *weight = nullptr)
1837 : n_(static_cast<long>(diag.size())),
1838 f_(diag.front().rows()),
1839 closed_(closed),
1840 chain_(c, diag, spectrum, weight),
1841 extras_(extras) {
1842 const long base = closed ? 2 * f_ : 0;
1843 const long m = base + static_cast<long>(extras.size());
1844 kinv_ = MatrixXd::Zero(m, m);
1845 MatrixXd k = MatrixXd::Zero(m, m);
1846 if (closed) {
1847 const double cl = chain_.closingSpring();
1848 kinv_.block(0, f_, f_, f_) = -MatrixXd::Identity(f_, f_) / cl;
1849 kinv_.block(f_, 0, f_, f_) = -MatrixXd::Identity(f_, f_) / cl;
1850 k.block(0, f_, f_, f_) = -cl * MatrixXd::Identity(f_, f_);
1851 k.block(f_, 0, f_, f_) = -cl * MatrixXd::Identity(f_, f_);
1852 }
1853 for (size_t i = 0; i < extras.size(); ++i) {
1854 const long r = base + static_cast<long>(i);
1855 kinv_(r, r) = 1.0 / kappas[i];
1856 k(r, r) = kappas[i];
1857 }
1858 if (m == 0) {
1859 ok_ = true;
1860 logAbsDet_ = chain_.logAbsDet();
1861 negative_ = chain_.negative();
1862 return;
1863 }
1864 gtg_ = MatrixXd::Zero(m, m);
1865 for (long col = 0; col < m; ++col) {
1866 gtg_.col(col) = pieces(chain_.solve(column(col)));
1867 }
1868 woodbury_.compute(ColMajorXd(kinv_ + gtg_));
1869 ok_ = gtg_.array().isFinite().all();
1870 if (spectrum) {
1871 const Eigen::PartialPivLU<ColMajorXd> lu(
1872 ColMajorXd(MatrixXd::Identity(m, m) + k * gtg_));
1873 double logDet = 0.0;
1874 for (long i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
1875 const double u = lu.matrixLU()(i, i);
1876 if (u == 0.0) {
1877 ok_ = false;
1878 logAbsDet_ = -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
1879 return;
1880 }
1881 logDet += std::log(std::abs(u));
1882 }
1883 logAbsDet_ = chain_.logAbsDet() + logDet;
1884 // neg(J) = neg(T) + neg(S) - neg(-K^{-1}), S = -K^{-1} - G^T T^{-1} G.
1885 const ColMajorXd sMat = -kinv_ - gtg_;
1886 const ColMajorXd sSym = 0.5 * (sMat + sMat.transpose());
1887 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(
1888 sSym, Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
1889 const ColMajorXd kn = -kinv_;
1890 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> ek(
1891 kn, Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
1892 negative_ = chain_.negative() + (es.eigenvalues().array() < 0.0).count() -
1893 (ek.eigenvalues().array() < 0.0).count();
1894 }
1895 }
1896 bool ok() const { return ok_; }
1897 std::vector<VectorXd> solve(const std::vector<VectorXd> &b) const {
1898 std::vector<VectorXd> tb = chain_.solve(b);
1899 if (kinv_.rows() == 0) {
1900 return tb;
1901 }
1902 const VectorXd y = woodbury_.solve(pieces(tb));
1903 const std::vector<VectorXd> gy = chain_.solve(expand(y));
1904 for (size_t j = 0; j < tb.size(); ++j) {
1905 tb[j] -= gy[j];
1906 }
1907 return tb;
1908 }
1909 double logAbsDet() const { return logAbsDet_; }
1910 long negative() const { return negative_; }
1911
1912private:
1913 std::vector<VectorXd> column(long col) const {
1914 const long base = closed_ ? 2 * f_ : 0;
1915 if (col < base) {
1916 std::vector<VectorXd> g(static_cast<size_t>(n_), VectorXd::Zero(f_));
1917 g[static_cast<size_t>(col < f_ ? 0 : n_ - 1)](col % f_) = 1.0;
1918 return g;
1919 }
1920 return extras_[static_cast<size_t>(col - base)];
1921 }
1922 VectorXd pieces(const std::vector<VectorXd> &x) const {
1923 const long base = closed_ ? 2 * f_ : 0;
1924 VectorXd out(base + static_cast<long>(extras_.size()));
1925 if (closed_) {
1926 out.head(f_) = x[0];
1927 out.segment(f_, f_) = x[static_cast<size_t>(n_ - 1)];
1928 }
1929 for (size_t i = 0; i < extras_.size(); ++i) {
1930 out(base + static_cast<long>(i)) = dot(extras_[i], x);
1931 }
1932 return out;
1933 }
1934 std::vector<VectorXd> expand(const VectorXd &y) const {
1935 const long base = closed_ ? 2 * f_ : 0;
1936 std::vector<VectorXd> g(static_cast<size_t>(n_), VectorXd::Zero(f_));
1937 if (closed_) {
1938 g[0] += y.head(f_);
1939 g[static_cast<size_t>(n_ - 1)] += y.segment(f_, f_);
1940 }
1941 for (size_t i = 0; i < extras_.size(); ++i) {
1942 const double w = y(base + static_cast<long>(i));
1943 for (long j = 0; j < n_; ++j) {
1944 g[static_cast<size_t>(j)] += w * extras_[i][static_cast<size_t>(j)];
1945 }
1946 }
1947 return g;
1948 }
1949
1950 long n_, f_;
1951 bool closed_;
1952 HaynsworthChain chain_;
1953 std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> extras_;
1954 MatrixXd kinv_, gtg_;
1955 Eigen::PartialPivLU<ColMajorXd> woodbury_;
1956 bool ok_ = false;
1957 double logAbsDet_ = 0.0;
1958 long negative_ = 0;
1959};
1960
1961// Diagonal blocks of the closed ring (H + 2 c I) or of the half chain from
1962// one turning point to the other (end blocks H / 2 + c I).
1963std::vector<MatrixXd>
1964ringDiagonal(const std::vector<MatrixXd> &physical, double c, bool half,
1965 const std::vector<double> *weight = nullptr) {
1966 const long beads = static_cast<long>(physical.size());
1967 const long f = physical.front().rows();
1968 const bool weighted = weight != nullptr && !weight->empty();
1969 if (weighted && (half || static_cast<long>(weight->size()) != beads)) {
1970 throw std::invalid_argument(
1971 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
1972 }
1973 std::vector<MatrixXd> diag(static_cast<size_t>(beads));
1974 for (long j = 0; j < beads; ++j) {
1975 const bool end = half && (j == 0 || j + 1 == beads);
1976 MatrixXd block = 0.5 * (physical[static_cast<size_t>(j)] +
1977 physical[static_cast<size_t>(j)].transpose());
1978 if (end) {
1979 block *= 0.5;
1980 }
1981 double add = end ? c : 2.0 * c;
1982 if (weighted) {
1983 const double wj = (*weight)[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
1984 const double wp = (*weight)[static_cast<size_t>((j + beads - 1) % beads)];
1985 if (!(wj > 0.0) || !(wp > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(wj) ||
1986 !std::isfinite(wp)) {
1987 throw std::invalid_argument(
1988 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
1989 }
1990 add = c / wj + c / wp;
1991 }
1992 block += add * MatrixXd::Identity(f, f);
1993 diag[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = block;
1994 }
1995 return diag;
1996}
1997
1998// (diag - c neighbours) v for the closed ring or the open half chain.
1999std::vector<VectorXd>
2000applyDiagonal(const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag, double c, bool closed,
2001 const std::vector<VectorXd> &v,
2002 const std::vector<double> *weight = nullptr) {
2003 const size_t n = v.size();
2004 const bool weighted = weight != nullptr && !weight->empty();
2005 if (weighted && (!closed || weight->size() != n)) {
2006 throw std::invalid_argument(
2007 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
2008 }
2009 std::vector<VectorXd> out(n);
2010 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
2011 out[j] = diag[j] * v[j];
2012 const size_t prev = (j + n - 1) % n;
2013 const size_t next = (j + 1) % n;
2014 double cPrev = c;
2015 double cNext = c;
2016 if (weighted) {
2017 const double wp = (*weight)[prev];
2018 const double wj = (*weight)[j];
2019 if (!(wp > 0.0) || !(wj > 0.0)) {
2020 throw std::invalid_argument(
2021 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
2022 }
2023 cPrev = c / wp;
2024 cNext = c / wj;
2025 }
2026 if (j > 0 || closed) {
2027 out[j] -= cPrev * v[prev];
2028 }
2029 if (j + 1 < n || closed) {
2030 out[j] -= cNext * v[next];
2031 }
2032 }
2033 return out;
2034}
2035
2036} // namespace
2037
2038namespace {
2039
2040void requireCyclicBlocks(double c, const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag,
2041 const char *what) {
2042 if (!(c > 0.0) || diag.empty()) {
2043 throw std::invalid_argument(std::string(what) +
2044 ": need a positive spring constant and blocks");
2045 }
2046 const long f = diag.front().rows();
2047 const long n = static_cast<long>(diag.size());
2048 if (f < 1 || n < 2) {
2049 throw std::invalid_argument(std::string(what) +
2050 ": need at least two beads and one coordinate");
2051 }
2052 for (const auto &block : diag) {
2053 if (block.rows() != f || block.cols() != f) {
2054 throw std::invalid_argument(std::string(what) +
2055 ": the blocks differ in size");
2056 }
2057 }
2058}
2059
2060} // namespace
2061
2062RingSpectrum ringSpectrum(const std::vector<MatrixXd> &beadHessians, double c,
2063 const std::vector<VectorXd> &tau) {
2064 if (beadHessians.empty() || beadHessians.size() != tau.size()) {
2065 throw std::invalid_argument(
2066 "ringSpectrum: N bead Hessians and N tau blocks");
2067 }
2068 const std::vector<MatrixXd> diag = ringDiagonal(beadHessians, c, false);
2069 // Lifted by the spring, as the rate lifts it: a unit lift would leave
2070 // ln|1 + lambda_0| in det', a unit-dependent amount.
2071 const WoodburyRing ring(c, diag, true, {tau}, {c}, true);
2072 if (!ring.ok()) {
2073 throw std::runtime_error("ringSpectrum: singular ring");
2074 }
2075 RingSpectrum out;
2076 out.zeroEigenvalue = dot(tau, applyDiagonal(diag, c, true, tau));
2077 out.logDetPrime =
2078 ring.logAbsDet() - std::log(std::abs(c + out.zeroEigenvalue));
2079 out.negativeModes = ring.negative();
2080 return out;
2081}
2082
2083double cyclicRingLogAbsDet(double c, const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag) {
2084 requireCyclicBlocks(c, diag, "cyclicRingLogAbsDet");
2085 return CyclicFactor(c, diag).logAbs;
2086}
2087
2088std::vector<VectorXd> cyclicRingSolve(double c,
2089 const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag,
2090 const std::vector<VectorXd> &rhs) {
2091 requireCyclicBlocks(c, diag, "cyclicRingSolve");
2092 if (static_cast<long>(rhs.size()) != static_cast<long>(diag.size())) {
2093 throw std::invalid_argument(
2094 "cyclicRingSolve: one right-hand side per bead");
2095 }
2096 for (const auto &row : rhs) {
2097 if (row.size() != diag.front().rows()) {
2098 throw std::invalid_argument(
2099 "cyclicRingSolve: the right-hand side does not match the blocks");
2100 }
2101 }
2102 return CyclicFactor(c, diag).solve(rhs);
2103}
2104
2105namespace {
2106
2107// Central difference of dV/dq. One batch of 2 f displaced beads.
2108MatrixXd fdPhysicalHessian(const VectorXd &q, const BatchPotential &potential,
2109 double eps) {
2110 const long f = q.size();
2111 std::vector<VectorXd> pts;
2112 pts.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(2 * f));
2113 for (long a = 0; a < f; ++a) {
2114 VectorXd qp = q;
2115 VectorXd qm = q;
2116 qp[a] += eps;
2117 qm[a] -= eps;
2118 pts.push_back(std::move(qp));
2119 pts.push_back(std::move(qm));
2120 }
2121 std::vector<double> v;
2122 std::vector<VectorXd> g;
2123 potential(pts, v, g);
2124 if (static_cast<long>(g.size()) != 2 * f) {
2125 throw std::runtime_error(
2126 "rate instanton: the Hessian sample returned the wrong count");
2127 }
2128 MatrixXd h(f, f);
2129 for (long a = 0; a < f; ++a) {
2130 h.col(a) =
2131 (g[static_cast<size_t>(2 * a)] - g[static_cast<size_t>(2 * a + 1)]) /
2132 (2.0 * eps);
2133 }
2134 return (0.5 * (h + h.transpose())).eval();
2135}
2136
2137// Bofill mix of Powell's symmetric Broyden and SR1. H is d2V/dq2.
2138void bofillUpdate(MatrixXd &h, const VectorXd &dq, const VectorXd &dg) {
2139 const double dq2 = dq.squaredNorm();
2140 if (!(dq2 > 1e-24)) {
2141 return;
2142 }
2143 const VectorXd r = dg - h * dq;
2144 const double rq = r.dot(dq);
2145 const double r2 = r.squaredNorm();
2146 const double phi = r2 * dq2 > 1e-30 ? (rq * rq) / (r2 * dq2) : 0.0;
2147 const double inv = 1.0 / dq2;
2148 h.noalias() += (1.0 - phi) * inv *
2149 (r * dq.transpose() + dq * r.transpose() -
2150 (rq * inv) * (dq * dq.transpose()));
2151 if (std::abs(rq) > 1e-12 * std::sqrt(std::max(0.0, r2 * dq2))) {
2152 h.noalias() += (phi / rq) * (r * r.transpose());
2153 }
2154 h = (0.5 * (h + h.transpose())).eval();
2155}
2156
2157// Eigenvalues below -1e-6 of the largest |lambda|. Rigid-body directions
2158// sit at zero to round-off, and their sign carries no curvature; counting
2159// it would make the allowed count, and with it the update below, depend on
2160// noise in the last digits of the geometry.
2161long clearlyNegative(const VectorXd &lam) {
2162 if (lam.size() == 0) {
2163 return 0;
2164 }
2165 const double span = lam.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
2166 return (lam.array() < -1e-6 * span).count();
2167}
2168
2169long negativeEigenvalues(const MatrixXd &h) {
2170 const ColMajorXd sym = 0.5 * (h + h.transpose());
2171 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(sym,
2172 Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
2173 return clearlyNegative(es.eigenvalues());
2174}
2175
2176// A Bofill update that keeps the block's count of negative curvatures at
2177// `allowed`, the count the last exact (finite-difference) block had. A
2178// secant pair carries curvature along one direction only; on a block of
2179// many coordinates with noisy gradient differences it can open new
2180// negative directions the surface does not have, and those then steer the
2181// ring's index-1 step. Extra negative eigenvalues, the least negative
2182// first, are mirrored to |lambda|. A negative `allowed` leaves the update
2183// alone.
2184void inertiaKeepingUpdate(MatrixXd &h, const VectorXd &dq, const VectorXd &dg,
2185 long allowed) {
2186 bofillUpdate(h, dq, dg);
2187 if (allowed < 0) {
2188 return;
2189 }
2190 const ColMajorXd sym = 0.5 * (h + h.transpose());
2191 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(sym);
2192 const VectorXd lam = es.eigenvalues();
2193 const long negative = clearlyNegative(lam);
2194 if (negative <= allowed) {
2195 return;
2196 }
2197 VectorXd fixed = lam;
2198 // Ascending order: indices allowed .. negative - 1 are the extra ones.
2199 for (long i = allowed; i < negative; ++i) {
2200 fixed(i) = std::abs(lam(i));
2201 }
2202 h = es.eigenvectors() * fixed.asDiagonal() * es.eigenvectors().transpose();
2203}
2204
2205VectorXd packBeads(const std::vector<VectorXd> &x) {
2206 const long f = x.front().size();
2207 VectorXd flat(static_cast<long>(x.size()) * f);
2208 for (long j = 0; j < static_cast<long>(x.size()); ++j) {
2209 flat.segment(j * f, f) = x[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2210 }
2211 return flat;
2212}
2213
2214void addPacked(std::vector<VectorXd> &x, const VectorXd &step) {
2215 const long f = x.front().size();
2216 for (long j = 0; j < static_cast<long>(x.size()); ++j) {
2217 x[static_cast<size_t>(j)] += step.segment(j * f, f);
2218 }
2219}
2220
2221double packedBeadNorm(const VectorXd &step, long f) {
2222 double big = 0.0;
2223 const long n = step.size() / f;
2224 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
2225 big = std::max(big, step.segment(j * f, f).norm());
2226 }
2227 return big;
2228}
2229
2230bool finiteBeads(const std::vector<VectorXd> &x) {
2231 for (const auto &q : x) {
2232 if (!q.array().isFinite().all()) {
2233 return false;
2234 }
2235 }
2236 return true;
2237}
2238
2239// Bead velocity times beta_N hbar: (q_{j+1} - q_{j-1}) / 2 on a uniform
2240// ring, the three-point derivative over the two time steps under link
2241// weights.
2242std::vector<VectorXd> beadVelocities(const std::vector<VectorXd> &x,
2243 const std::vector<double> *weight) {
2244 const size_t n = x.size();
2245 const bool weighted = weight != nullptr && !weight->empty();
2246 std::vector<VectorXd> out(n);
2247 for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
2248 const size_t prev = (j + n - 1) % n;
2249 const size_t next = (j + 1) % n;
2250 if (!weighted) {
2251 out[j] = 0.5 * (x[next] - x[prev]);
2252 } else {
2253 const double a = (*weight)[prev];
2254 const double b = (*weight)[j];
2255 out[j] = (a * a * (x[next] - x[j]) + b * b * (x[j] - x[prev])) /
2256 (a * b * (a + b));
2257 }
2258 }
2259 return out;
2260}
2261
2262// Normalised bead velocity. Empty when the beads coincide.
2263VectorXd timeTranslation(const std::vector<VectorXd> &x,
2264 const std::vector<double> *weight = nullptr) {
2265 const long n = static_cast<long>(x.size());
2266 const long f = x.front().size();
2267 const std::vector<VectorXd> vel = beadVelocities(x, weight);
2268 VectorXd tau(n * f);
2269 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
2270 tau.segment(j * f, f) = vel[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2271 }
2272 const double nrm = tau.norm();
2273 if (!(nrm > 0.0)) {
2274 return VectorXd();
2275 }
2276 tau /= nrm;
2277 return tau;
2278}
2279
2280// B_N, sum_j |q_{j+1} - q_j|^2: the squared speed of the ring's time shift
2281// times (beta_N hbar)^2. Link j of a weighted ring lasts w_j, so its
2282// velocity is the difference over w_j.
2283double ringSpeed(const std::vector<VectorXd> &x,
2284 const std::vector<double> &weight) {
2285 if (!weight.empty() && weight.size() != x.size()) {
2286 throw std::invalid_argument(
2287 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
2288 }
2289 double b = 0.0;
2290 for (size_t j = 0; j < x.size(); ++j) {
2291 const double d = (x[(j + 1) % x.size()] - x[j]).squaredNorm();
2292 b += weight.empty() ? d : d / (weight[j] * weight[j]);
2293 }
2294 return b;
2295}
2296
2297struct Climb {
2298 long index = -1;
2299 double curvature = 0.0;
2300 long negative = 0;
2301};
2302
2303// Cosine between the turning points, opened by (1 - T / Tc) of the lower
2304// barrier, over each bead's imaginary time. The far turning point sits on
2305// bead 0.
2306std::vector<VectorXd> cosineSeed(const VectorXd &saddle, const VectorXd &dir,
2307 double lambda0, double temperature,
2308 double crossover, long nBeads,
2309 const BatchPotential &potential,
2310 const std::vector<double> &weight = {}) {
2311 if (!weight.empty() && static_cast<long>(weight.size()) != nBeads) {
2312 throw std::invalid_argument(
2313 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
2314 }
2315 std::vector<double> v0;
2316 std::vector<VectorXd> g0;
2317 potential({saddle}, v0, g0);
2318 const double vS = v0.at(0);
2319 const double h = 0.25 * std::sqrt(2.0 * kBoltzmann * crossover / -lambda0);
2320 const long pts = 200;
2321 const double dPlus = sideDrop(saddle, dir, vS, 1.0, h, pts, potential);
2322 const double dMinus = sideDrop(saddle, dir, vS, -1.0, h, pts, potential);
2323 const double dMin = std::min(dPlus, dMinus);
2324 const double drop = (1.0 - temperature / crossover) *
2325 (dMin > 0.0 ? dMin : kBoltzmann * crossover);
2326 const double sPlus =
2327 turningDistance(saddle, dir, vS, drop, 1.0, h, pts, potential);
2328 const double sMinus =
2329 turningDistance(saddle, dir, vS, drop, -1.0, h, pts, potential);
2330 std::vector<VectorXd> guess(static_cast<size_t>(nBeads));
2331 double time = 0.0;
2332 for (long j = 0; j < nBeads; ++j) {
2333 const double ct =
2334 std::cos(2.0 * std::numbers::pi * time / static_cast<double>(nBeads));
2335 guess[static_cast<size_t>(j)] =
2336 saddle + dir * (ct >= 0.0 ? sPlus * ct : sMinus * ct);
2337 time += weight.empty() ? 1.0 : weight[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2338 }
2339 return guess;
2340}
2341
2342// Index-1 Newton step through the block chain: a negative climb eigenvalue
2343// stays and a raw Newton step climbs it; a positive one is flipped, as is
2344// every other negative Ritz value off the cycle; a tiny one is parked at a
2345// spring-sized curvature. The cycle keeps its component of the step, on its
2346// own curvature, and is lifted to a spring-sized one only while that
2347// curvature is near zero; the rigid modes are projected out. Each flip is a
2348// rank-one term in the Woodbury correction, so the solve stays O(N f^3).
2349VectorXd chainIndexOneStep(const std::vector<RingMode> &ritz,
2350 const Climb &climb,
2351 const std::vector<MatrixXd> &diag, double spring,
2352 bool closed, const std::vector<VectorXd> &grad,
2353 const VectorXd &tau,
2354 const std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> &nullRing,
2355 const std::vector<double> *weight = nullptr,
2356 const std::vector<double> &eta = {},
2357 const MatrixXd &physicalBathHessian = MatrixXd()) {
2358 if (climb.index < 0 || ritz.empty() || grad.empty()) {
2359 return VectorXd();
2360 }
2361 const long f = grad.front().size();
2362 const long dim = static_cast<long>(grad.size()) * f;
2363 const double cut = -1e-8 * std::max(1.0, spring);
2364 const double tiny = 1e-8 * std::max(1.0, spring);
2365 const double parked = std::max(1.0, spring);
2366 std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> extras;
2367 std::vector<double> kappas;
2368 std::vector<VectorXd> tauRing;
2369 if (tau.size() == dim) {
2370 tauRing.assign(grad.size(), VectorXd::Zero(f));
2371 for (size_t j = 0; j < grad.size(); ++j) {
2372 tauRing[j] = tau.segment(static_cast<long>(j) * f, f);
2373 }
2374 // On a discrete ring the time shift has a small curvature of its own,
2375 // and the stationary ring is where Newton on that curvature leads; the
2376 // lift is only for a cycle too flat to solve with.
2377 double cycleCurvature = 0.0;
2378 for (const auto &m : ritz) {
2379 if (std::abs(dot(m.vector, tauRing)) > 0.5) {
2380 cycleCurvature = m.theta;
2381 break;
2382 }
2383 }
2384 if (std::abs(cycleCurvature) <= 1e-6 * std::max(1.0, spring)) {
2385 extras.push_back(tauRing);
2386 kappas.push_back(spring);
2387 }
2388 }
2389 // The rigid ring motions are lifted like the cycle.
2390 auto onNull = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &m) {
2391 for (const auto &r : nullRing) {
2392 if (std::abs(dot(m, r)) > 0.5) {
2393 return true;
2394 }
2395 }
2396 return false;
2397 };
2398 for (const auto &r : nullRing) {
2399 extras.push_back(r);
2400 kappas.push_back(spring);
2401 }
2402 for (size_t i = 0; i < ritz.size(); ++i) {
2403 if (!tauRing.empty() && std::abs(dot(ritz[i].vector, tauRing)) > 0.5) {
2404 continue;
2405 }
2406 if (onNull(ritz[i].vector)) {
2407 continue;
2408 }
2409 const double li = ritz[i].theta;
2410 const bool isClimb = static_cast<long>(i) == climb.index;
2411 if ((isClimb && li > 0.0) || (!isClimb && li < cut)) {
2412 extras.push_back(ritz[i].vector);
2413 kappas.push_back(-2.0 * li);
2414 } else if (!isClimb && std::abs(li) <= tiny) {
2415 extras.push_back(ritz[i].vector);
2416 kappas.push_back(parked - li);
2417 }
2418 }
2419 std::vector<VectorXd> rhs = grad;
2420 scale(rhs, -1.0);
2421 // The operator the step solves with: the ring plus every rank-one term.
2422 auto applyShifted = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &x) {
2423 std::vector<VectorXd> out = applyDiagonal(diag, spring, closed, x, weight);
2424 if (physicalBathHessian.size()) {
2425 const VectorXd added = physicalBathHessian * packBeads(x);
2426 for (size_t j = 0; j < out.size(); ++j)
2427 out[j] += added.segment(j * f, f);
2428 }
2429 if (!eta.empty()) {
2430 double energy = 0.0;
2431 addFrictionBath(x, energy, out, eta);
2432 }
2433 for (size_t i = 0; i < extras.size(); ++i) {
2434 const double w = kappas[i] * dot(extras[i], x);
2435 for (size_t j = 0; j < out.size(); ++j) {
2436 out[j] += w * extras[i][j];
2437 }
2438 }
2439 return out;
2440 };
2441 const double rhsNorm = std::sqrt(dot(rhs, rhs));
2442 std::vector<VectorXd> stepRing;
2443 bool solved = false;
2444 try {
2445 if (dim <= kDenseRing || !eta.empty() || physicalBathHessian.size()) {
2446 throw std::runtime_error("dense ring or nonlocal bath: dense solve");
2447 }
2448 const WoodburyRing ring(spring, diag, closed, extras, kappas, false,
2449 weight);
2450 if (ring.ok()) {
2451 stepRing = ring.solve(rhs);
2452 // Cutting the ring open can leave a Schur pivot near zero next to
2453 // the barrier, and the Woodbury solve then loses digits; iterative
2454 // refinement against the exact operator recovers them.
2455 for (int pass = 0; pass < 4; ++pass) {
2456 std::vector<VectorXd> r = applyShifted(stepRing);
2457 for (size_t j = 0; j < r.size(); ++j) {
2458 r[j] = rhs[j] - r[j];
2459 }
2460 const double rn = std::sqrt(dot(r, r));
2461 if (!std::isfinite(rn)) {
2462 break;
2463 }
2464 if (rn <= 1e-10 * std::max(1.0, rhsNorm)) {
2465 solved = true;
2466 break;
2467 }
2468 const std::vector<VectorXd> dx = ring.solve(r);
2469 for (size_t j = 0; j < stepRing.size(); ++j) {
2470 stepRing[j] += dx[j];
2471 }
2472 }
2473 }
2474 } catch (const std::runtime_error &) {
2475 solved = false;
2476 }
2477 if (!solved && dim <= kDenseRing) {
2478 // A small ring is cheap to solve densely when the chain cannot.
2479 const long n = static_cast<long>(grad.size());
2480 ColMajorXd jt = ColMajorXd::Zero(dim, dim);
2481 for (long col = 0; col < dim; ++col) {
2482 std::vector<VectorXd> e(static_cast<size_t>(n), VectorXd::Zero(f));
2483 e[static_cast<size_t>(col / f)](col % f) = 1.0;
2484 jt.col(col) = packBeads(applyShifted(e));
2485 }
2486 const Eigen::PartialPivLU<ColMajorXd> lu(jt);
2487 const VectorXd x = lu.solve(packBeads(rhs));
2488 stepRing.assign(static_cast<size_t>(n), VectorXd::Zero(f));
2489 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
2490 stepRing[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = x.segment(j * f, f);
2491 }
2492 solved = x.array().isFinite().all();
2493 }
2494 if (!solved && stepRing.empty()) {
2495 return VectorXd();
2496 }
2497 // The cycle component stays: a gradient along it has to be stepped out.
2498 VectorXd step = packBeads(stepRing);
2499 for (const auto &r : nullRing) {
2500 const VectorXd rf = packBeads(r);
2501 if (rf.size() == step.size()) {
2502 step -= step.dot(rf) * rf;
2503 }
2504 }
2505 if (!step.array().isFinite().all()) {
2506 return VectorXd();
2507 }
2508 return step;
2509}
2510
2511// Non-increasing isotonic regression (pool adjacent violators).
2512std::vector<double> pavaNonIncreasing(const std::vector<double> &values) {
2513 const long n = static_cast<long>(values.size());
2514 struct Block {
2515 long start;
2516 long end;
2517 double average;
2518 double weight;
2519 };
2520 std::vector<Block> blocks;
2521 blocks.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(n));
2522 for (long i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
2523 blocks.push_back(Block{i, i, -values[static_cast<size_t>(i)], 1.0});
2524 while (blocks.size() >= 2 &&
2525 blocks[blocks.size() - 2].average > blocks.back().average) {
2526 const Block b = blocks.back();
2527 blocks.pop_back();
2528 Block &a = blocks.back();
2529 const double w = a.weight + b.weight;
2530 a.average = (a.average * a.weight + b.average * b.weight) / w;
2531 a.end = b.end;
2532 a.weight = w;
2533 }
2534 }
2535 std::vector<double> out(static_cast<size_t>(n));
2536 for (const Block &b : blocks) {
2537 for (long i = b.start; i <= b.end; ++i) {
2538 out[static_cast<size_t>(i)] = -b.average;
2539 }
2540 }
2541 return out;
2542}
2543
2544// Beads 0..last move along the unit vector dir until that coordinate is
2545// monotone.
2546// The sense follows the two ends, so an arbitrary eigenvector sign is harmless.
2547void projectMonotonePrefix(std::vector<VectorXd> &q, long last,
2548 const VectorXd &dir) {
2549 if (last < 1 || q.empty() || dir.size() != q.front().size()) {
2550 return;
2551 }
2552 const long m = last;
2553 std::vector<double> s(static_cast<size_t>(m + 1));
2554 for (long j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
2555 s[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = dir.dot(q[static_cast<size_t>(j)]);
2556 }
2557 std::vector<double> target;
2558 if (s.front() >= s.back()) {
2559 target = pavaNonIncreasing(s);
2560 } else {
2561 std::vector<double> flipped(s.size());
2562 for (size_t j = 0; j < s.size(); ++j) {
2563 flipped[j] = -s[j];
2564 }
2565 target = pavaNonIncreasing(flipped);
2566 for (double &v : target) {
2567 v = -v;
2568 }
2569 }
2570 for (long j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
2571 q[static_cast<size_t>(j)] +=
2572 (target[static_cast<size_t>(j)] - s[static_cast<size_t>(j)]) * dir;
2573 }
2574}
2575
2582std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>>
2583ringRigidBasis(const std::vector<VectorXd> &q,
2584 const std::vector<double> &sqrtMasses, const VectorXd &reference,
2585 const std::array<bool, 3> &rotations) {
2586 std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> out;
2587 const long nAtoms = static_cast<long>(sqrtMasses.size());
2588 if (nAtoms == 0 || q.empty() || reference.size() != 3 * nAtoms ||
2589 q.front().size() != 3 * nAtoms) {
2590 return out;
2591 }
2592 const long nb = static_cast<long>(q.size());
2593 // Cartesian positions and the ring's centre of mass.
2594 Eigen::Vector3d centre = Eigen::Vector3d::Zero();
2595 double total = 0.0;
2596 for (long j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {
2597 for (long k = 0; k < nAtoms; ++k) {
2598 const double sm = sqrtMasses[static_cast<size_t>(k)];
2599 const Eigen::Vector3d r =
2600 reference.segment<3>(3 * k) +
2601 q[static_cast<size_t>(j)].segment<3>(3 * k) / sm;
2602 centre += sm * sm * r;
2603 total += sm * sm;
2604 }
2605 }
2606 centre /= total;
2607 std::vector<int> kinds{0, 1, 2};
2608 for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
2609 if (rotations[static_cast<size_t>(c)]) {
2610 kinds.push_back(3 + c);
2611 }
2612 }
2613 const long dim = nb * 3 * nAtoms;
2614 MatrixXd g = MatrixXd::Zero(dim, static_cast<long>(kinds.size()));
2615 for (size_t col = 0; col < kinds.size(); ++col) {
2616 const int kind = kinds[col];
2617 for (long j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {
2618 for (long k = 0; k < nAtoms; ++k) {
2619 const double sm = sqrtMasses[static_cast<size_t>(k)];
2620 Eigen::Vector3d d = Eigen::Vector3d::Zero();
2621 if (kind < 3) {
2622 d(kind) = sm;
2623 } else {
2624 const Eigen::Vector3d r =
2625 reference.segment<3>(3 * k) +
2626 q[static_cast<size_t>(j)].segment<3>(3 * k) / sm;
2627 Eigen::Vector3d e = Eigen::Vector3d::Zero();
2628 e(kind - 3) = 1.0;
2629 d = sm * e.cross(r - centre);
2630 }
2631 g.block(j * 3 * nAtoms + 3 * k, static_cast<long>(col), 3, 1) = d;
2632 }
2633 }
2634 }
2635 // Unit columns and a relative cut, so that translations and rotations
2636 // compete as directions. A rotation about the axis of a ring that is
2637 // straight to round-off has a generator of round-off size; it is no
2638 // rigid motion and must not be scaled up into one.
2639 ColMajorXd gc(dim, g.cols());
2640 long kept = 0;
2641 const double largest = g.colwise().norm().maxCoeff();
2642 for (long col = 0; col < g.cols(); ++col) {
2643 const double norm = g.col(col).norm();
2644 if (norm > 1e-8 * largest) {
2645 gc.col(kept++) = g.col(col) / norm;
2646 }
2647 }
2648 if (kept == 0) {
2649 return out;
2650 }
2651 Eigen::ColPivHouseholderQR<ColMajorXd> qr(gc.leftCols(kept));
2652 qr.setThreshold(1e-8);
2653 const long rank = qr.rank();
2654 const ColMajorXd basis = qr.householderQ() * ColMajorXd::Identity(dim, rank);
2655 for (long r = 0; r < rank; ++r) {
2656 std::vector<VectorXd> u(static_cast<size_t>(nb));
2657 for (long j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {
2658 u[static_cast<size_t>(j)] =
2659 basis.col(r).segment(j * 3 * nAtoms, 3 * nAtoms);
2660 }
2661 out.push_back(std::move(u));
2662 }
2663 return out;
2664}
2665
2666struct NewtonOut {
2667 std::vector<VectorXd> beads;
2668 std::vector<double> energies;
2669 double ringPotential = 0.0;
2670 double bN = 0.0;
2671 long iterations = 0;
2672 bool converged = false;
2673 // Half ring, stationary, and not index 1. The odd-mode probe decides
2674 // whether the search continues on the whole ring.
2675 bool stalledHalf = false;
2676 // The beads fell together: B_N dropped below collapseFraction of the
2677 // starting ring, so the search left the bounce for a stationary point of
2678 // V.
2679 bool collapsed = false;
2680};
2681
2682// Index-1 Newton on one ring. `x` holds N beads. A half ring optimises beads
2683// 0..N/2 and mirrors them. Trust is the largest bead displacement.
2684NewtonOut newtonInstanton(std::vector<VectorXd> guess, double c,
2685 const MatrixXd &hessSaddle,
2686 const RateInstantonOptions &options,
2687 const BatchPotential &potential) {
2688 const long nBeads = options.beads;
2689 // Fold only an even ring that already matches under j -> N - j. An empty
2690 // guess is seeded into that shape before this call.
2691 // The folded Newton objective contains no bath term. Friction uses the
2692 // full objective so its energy and residual include the requested bath.
2693 // Link weights keep the whole ring.
2694 bool half = options.halfRing && options.discretization.empty() &&
2695 !options.friction && !options.physicalBath && nBeads % 2 == 0 &&
2696 static_cast<long>(guess.size()) == nBeads;
2697 if (half) {
2698 const long m = nBeads / 2;
2699 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
2700 if ((guess[static_cast<size_t>(j)] -
2701 guess[static_cast<size_t>(nBeads - j)])
2702 .norm() > 1e-8) {
2703 half = false;
2704 break;
2705 }
2706 }
2707 }
2708 if (half && !options.discretization.empty()) {
2709 throw std::invalid_argument("link weights need the full ring; a half ring "
2710 "keeps the uniform spring");
2711 }
2712 const std::vector<double> *linkWeight =
2713 options.discretization.empty() ? nullptr : &options.discretization;
2714 std::vector<VectorXd> x;
2715 if (half) {
2716 const long m = nBeads / 2;
2717 x.resize(static_cast<size_t>(m + 1));
2718 for (long j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
2719 x[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = guess[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2720 }
2721 } else {
2722 x = std::move(guess);
2723 }
2724 const long f = x.front().size();
2725 const std::vector<double> eta = frictionEta(options, x.size());
2726 const MatrixXd hS = (0.5 * (hessSaddle + hessSaddle.transpose())).eval();
2727 // The rigid quotient: translations and free rotations of the whole ring
2728 // about its centre of mass, from the current beads, orthonormalised.
2729 const long nAtoms = static_cast<long>(options.rigidSqrtMasses.size());
2730 const bool quotient = nAtoms > 0 && 3 * nAtoms == hS.rows() &&
2731 options.rigidReference.size() == 3 * nAtoms;
2732 auto ringRigid = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &q) {
2733 if (!quotient) {
2734 return std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>>{};
2735 }
2736 return ringRigidBasis(q, options.rigidSqrtMasses, options.rigidReference,
2737 options.rigidRotations);
2738 };
2739 std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> nullRing;
2740 // A one-dimensional well is already the saddle curvature. In more
2741 // dimensions the turning points are not the saddle, so each bead starts
2742 // from its own curvature and the Bofill update carries it.
2743 std::vector<MatrixXd> physical;
2744 const auto beadPotential =
2745 ownedEvaluation(potential, options, 0, static_cast<long>(x.size()));
2746 const auto derivativePotential =
2747 ownedEvaluation(potential, options, potential_owner::derivative);
2748 auto physicalAt = [&](const VectorXd &q) -> MatrixXd {
2749 if (!options.physicalHessian)
2750 return fdPhysicalHessian(q, derivativePotential,
2751 options.physicalHessianStep);
2752 const MatrixXd h = options.physicalHessian(q);
2753 if (h.rows() != f || h.cols() != f || !h.allFinite() ||
2754 !h.isApprox(h.transpose(), 1e-12))
2755 throw std::invalid_argument(
2756 "rate instanton: invalid analytic physical Hessian");
2757 return h;
2758 };
2759 if (options.physicalHessian) {
2760 physical.resize(x.size());
2761 for (size_t j = 0; j < x.size(); ++j)
2762 physical[j] = physicalAt(x[j]);
2763 } else if (f == 1 || options.initialHessians != "finite_difference") {
2764 physical.assign(x.size(), hS);
2765 } else {
2766 physical.resize(x.size());
2767 for (size_t j = 0; j < x.size(); ++j) {
2768 physical[j] = physicalAt(x[j]);
2769 }
2770 }
2771 // Negative curvatures each bead block may carry between exact rebuilds.
2772 std::vector<long> allowedNegatives(x.size(), -1);
2773 auto recountNegatives = [&]() {
2774 if (f == 1) {
2775 return;
2776 }
2777 for (size_t j = 0; j < x.size(); ++j) {
2778 allowedNegatives[j] = negativeEigenvalues(physical[j]);
2779 }
2780 };
2781 recountNegatives();

2783 struct Obj {
2784 std::vector<VectorXd> grad;
2785 std::vector<VectorXd> gradPot;
2786 std::vector<double> energies;
2787 double u = 0.0;
2788 };
2789 auto objective = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &q) {
2790 Obj out;
2791 if (half) {
2792 // The potential is evaluated on beads 0..N/2. The closed ring is that
2793 // chain plus its mirror, and the folded gradient is half the derivative
2794 // of the closed-ring energy.
2795 const long m = static_cast<long>(q.size()) - 1;
2796 const long n = 2 * m;
2797 std::vector<double> vu;
2798 std::vector<VectorXd> gu;
2799 beadPotential(q, vu, gu);
2800 for (double &vj : vu) {
2801 vj -= options.energyShift;
2802 }
2803 if (vu.size() != q.size() || gu.size() != q.size()) {
2804 throw std::runtime_error(
2805 "rate instanton: potential returned the wrong count");
2806 }
2807 std::vector<VectorXd> full(static_cast<size_t>(n));
2808 std::vector<double> vFull(static_cast<size_t>(n));
2809 std::vector<VectorXd> gFull(static_cast<size_t>(n));
2810 for (long j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
2811 full[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = q[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2812 vFull[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = vu[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2813 gFull[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = gu[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2814 }
2815 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
2816 full[static_cast<size_t>(n - j)] = q[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2817 vFull[static_cast<size_t>(n - j)] = vu[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2818 gFull[static_cast<size_t>(n - j)] = gu[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2819 }
2820 std::vector<VectorXd> gRing(static_cast<size_t>(n));
2821 double uFull = 0.0;
2822 double springE = 0.0;
2823 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
2824 const long prev = (j + n - 1) % n;
2825 const long next = (j + 1) % n;
2826 gRing[static_cast<size_t>(j)] =
2827 gFull[static_cast<size_t>(j)] +
2828 c * (2.0 * full[static_cast<size_t>(j)] -
2829 full[static_cast<size_t>(prev)] -
2830 full[static_cast<size_t>(next)]);
2831 springE +=
2832 (full[static_cast<size_t>(next)] - full[static_cast<size_t>(j)])
2833 .squaredNorm();
2834 uFull += vFull[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
2835 }
2836 uFull += 0.5 * c * springE;
2837 out.u = 0.5 * uFull;
2838 out.grad.resize(q.size());
2839 out.grad.front() = 0.5 * gRing.front();
2840 out.grad.back() = 0.5 * gRing[static_cast<size_t>(m)];
2841 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
2842 out.grad[static_cast<size_t>(j)] =
2843 0.5 *
2844 (gRing[static_cast<size_t>(j)] + gRing[static_cast<size_t>(n - j)]);
2845 }
2846 out.gradPot = std::move(gu);
2847 out.energies = std::move(vu);
2848 } else {
2849 const RingEval ev =
2850 evaluateRing(q, c, beadPotential, options.energyShift,
2851 frictionEta(options, q.size()), options.discretization,
2852 options.physicalBath);
2853 out.u = ev.u;
2854 out.grad = ev.grad;
2855 out.gradPot = ev.physicalGrad;
2856 out.energies = ev.v;
2857 }
2858 return out;
2859 };

2861 struct View {

2870 // Turning-point blocks store half the closed-ring derivative. The

2900 {
2901 const double n0 = std::sqrt(dot(track, track));

2905 }

2924 return value == eta.front();
2925 });

2930 auto apply = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &vec) {

2932 applyDiagonal(v.diag, c, !half, vec, linkWeight);
2933 if (v.physicalBathHessian.size()) {

2961 for (long col = 0; col < dim; ++col) {
2962 std::vector<VectorXd> e(static_cast<size_t>(nb), VectorXd::Zero(f));

2985 std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> lift;
2986 std::vector<double> kap;

2990 tauRing[j] = v.tau.segment(static_cast<long>(j) * f, f);

3006 const double resolvedTol = 1e-8 * std::max(1.0, 4.0 * c);
3007 auto resolvedNegatives = [&](const std::vector<RingMode> &modes) {
3008 long count = 0;
3009 for (const auto &m : modes) {
3010 if (m.theta < 0.0 && m.residual <= resolvedTol) {
3011 ++count;
3012 }
3013 }

3020 // pseudo-random admixture reaches every symmetry sector.
3021 std::vector<VectorXd> start = ritzStart;
3022 std::uint64_t h = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;
3023 for (auto &bead : start) {
3024 for (long a2 = 0; a2 < bead.size(); ++a2) {
3025 h ^= h << 13;
3026 h ^= h >> 7;
3027 h ^= h << 17;
3028 bead(a2) += 1e-2 * (static_cast<double>(h >> 11) * 0x1.0p-53 - 0.5);

3039 v.ritz.erase(std::remove_if(v.ritz.begin(), v.ritz.end(),
3040 [](const RingMode &m) {
3041 return m.residual >
3042 1e-6 *
3043 std::max(1.0, std::abs(m.theta));
3044 }),
3045 v.ritz.end());

3051 double minimumWeight = 1.0;
3052 for (double weight : options.discretization) {

3055 double operatorBound = 0.0;
3056 for (const auto &block : v.diag) {

3061 if (!eta.empty()) {

3079 }
3080 auto onCycle = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &m) {

3083 }

3087 }
3088 }

3090 };

3092 long lowest = -1;

3096 }

3100 }
3101 if (v.ritz[i].theta < 0.0 && track.size() == v.ritz[i].vector.size()) {

3105 v.climb.index = static_cast<long>(i);
3106 }
3107 }
3108 }
3109 if (v.climb.index < 0 || best < kTrackOverlap) {
3110 v.climb.index = lowest;
3111 }
3112 if (v.climb.index >= 0) {

3115 if (v.climb.curvature < 0.0) {

3119 }

3122 }
3123 }
3124 }

3126 if (v.climb.index >= 0) {
3127 ritzStart = v.ritz[static_cast<size_t>(v.climb.index)].vector;

3130 if (track.size() == ritzStart.size() && dot(track, track) > 0.0) {

3132 }
3133 }
3134 }
3135 }
3136 return v;
3137 };
3138 auto done = [&](const View &v) {
3139 return v.ok && v.gmax < options.forceTolerance && v.climb.negative == 1 &&
3140 v.climb.curvature < 0.0;
3141 };

3143 Obj cur = objective(x);
3144 double trust = options.maxStep;
3145 long entries = 0;
3146 bool converged = false;
3147 bool analyticPolishAttempted = false;
3148 bool stalledHalf = false;

3160 int driftRefreshes = 0;
3161 // B_N of the closed ring the beads describe.
3162 auto ringLength = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &q) {
3163 double b = 0.0;

3165 for (size_t j = 0; j + 1 < q.size(); ++j) {
3166 b += 2.0 * (q[j + 1] - q[j]).squaredNorm();
3167 }
3168 } else {
3169 for (size_t j = 0; j < q.size(); ++j) {
3170 b += (q[(j + 1) % q.size()] - q[j]).squaredNorm();

3172 }

3179 const double length = ringLength(x);

3182 break;

3195 "{:.3e}, B_N {:.6e}, climb curvature {:.4e}, {} negative, "
3196 "trust {:.3e}",

3237 recountNegatives();
3238 exactAtX = true;
3239 EONC_LOG_DEBUG("[Instanton] Newton {}: {} negative curvatures in the "

3241 it, v.climb.negative);

3250 }

3252 if (!(big > 0.0)) {

3256 addPacked(trial, dir);
3257 if (half) {

3260 }
3261 if (!finiteBeads(trial)) {

3302 const double unresolved = 1e-12 * std::max(1.0, std::abs(cur.u));

3313 double magnitude = std::abs(cur.u);
3314 for (const double vj : cur.energies) {

3316 }
3317 const double roundoff =
3318 1e3 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() * magnitude;

3323 }
3324 }
3325 if (!ratioOk) {
