3327 }
3328 if (polishing && closedGmax(next) > closedGmax(cur))
3329 return false;
3330 if (!options.physicalHessian)
3331 for (size_t k = 0; k < x.size(); ++k) {
3332 inertiaKeepingUpdate(physical[k], trial[k] - x[k],
3333 next.gradPot[k] - cur.gradPot[k],
3334 allowedNegatives[k]);
3335 }
3336 x = std::move(trial);
3337 cur = std::move(next);
3338 exactAtX = static_cast<bool>(options.physicalHessian);
3339 if (ratioOk && ratio > 0.75 && ratio < 1.25 &&
3340 packedBeadNorm(dir, f) >= 0.99 * trust) {
3341 trust = std::min(2.0 * trust, options.maxStep);
3342 }
3343 return true;
3344 };
3345 // A converged gradient is classified with exact bead Hessians, as
3346 // i-PI's hessian_final does: the Bofill blocks can carry negative
3347 // curvatures the surface does not have. A second negative curvature
3348 // that survives the rebuild is a higher-index stationary ring, where
3349 // the flipped Newton step vanishes; a trust-sized displacement down
3350 // that mode leaves it.
3351 if (v.ok && v.gmax < options.forceTolerance && v.climb.negative != 1 &&
3352 !exactAtX) {
3353 for (size_t j = 0; j < x.size(); ++j) {
3354 physical[j] = physicalAt(x[j]);
3355 }
3356 recountNegatives();
3357 exactAtX = true;
3358 continue;
3359 }
3360 if (v.ok && v.gmax < options.forceTolerance && v.climb.negative > 1) {
3361 long down = -1;
3362 for (size_t i = 0; i < v.ritz.size(); ++i) {
3363 const auto &m = v.ritz[i];
3364 if (static_cast<long>(i) == v.climb.index || !(m.theta < 0.0)) {
3365 continue;
3366 }
3367 bool held = false;
3368 if (v.tau.size() == static_cast<long>(x.size()) * f) {
3369 held = std::abs(packBeads(m.vector).dot(v.tau)) > 0.5;
3370 }
3371 for (const auto &r : nullRing) {
3372 held = held || std::abs(dot(m.vector, r)) > 0.5;
3373 }
3374 if (!held &&
3375 (down < 0 || m.theta < v.ritz[static_cast<size_t>(down)].theta)) {
3376 down = static_cast<long>(i);
3377 }
3378 }
3379 if (down >= 0) {
3380 trust = options.maxStep;
3381 // The Ritz vector has unit norm over every bead; scaled so its
3382 // largest bead moves the trust radius, as the Newton step is.
3383 VectorXd mode = packBeads(v.ritz[static_cast<size_t>(down)].vector);
3384 const double big = packedBeadNorm(mode, f);
3385 if (big > 0.0) {
3386 mode *= trust / big;
3387 if (accept(mode) || accept(-mode)) {
3388 continue;
3389 }
3390 }
3391 }
3392 }
3393 // A half ring that is stationary at the wrong index cannot see a mode
3394 // odd under the mirror. Leave it for the odd-mode probe instead of
3395 // spending the remaining iterations on this point.
3396 if (half && options.checkOddSector && exactAtX && v.ok &&
3397 v.gmax < options.forceTolerance && v.climb.negative != 1) {
3398 stalledHalf = true;
3399 break;
3400 }
3401 const VectorXd step =
3402 chainIndexOneStep(v.ritz, v.climb, v.diag, c, !half, cur.grad, v.tau,
3403 nullRing, linkWeight, eta, v.physicalBathHessian);
3404 bool moved = false;
3405 VectorXd dir = step;
3406 // Clip to the trust radius once, then halve that capped step.
3407 if (dir.size() > 0) {
3408 const double big0 = packedBeadNorm(dir, f);
3409 if (big0 > trust) {
3410 dir *= trust / big0;
3411 }
3412 }
3413 for (int bt = 0; bt < 4 && !moved; ++bt) {
3414 moved = accept(dir);
3415 dir *= 0.5;
3416 }
3417 if (!moved) {
3418 if (polishing) {
3419 converged = true;
3420 break;
3421 }
3422 trust = std::max(0.5 * trust, trustFloor);
3423 // At the trust floor the Bofill blocks no longer model the ring and
3424 // every step is refused; rebuild them from finite differences, 2 f
3425 // gradient calls per bead, a few times at most, and start the trust
3426 // region again.
3427 if (trust <= trustFloor && refreshes < kMaxHessianRefreshes) {
3428 ++refreshes;
3429 for (size_t j = 0; j < x.size(); ++j) {
3430 physical[j] = physicalAt(x[j]);
3431 }
3432 recountNegatives();
3433 trust = options.maxStep;
3434 }
3435 }
3436 }
3437 // A budget that ends on a converged gradient still classifies it with
3438 // exact blocks.
3439 if (!converged) {
3440 View last = viewOf(cur);
3441 if (f > 1 && last.ok && last.gmax < options.forceTolerance && !exactAtX) {
3442 const double eps = options.lanczosStep > 0.0 ? options.lanczosStep : 1e-4;
3443 for (size_t j = 0; j < x.size(); ++j) {
3444 physical[j] = fdPhysicalHessian(x[j], potential, eps);
3445 }
3446 last = viewOf(cur);
3447 }
3448 converged = done(last);
3449 }
3450
3451 NewtonOut out;
3452 out.iterations = entries;
3453 out.converged = converged;
3454 out.stalledHalf = stalledHalf;
3455 out.collapsed = collapsed;
3456 if (half) {
3457 const long m = static_cast<long>(x.size()) - 1;
3458 const long n = 2 * m;
3459 out.beads.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n));
3460 out.energies.assign(static_cast<size_t>(n), 0.0);
3461 for (long j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
3462 out.beads[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = x[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3463 out.energies[static_cast<size_t>(j)] =
3464 cur.energies[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3465 }
3466 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
3467 out.beads[static_cast<size_t>(n - j)] = x[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3468 out.energies[static_cast<size_t>(n - j)] =
3469 cur.energies[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3470 }
3471 out.ringPotential = 2.0 * cur.u;
3472 } else {
3473 out.beads = std::move(x);
3474 out.ringPotential = cur.u;
3475 out.energies = std::move(cur.energies);
3476 }
3477 out.bN = ringSpeed(out.beads, options.discretization);
3478 return out;
3479}
3480
3481// A one-dimensional bead carries its own curvature, so the requested
3482// temperature is solved first. Below 0.75 Tc an empty guess that does not
3483// converge walks down from 0.85 Tc, and that walk replaces the first try.
3484RateInstanton optimizeRateByNewton(const VectorXd &saddle,
3485 const MatrixXd &hessSaddle, double beta,
3486 std::vector<VectorXd> guess,
3487 const BatchPotential &potential,
3488 const RateInstantonOptions &options) {
3489 const long nBeads = options.beads;
3490 if (nBeads < 4 || !(beta > 0.0) || hessSaddle.rows() != saddle.size()) {
3491 throw std::invalid_argument(
3492 "optimizeRateInstanton: need N >= 4, beta > 0 and a saddle Hessian "
3493 "of the saddle's dimension");
3494 }
3495 if (!options.discretization.empty() &&
3496 static_cast<long>(options.discretization.size()) != nBeads) {
3497 throw std::invalid_argument(
3498 "link weights must be one positive value per bead");
3499 }
3500 RateInstanton inst;
3501 inst.physicalBath = options.physicalBath;
3502 inst.discretization = options.discretization;
3503 inst.bathEta = frictionEta(options, options.beads);
3504 inst.beta = beta;
3505 inst.betaN = beta / static_cast<double>(nBeads);
3506 inst.temperature = 1.0 / (kBoltzmann * beta);
3507 inst.crossover = crossoverTemperature(
3508 options.physicalBath
3509 ? MatrixXd(options.physicalBath->fullHessian(saddle, hessSaddle))
3510 : hessSaddle);
3511 if (!(inst.temperature < inst.crossover)) {
3512 throw std::invalid_argument(
3513 "optimizeRateInstanton: T is at or above the crossover temperature; "
3514 "the ring collapses onto the saddle and steepest descent needs the "
3515 "parabolic barrier correction, of which classical transition-state "
3516 "theory is only the one-bead limit");
3517 }
3518
3519 const bool cool = static_cast<long>(guess.size()) != nBeads &&
3520 inst.temperature < 0.75 * inst.crossover;
3521 // A half ring cannot see modes odd under j -> N-j, so two copies of the
3522 // instanton are a stationary point it can accept or sit on. An unstable
3523 // odd mode there sends the search onto the whole ring from a kick along
3524 // that mode.
3525 auto probeOddSector = [&](NewtonOut &got, double spring) {
3526 const long nGot = static_cast<long>(got.beads.size());
3527 bool mirrored = (got.converged || got.stalledHalf) && options.halfRing &&
3528 options.discretization.empty() && options.checkOddSector &&
3529 nGot == nBeads && nGot % 2 == 0;
3530 for (long j = 1; mirrored && j < nGot / 2; ++j) {
3531 mirrored = (got.beads[static_cast<size_t>(j)] -
3532 got.beads[static_cast<size_t>(nGot - j)])
3533 .norm() <= 1e-8;
3534 }
3535 if (!mirrored) {
3536 return;
3537 }
3538 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> es0(
3539 0.5 * (hessSaddle + hessSaddle.transpose()));
3540 const double barrierCurvature = std::abs(es0.eigenvalues()(0));
3541 const RingEval here =
3542 evaluateRing(got.beads, spring, potential, options.energyShift,
3543 frictionEta(options, got.beads.size()));
3544 std::vector<VectorXd> oddMode;
3545 const double oddCurv = lowestOddMode(
3546 got.beads, here, spring, potential, oddMode, options.lanczosFirst,
3547 options.lanczosStep, frictionEta(options, got.beads.size()));
3548 if (!(oddCurv < -1e-3 * barrierCurvature) ||
3549 oddMode.size() != got.beads.size()) {
3550 return;
3551 }
3552 std::vector<VectorXd> kicked = got.beads;
3553 const double kick = std::sqrt(2.0 / (inst.betaN * -oddCurv));
3554 for (size_t k = 0; k < kicked.size(); ++k) {
3555 kicked[k] += kick * oddMode[k];
3556 }
3557 RateInstantonOptions whole = options;
3558 whole.halfRing = false;
3559 const long before = got.iterations;
3560 got = newtonInstanton(std::move(kicked), spring, hessSaddle, whole,
3561 potential);
3562 got.iterations += before;
3563 };
3564 // One dimension solves the requested temperature before any walk. A
3565 // higher-dimensional empty guess below 0.75 Tc keeps the walk, which
3566 // starts from a curvature copied off the saddle.
3567 if (saddle.size() == 1 || !cool) {
3568 if (static_cast<long>(guess.size()) != nBeads) {
3569 const ColMajorXd hS = physicalStaticCurvature(
3570 0.5 * (hessSaddle + hessSaddle.transpose()), saddle, options);
3571 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(hS);
3572 guess = cosineSeed(saddle, es.eigenvectors().col(0), es.eigenvalues()(0),
3573 inst.temperature, inst.crossover, nBeads, potential,
3574 options.discretization);
3575 }
3576 const double bnh = inst.betaN * kHbar;
3577 const double spring = 1.0 / (bnh * bnh);
3578 NewtonOut got = newtonInstanton(std::move(guess), spring, hessSaddle,
3579 options, potential);
3580 probeOddSector(got, spring);
3581 inst.beads = got.beads;
3582 inst.energies = got.energies;
3583 inst.ringPotential = got.ringPotential;
3584 inst.bN = got.bN;
3585 inst.iterations = got.iterations;
3586 inst.converged = got.converged;
3587 inst.collapsed = got.collapsed;
3588 if (inst.converged || !cool) {
3589 return inst;
3590 }
3591 }
3592 {
3593 std::vector<double> temps;
3594 for (double t = 0.85 * inst.crossover; t > inst.temperature * 1.05;
3595 t *= 0.75) {
3596 temps.push_back(t);
3597 }
3598 temps.push_back(inst.temperature);
3599 std::vector<VectorXd> beads;
3600 RateInstanton last;
3601 // A one-dimensional first try spent part of the budget already; with
3602 // nothing left it is the answer.
3603 long used = saddle.size() == 1 ? inst.iterations : 0;
3604 if (used >= options.maxIterations) {
3605 return inst;
3606 }
3607 bool targetRan = false;
3608 const ColMajorXd hS = physicalStaticCurvature(
3609 0.5 * (hessSaddle + hessSaddle.transpose()), saddle, options);
3610 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(hS);
3611 for (size_t s = 0; s < temps.size(); ++s) {
3612 const long remain = options.maxIterations - used;
3613 if (remain <= 0) {
3614 break;
3615 }
3616 RateInstantonOptions opt = options;
3617 opt.maxIterations = remain;
3618 const bool target = s + 1 == temps.size();
3619 opt.checkOddSector = options.checkOddSector && target;
3620 const double betaStage = target ? beta : 1.0 / (kBoltzmann * temps[s]);
3621 std::vector<VectorXd> stageGuess = beads;
3622 if (static_cast<long>(stageGuess.size()) != nBeads) {
3623 stageGuess = cosineSeed(saddle, es.eigenvectors().col(0),
3624 es.eigenvalues()(0), temps[s], inst.crossover,
3625 nBeads, potential, options.discretization);
3626 }
3627 last = optimizeRateInstanton(saddle, hessSaddle, betaStage,
3628 std::move(stageGuess), potential, opt);
3629 used += last.iterations;
3630 if (last.collapsed) {
3631 break;
3632 }
3633 beads = last.beads;
3634 if (target) {
3635 targetRan = true;
3636 }
3637 }
3638 last.iterations = used;
3639 if (targetRan) {
3640 last.beta = beta;
3641 last.betaN = beta / static_cast<double>(nBeads);
3642 last.temperature = inst.temperature;
3643 last.crossover = inst.crossover;
3644 } else {
3645 last.converged = false;
3646 }
3647 return last;
3648 }
3649
3650 if (static_cast<long>(guess.size()) != nBeads) {
3651 const ColMajorXd hS = physicalStaticCurvature(
3652 0.5 * (hessSaddle + hessSaddle.transpose()), saddle, options);
3653 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(hS);
3654 guess = cosineSeed(saddle, es.eigenvectors().col(0), es.eigenvalues()(0),
3655 inst.temperature, inst.crossover, nBeads, potential);
3656 }
3657 const double bnh = inst.betaN * kHbar;
3658 const double spring = 1.0 / (bnh * bnh);
3659 NewtonOut got =
3660 newtonInstanton(std::move(guess), spring, hessSaddle, options, potential);
3661 // A half ring cannot see modes odd under j -> N-j, so two copies of the
3662 // instanton are a stationary point it can accept or sit on. An unstable
3663 // odd mode there sends the search onto the whole ring from a kick along
3664 // that mode.
3665 const long nGot = static_cast<long>(got.beads.size());
3666 bool mirrored = (got.converged || got.stalledHalf) && options.halfRing &&
3667 !options.friction && !options.physicalBath &&
3668 options.checkOddSector && nGot == nBeads && nGot % 2 == 0;
3669 for (long j = 1; mirrored && j < nGot / 2; ++j) {
3670 mirrored = (got.beads[static_cast<size_t>(j)] -
3671 got.beads[static_cast<size_t>(nGot - j)])
3672 .norm() <= 1e-8;
3673 }
3674 if (mirrored) {
3675 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> es0(
3676 0.5 * (hessSaddle + hessSaddle.transpose()));
3677 const double barrierCurvature = std::abs(es0.eigenvalues()(0));
3678 const RingEval here =
3679 evaluateRing(got.beads, spring, potential, options.energyShift,
3680 frictionEta(options, got.beads.size()));
3681 std::vector<VectorXd> oddMode;
3682 const double oddCurv =
3683 lowestOddMode(got.beads, here, spring, potential, oddMode,
3684 options.lanczosFirst, options.lanczosStep);
3685 if (oddCurv < -1e-3 * barrierCurvature &&
3686 oddMode.size() == got.beads.size()) {
3687 std::vector<VectorXd> kicked = got.beads;
3688 const double kick = std::sqrt(2.0 / (inst.betaN * -oddCurv));
3689 for (size_t k = 0; k < kicked.size(); ++k) {
3690 kicked[k] += kick * oddMode[k];
3691 }
3692 RateInstantonOptions whole = options;
3693 whole.halfRing = false;
3694 const long before = got.iterations;
3695 got = newtonInstanton(std::move(kicked), spring, hessSaddle, whole,
3696 potential);
3697 got.iterations += before;
3698 }
3699 }
3700 inst.beads = got.beads;
3701 inst.energies = got.energies;
3702 inst.ringPotential = got.ringPotential;
3703 inst.bN = got.bN;
3704 inst.iterations = got.iterations;
3705 inst.converged = got.converged;
3706 inst.collapsed = got.collapsed;
3707 return inst;
3708}
3709
3710} // namespace
3711
3712namespace {
3713
3714struct SearchedRing {
3715 std::vector<VectorXd> beads;
3716 std::vector<double> energies;
3717 double ringPotential = 0.0;
3718 double bN = 0.0;
3719 long iterations = 0;
3720 bool converged = false;
3721};
3722
3723std::vector<VectorXd> activeBeadsOf(const std::vector<VectorXd> &full,
3724 bool fold) {
3725 if (!fold) {
3726 return full;
3727 }
3728 const long m = static_cast<long>(full.size()) / 2;
3729 return std::vector<VectorXd>(full.begin(), full.begin() + (m + 1));
3730}
3731
3732std::vector<VectorXd> expandMirrored(const std::vector<VectorXd> &active,
3733 long nBeads, bool fold) {
3734 if (!fold) {
3735 return active;
3736 }
3737 const long m = nBeads / 2;
3738 std::vector<VectorXd> full(static_cast<size_t>(nBeads));
3739 full[0] = active[0];
3740 full[static_cast<size_t>(m)] = active[static_cast<size_t>(m)];
3741 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
3742 full[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = active[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3743 full[static_cast<size_t>(nBeads - j)] = active[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3744 }
3745 return full;
3746}
3747
3748} // namespace
3749
3750void RingPolymerPotential::fixLayout(long nBeads, long dof, bool fold,
3751 const VectorXd &modeDir) {
3752 if (nBeads < 4 || dof < 1 || modeDir.size() != dof) {
3753 throw std::invalid_argument(
3754 "ring structure: need at least 4 beads and a mode of the bead "
3755 "dimension");
3756 }
3757 if (fold && nBeads % 2 != 0) {
3758 throw std::invalid_argument(
3759 "ring structure: a folded ring needs an even bead count");
3760 }
3761 nBeads_ = nBeads;
3762 dof_ = dof;
3763 fold_ = fold;
3764 nActive_ = fold ? (nBeads / 2 + 1) : nBeads;
3765 atomsPerBead_ = (dof + 2) / 3;
3766 usedOnLast_ = static_cast<int>(dof % 3 == 0 ? 3 : dof % 3);
3767 nAtoms_ = atomsPerBead_ * nActive_;
3768 modeDir_ = modeDir;
3769 const double nrm = modeDir_.norm();
3770 if (!(nrm > 0.0)) {
3771 throw std::invalid_argument("ring structure: the saddle direction is zero");
3772 }
3773 modeDir_ /= nrm;
3774}
3775
3776RingPolymerPotential::RingPolymerPotential(BatchPotential beads, long nBeads,
3777 long dof, double spring,
3778 double energyShift,
3779 std::vector<double> eta, bool fold,
3780 VectorXd modeDir)
3781 : Potential(PotType::UNKNOWN),
3782 beads_(std::move(beads)),
3783 spring_(spring),
3784 energyShift_(energyShift),
3785 eta_(std::move(eta)) {
3786 if (!(spring > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(spring)) {
3787 throw std::invalid_argument(
3788 "ring structure: the spring constant must be positive");
3789 }
3790 fixLayout(nBeads, dof, fold, modeDir);
3791}
3792
3793void RingPolymerPotential::packActive(const std::vector<VectorXd> &active,
3794 double *positions) const {
3795 if (static_cast<long>(active.size()) != nActive_ || positions == nullptr) {
3796 throw std::invalid_argument("ring structure: bead count does not match");
3797 }
3798 std::fill(positions, positions + 3 * nAtoms_, 0.0);
3799 for (long j = 0; j < nActive_; ++j) {
3800 if (active[static_cast<size_t>(j)].size() != dof_) {
3801 throw std::invalid_argument(
3802 "ring structure: bead dimension does not match");
3803 }
3804 long flat = 0;
3805 const double *src = active[static_cast<size_t>(j)].data();
3806 for (long a = 0; a < atomsPerBead_; ++a) {
3807 double *atom = positions + (j * atomsPerBead_ + a) * 3;
3808 const int nax = (a + 1 == atomsPerBead_) ? usedOnLast_ : 3;
3809 for (int ax = 0; ax < nax; ++ax, ++flat) {
3810 atom[ax] = src[flat];
3811 }
3812 }
3813 }
3814}
3815
3816std::vector<VectorXd>
3817RingPolymerPotential::unpack(const double *positions) const {
3818 if (positions == nullptr) {
3819 throw std::invalid_argument("ring structure: missing positions");
3820 }
3821 std::vector<VectorXd> active(static_cast<size_t>(nActive_),
3822 VectorXd::Zero(dof_));
3823 for (long j = 0; j < nActive_; ++j) {
3824 long flat = 0;
3825 for (long a = 0; a < atomsPerBead_; ++a) {
3826 const double *atom = positions + (j * atomsPerBead_ + a) * 3;
3827 const int nax = (a + 1 == atomsPerBead_) ? usedOnLast_ : 3;
3828 for (int ax = 0; ax < nax; ++ax, ++flat) {
3829 active[static_cast<size_t>(j)](flat) = atom[ax];
3830 }
3831 }
3832 }
3833 return active;
3834}
3835
3836void RingPolymerPotential::packMode(const VectorXd &dir,
3837 AtomMatrix &mode) const {
3838 if (mode.rows() != nAtoms_) {
3839 throw std::invalid_argument("ring mode: atom count does not match");
3840 }
3841 std::vector<VectorXd> beads(static_cast<size_t>(nActive_), dir);
3842 packActive(beads, mode.data());
3843 const double nrm = mode.norm();
3844 if (!(nrm > 0.0)) {
3845 throw std::invalid_argument("ring mode: the saddle direction is zero");
3846 }
3847 mode /= nrm;
3848}
3849
3850double RingPolymerPotential::writeForces(const std::vector<VectorXd> &grad,
3851 const double *positions,
3852 double *forces) const {
3853 std::fill(forces, forces + 3 * nAtoms_, 0.0);
3854 for (long j = 0; j < nActive_; ++j) {
3855 long flat = 0;
3856 const double *src = grad[static_cast<size_t>(j)].data();
3857 for (long a = 0; a < atomsPerBead_; ++a) {
3858 double *atom = forces + (j * atomsPerBead_ + a) * 3;
3859 const int nax = (a + 1 == atomsPerBead_) ? usedOnLast_ : 3;
3860 for (int ax = 0; ax < nax; ++ax, ++flat) {
3861 atom[ax] = -src[flat];
3862 }
3863 }
3864 }
3865 double extra = 0.0;
3866 constexpr double kAxis = 1.0e3;
3867 if (usedOnLast_ == 3) {
3868 return extra;
3869 }
3870 for (long j = 0; j < nActive_; ++j) {
3871 const long atom = j * atomsPerBead_ + atomsPerBead_ - 1;
3872 double *frc = forces + atom * 3;
3873 const double *pos = positions + atom * 3;
3874 for (int ax = usedOnLast_; ax < 3; ++ax) {
3875 extra += 0.5 * kAxis * pos[ax] * pos[ax];
3876 frc[ax] = -kAxis * pos[ax];
3877 }
3878 }
3879 return extra;
3880}
3881
3882void RingPolymerPotential::force(long nAtoms, const double *positions,
3883 const int *atomicNrs, double *forces,
3884 double *energy, double *variance,
3885 const double *box) {
3886 const double *pos[] = {positions};
3887 const int *nrs[] = {atomicNrs};
3888 double *frc[] = {forces};
3889 const double *boxes[] = {box};
3890 double var = 0.0;
3891 forceBatch(1, nAtoms, pos, nrs, frc, energy, variance ? &var : &var, boxes);
3892 if (variance) {
3893 *variance = var;
3894 }
3895 forceCallCounter -= 1;
3896}
3897
3898void RingPolymerPotential::forceBatch(long nSystems, long nAtoms,
3899 const double *const *positions,
3900 const int *const *atomicNrs,
3901 double *const *forces, double *energies,
3902 double *variances,
3903 const double *const *boxes) {
3904 static_cast<void>(atomicNrs);
3905 static_cast<void>(boxes);
3906 if (nSystems < 1 || nAtoms != nAtoms_ || positions == nullptr ||
3907 forces == nullptr || energies == nullptr) {
3908 throw std::invalid_argument(
3909 "ring structure: the atom count does not match the bead packing");
3910 }
3911 struct Item {
3912 std::vector<VectorXd> raw;
3913 std::vector<VectorXd> q;
3914 };
3915 std::vector<Item> items(static_cast<size_t>(nSystems));
3916 std::vector<VectorXd> all;
3917 all.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(nSystems * nActive_));
3918 for (long i = 0; i < nSystems; ++i) {
3919 items[static_cast<size_t>(i)].raw = unpack(positions[i]);
3920 items[static_cast<size_t>(i)].q = items[static_cast<size_t>(i)].raw;
3921 if (fold_) {
3922 projectMonotonePrefix(items[static_cast<size_t>(i)].q, nActive_ - 1,
3923 modeDir_);
3924 }
3925 all.insert(all.end(), items[static_cast<size_t>(i)].q.begin(),
3926 items[static_cast<size_t>(i)].q.end());
3927 }
3928 std::vector<double> vAll;
3929 std::vector<VectorXd> gAll;
3930 beads_(all, vAll, gAll);
3931 if (vAll.size() != all.size() || gAll.size() != all.size()) {
3932 throw std::runtime_error(
3933 "ring structure: the bead potential returned the wrong count");
3934 }
3935 size_t cursor = 0;
3936 const double kMono = std::max(4.0 * spring_, 1.0);
3937 for (long i = 0; i < nSystems; ++i) {
3938 const auto &q = items[static_cast<size_t>(i)].q;
3939 const auto &raw = items[static_cast<size_t>(i)].raw;
3940 std::vector<double> vActive(
3941 vAll.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(cursor),
3942 vAll.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(cursor + nActive_));
3943 std::vector<VectorXd> gActive(
3944 gAll.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(cursor),
3945 gAll.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(cursor + nActive_));
3946 cursor += static_cast<size_t>(nActive_);
3947 for (const auto &g : gActive) {
3948 if (g.size() != dof_) {
3949 throw std::runtime_error(
3950 "ring structure: a bead gradient has the wrong dimension");
3951 }
3952 }
3953 std::vector<VectorXd> fullQ = expandMirrored(q, nBeads_, fold_);
3954 std::vector<double> vFull(static_cast<size_t>(nBeads_));
3955 std::vector<VectorXd> gFull(static_cast<size_t>(nBeads_),
3956 VectorXd::Zero(dof_));
3957 if (!fold_) {
3958 vFull = std::move(vActive);
3959 gFull = std::move(gActive);
3960 } else {
3961 const long m = nBeads_ / 2;
3962 vFull[0] = vActive[0];
3963 gFull[0] = gActive[0];
3964 vFull[static_cast<size_t>(m)] = vActive[static_cast<size_t>(m)];
3965 gFull[static_cast<size_t>(m)] = gActive[static_cast<size_t>(m)];
3966 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
3967 vFull[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = vActive[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3968 vFull[static_cast<size_t>(nBeads_ - j)] =
3969 vActive[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3970 gFull[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = gActive[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3971 gFull[static_cast<size_t>(nBeads_ - j)] =
3972 gActive[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
3973 }
3974 }
3975 auto replay = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &, std::vector<double> &v,
3976 std::vector<VectorXd> &g) {
3977 v = vFull;
3978 g = gFull;
3979 };
3980 const RingEval ev = evaluateRing(fullQ, spring_, replay, energyShift_, eta_,
3981 discretization_, physicalBath_);
3982 std::vector<VectorXd> reduced;
3983 if (!fold_) {
3984 reduced = ev.grad;
3985 } else {
3986 const long m = nBeads_ / 2;
3987 reduced.resize(static_cast<size_t>(m + 1));
3988 reduced[0] = ev.grad[0];
3989 reduced[static_cast<size_t>(m)] = ev.grad[static_cast<size_t>(m)];
3990 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
3991 reduced[static_cast<size_t>(j)] =
3992 ev.grad[static_cast<size_t>(j)] +
3993 ev.grad[static_cast<size_t>(nBeads_ - j)];
3994 }
3995 }
3996 double penalty = 0.0;
3997 if (fold_) {
3998 for (long j = 0; j < nActive_; ++j) {
3999 const VectorXd d =
4000 raw[static_cast<size_t>(j)] - q[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
4001 penalty += 0.5 * kMono * d.squaredNorm();
4002 reduced[static_cast<size_t>(j)] += kMono * d;
4003 }
4004 }
4005 const double axis = writeForces(reduced, positions[i], forces[i]);
4006 energies[i] = ev.u + penalty + axis;
4007 if (variances) {
4008 variances[i] = 0.0;
4009 }
4010 forceCallCounter += 1;
4011 }
4012}

4014namespace {
4015
4016SearchedRing oneDimerSearch(const std::vector<VectorXd> &full, double c,
4017 const BatchPotential &potential,
4018 const RateInstantonOptions &options,
4019 const VectorXd &dir, bool fold,
4020 const std::vector<double> &eta) {
4021 auto pot = std::make_shared<RingPolymerPotential>(
4022 ownedEvaluation(potential, options, 0,
4023 fold ? options.beads / 2 + 1 : options.beads),
4024 options.beads, dir.size(), c, options.energyShift, eta, fold, dir);
4025 pot->setDiscretization(options.discretization);
4026 pot->setPhysicalBath(options.physicalBath);
4027 Parameters params;
4028 ParametersLoadAccess::main_options(params).removeNetForce = false;
4029 ParametersLoadAccess::main_options(params).parallel = false;
4030 ParametersLoadAccess::main_options(params).finiteDifference =
4031 options.lanczosStep > 0.0 ? options.lanczosStep : 1.0e-4;
4032 ParametersLoadAccess::optimizer_options(params).method = OptType::CG;
4033 ParametersLoadAccess::optimizer_options(params).max_move = options.maxStep;
4034 ParametersLoadAccess::optimizer_options(params).convergence_metric =
4035 "max_component";
4036 ParametersLoadAccess::optimizer_options(params).converged_force =
4037 options.forceTolerance;
4038 ParametersLoadAccess::saddle_search_options(params).minmode_method =
4039 LowestEigenmode::MINMODE_DIMER;
4040 ParametersLoadAccess::saddle_search_options(params).max_iterations =
4041 options.maxIterations;
4042 ParametersLoadAccess::saddle_search_options(params).converged_force =
4043 options.forceTolerance;
4044 ParametersLoadAccess::saddle_search_options(params).max_energy = 1.0e9;
4045 ParametersLoadAccess::dimer_options(params).improved = true;
4046 ParametersLoadAccess::dimer_options(params).rotation_backend =
4047 DimerRotationBackend::Classical;
4048
4049 auto matter = std::make_shared<Matter>(pot, params);
4050 matter->resize(pot->structureAtoms());
4051 matter->setPeriodic(false);
4052 matter->setMasses(VectorXd::Ones(pot->structureAtoms()));
4053 for (long i = 0; i < pot->structureAtoms(); ++i) {
4054 matter->setAtomicNr(i, 1);
4055 }
4056 const long atomsPer = pot->structureAtoms() / pot->activeBeads();
4057 const int used =
4058 static_cast<int>((dir.size() % 3 == 0) ? 3 : (dir.size() % 3));
4059 if (used < 3) {
4060 for (long j = 0; j < pot->activeBeads(); ++j) {
4061 const long atom = j * atomsPer + atomsPer - 1;
4062 for (int ax = used; ax < 3; ++ax) {
4063 matter->setFixed(atom, ax, 1);
4064 }
4065 }
4066 }
4067 VectorXd packed = VectorXd::Zero(3 * pot->structureAtoms());
4068 pot->packActive(activeBeadsOf(full, fold), packed.data());
4069 matter->setPositionsV(packed);
4070 AtomMatrix mode(pot->structureAtoms(), 3);
4071 pot->packMode(dir, mode);
4072 const double e0 = matter->getPotentialEnergy();
4073 MinModeSaddleSearch search(matter, mode, e0, params, pot);
4074 const int status = search.run(options.maxIterations);
4075
4076 std::vector<VectorXd> beads = expandMirrored(
4077 pot->unpack(matter->getPositions().data()), options.beads, fold);
4078 RingEval ev = evaluateRing(beads, c, potential, options.energyShift, eta,
4079 options.discretization, options.physicalBath);
4080 if (fold) {
4081 std::vector<VectorXd> projected = beads;
4082 projectMonotonePrefix(projected, options.beads / 2, dir);
4083 const long m = options.beads / 2;
4084 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
4085 projected[static_cast<size_t>(options.beads - j)] =
4086 projected[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
4087 }
4088 RingEval evFold = evaluateRing(projected, c, potential, options.energyShift,
4089 eta, options.discretization);
4090 if (largestBeadNorm(evFold.grad) <= largestBeadNorm(ev.grad)) {
4091 beads = std::move(projected);
4092 ev = std::move(evFold);
4093 }
4094 }
4095 SearchedRing out;
4096 out.beads = std::move(beads);
4097 out.energies = ev.v;
4098 out.ringPotential = ev.u;
4099 for (size_t j = 0; j < out.beads.size(); ++j) {
4100 const size_t next = (j + 1) % out.beads.size();
4101 out.bN += (out.beads[next] - out.beads[j]).squaredNorm();
4102 }
4103 out.iterations = search.getIterationCount();
4104 const double residual = largestBeadNorm(ev.grad);
4105 out.converged =
4106 search.getEigenvalue() < 0.0 && residual < options.forceTolerance;
4107 EONC_LOG_INFO("[Instanton] dimer status {} after {} iterations, largest "
4108 "residual {:.3e}, curvature {:.6f}",
4109 status, out.iterations, residual, search.getEigenvalue());
4110 return out;
4111}
4112
4113SearchedRing searchRingWithDimer(std::vector<VectorXd> full, double c,
4114 const BatchPotential &potential,
4115 const RateInstantonOptions &options,
4116 const VectorXd &dir, bool fold, double betaN,
4117 double barrierCurvature) {
4118 const std::vector<double> eta = frictionEta(options, full.size());
4119 SearchedRing out =
4120 oneDimerSearch(full, c, potential, options, dir, fold, eta);
4121 if (!fold || !options.checkOddSector || out.beads.size() != full.size()) {
4122 return out;
4123 }
4124 const RingEval here =
4125 evaluateRing(out.beads, c, potential, options.energyShift, eta,
4126 options.discretization);
4127 if (!(largestBeadNorm(here.grad) < options.forceTolerance)) {
4128 return out;
4129 }
4130 std::vector<VectorXd> oddMode;
4131 const double oddCurv =
4132 lowestOddMode(out.beads, here, c, potential, oddMode,
4133 options.lanczosFirst, options.lanczosStep, eta);
4134 if (!(oddCurv < -1.0e-3 * barrierCurvature) ||
4135 oddMode.size() != out.beads.size()) {
4136 return out;
4137 }
4138 std::vector<VectorXd> kicked = out.beads;
4139 const double kick = std::sqrt(2.0 / (betaN * -oddCurv));
4140 for (size_t k = 0; k < kicked.size(); ++k) {
4141 kicked[k] += kick * oddMode[k];
4142 }
4143 const long before = out.iterations;
4144 out = oneDimerSearch(kicked, c, potential, options, dir, false, eta);
4145 out.iterations += before;
4146 return out;
4147}

4150
4151RateInstanton optimizeRateInstanton(const VectorXd &saddle,
4152 const MatrixXd &hessSaddle, double beta,
4153 std::vector<VectorXd> guess,
4154 const BatchPotential &potential,
4155 const RateInstantonOptions &request) {
4156 if (request.physicalBath) {
4157 request.physicalBath->validate(saddle.size());
4158 if (request.friction || !request.discretization.empty() ||
4159 !request.rigidSqrtMasses.empty())
4160 throw std::invalid_argument(
4161 "physical quadratic bath requires uniform links and a retained "
4162 "coordinate basis without rigid generators");
4163 }
4164 if (!(request.physicalHessianStep > 0.0) ||
4165 !std::isfinite(request.physicalHessianStep)) {
4166 throw std::invalid_argument("optimizeRateInstanton: physicalHessianStep "
4167 "must be finite and positive "
4168 "in sqrt(amu) Angstrom");
4169 }
4170 const long N = request.beads;
4171 if (N < 4 || !(beta > 0.0) || hessSaddle.rows() != saddle.size()) {
4172 throw std::invalid_argument(
4173 "optimizeRateInstanton: need N >= 4, beta > 0 and a saddle Hessian "
4174 "of the saddle's dimension");
4175 }
4176 RateInstantonOptions options = request;
4177 // A friction bath couples every bead to every other, which the Newton
4178 // step's block-tridiagonal model cannot hold; the dimer needs gradients
4179 // only, and the rate takes the bath's curvature from the dense ring.
4180 const std::vector<double> bath = frictionEta(options, N);
4181 if (!bath.empty() && !options.discretization.empty()) {
4182 throw std::invalid_argument(
4183 "optimizeRateInstanton: the friction bath's frequencies are those of "
4184 "the uniform ring, so it takes no link weights");
4185 }
4186 RateInstanton inst;
4187 inst.physicalBath = options.physicalBath;
4188 inst.discretization = options.discretization;
4189 inst.bathEta = frictionEta(options, options.beads);
4190 inst.beta = beta;
4191 inst.betaN = beta / static_cast<double>(N);
4192 inst.temperature = 1.0 / (kBoltzmann * beta);
4193 inst.crossover = crossoverTemperature(
4194 options.physicalBath
4195 ? MatrixXd(options.physicalBath->fullHessian(saddle, hessSaddle))
4196 : hessSaddle);
4197 if (!(inst.temperature < inst.crossover)) {
4198 throw std::invalid_argument(
4199 "optimizeRateInstanton: T is at or above the crossover temperature; "
4200 "the ring collapses onto the saddle and steepest descent needs the "
4201 "parabolic barrier correction, of which classical transition-state "
4202 "theory is only the one-bead limit");
4203 }
4204 bool mirror = options.halfRing && options.discretization.empty() &&
4205 !options.friction && !options.physicalBath && N % 2 == 0;
4206 if (mirror && static_cast<long>(guess.size()) == N) {
4207 const long mid = N / 2;
4208 for (long j = 1; j < mid && mirror; ++j) {
4209 if ((guess[static_cast<size_t>(j)] - guess[static_cast<size_t>(N - j)])
4210 .norm() > 1e-8) {
4211 mirror = false;
4212 }
4213 }
4214 }
4215 const long active = mirror ? (N / 2 + 1) : N;
4216 // The nonlocal bath uses the dense Newton operator. Larger rings
4217 // use the dimer backend, whose products include the complete bath.
4218 const bool denseBath =
4219 options.physicalBath || !frictionEta(options, N).empty();
4220 if (options.newtonLimit > 0 &&
4221 active * saddle.size() <= options.newtonLimit &&
4222 (!denseBath || active * saddle.size() <= kDenseRing)) {
4223 return optimizeRateByNewton(saddle, hessSaddle, beta, std::move(guess),
4224 potential, options);
4225 }
4226 if (!options.discretization.empty()) {
4227 throw std::invalid_argument(
4228 "optimizeRateInstanton: link weights take the Newton search; "
4229 "minimum-mode following keeps the uniform ring");
4230 }
4231 const double bnh = inst.betaN * kHbar;
4232 const double c = 1.0 / (bnh * bnh);
4233
4234 const ColMajorXd saddleCurvature = physicalStaticCurvature(
4235 0.5 * (hessSaddle + hessSaddle.transpose()), saddle, options);
4236 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(saddleCurvature);
4237 const VectorXd dir = es.eigenvectors().col(0);
4238
4239 if (static_cast<long>(guess.size()) != N) {
4240 std::vector<double> v0;
4241 std::vector<VectorXd> g0;
4242 potential({saddle}, v0, g0);
4243 const double vS = v0.at(0);
4244 // Scan in steps of a quarter of the length over which the barrier's
4245 // curvature drops V by kB T_c.
4246 const double h = 0.25 * std::sqrt(2.0 * kBoltzmann * inst.crossover /
4247 -es.eigenvalues()(0));
4248 const long pts = 200;
4249 const double dPlus = sideDrop(saddle, dir, vS, 1.0, h, pts, potential);
4250 const double dMinus = sideDrop(saddle, dir, vS, -1.0, h, pts, potential);
4251 const double dMin = std::min(dPlus, dMinus);
4252 const double drop =
4253 (1.0 - inst.temperature / inst.crossover) *
4254 (std::isfinite(dMin) ? dMin : kBoltzmann * inst.crossover);
4255 const double sPlus =
4256 turningDistance(saddle, dir, vS, drop, 1.0, h, pts, potential);
4257 const double sMinus =
4258 turningDistance(saddle, dir, vS, drop, -1.0, h, pts, potential);
4259 guess.resize(static_cast<size_t>(N));
4260 for (long j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
4261 const double ct =
4262 std::cos(2.0 * std::numbers::pi * static_cast<double>(j) /
4263 static_cast<double>(N));
4264 guess[static_cast<size_t>(j)] =
4265 saddle + dir * (ct >= 0.0 ? sPlus * ct : sMinus * ct);
4266 }
4267 }
4268
4269 // An even count whose beads already match under j -> N-j is the
4270 // out-and-back instanton. The shared dimer sees one half of that ring.
4271 const bool wantMirror = options.halfRing && !options.friction &&
4272 !options.physicalBath &&
4273 options.discretization.empty() && N % 2 == 0;
4274 std::vector<VectorXd> x = std::move(guess);
4275 bool fold = false;
4276 if (wantMirror) {
4277 fold = true;
4278 const long m = N / 2;
4279 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
4280 if ((x[static_cast<size_t>(j)] - x[static_cast<size_t>(N - j)]).norm() >
4281 1e-8) {
4282 fold = false;
4283 break;
4284 }
4285 }
4286 }
4287 if (fold) {
4288 const long m = N / 2;
4289 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
4290 const size_t a = static_cast<size_t>(j);
4291 const size_t b = static_cast<size_t>(N - j);
4292 const VectorXd mid = 0.5 * (x[a] + x[b]);
4293 x[a] = mid;
4294 x[b] = mid;
4295 }
4296 projectMonotonePrefix(x, m, dir);
4297 for (long j = 1; j < m; ++j) {
4298 x[static_cast<size_t>(N - j)] = x[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
4299 }
4300 }
4301 const double barrierCurvature = std::abs(es.eigenvalues()(0));
4302 const SearchedRing found =
4303 searchRingWithDimer(std::move(x), c, potential, options, dir, fold,
4304 inst.betaN, barrierCurvature);
4305 inst.beads = found.beads;
4306 inst.energies = found.energies;
4307 inst.ringPotential = found.ringPotential;
4308 inst.bN = found.bN;
4309 inst.iterations = found.iterations;
4310 inst.converged = found.converged;
4311 return inst;
4312}

4320std::vector<bool> nearestZero(const VectorXd &lam, long count, long first = 0) {
4321 std::vector<long> order(static_cast<size_t>(lam.size() - first));
4322 std::iota(order.begin(), order.end(), first);
4323 std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](long a, long b) {
4324 return std::abs(lam(a)) < std::abs(lam(b));
4325 });
4326 std::vector<bool> out(static_cast<size_t>(lam.size()), false);
4327 for (long k = 0; k < std::min<long>(count, static_cast<long>(order.size()));
4328 ++k) {
4329 out[static_cast<size_t>(order[static_cast<size_t>(k)])] = true;
4330 }
4331 return out;
4332}

4336namespace {
4337
4338// The principal moments, about the beads' common centre of mass, of the
4339// inertia restricted to the free rotation axes, sorted, those under 1e-8
4340// of the largest left out.
4341std::vector<double> rotationMoments(const std::vector<VectorXd> &beads,
4342 const RingRigidBodies &bodies) {
4343 const long nAtoms = static_cast<long>(bodies.sqrtMasses.size());
4344 Eigen::Vector3d centre = Eigen::Vector3d::Zero();
4345 double total = 0.0;
4346 auto position = [&](const VectorXd &q, long k) {
4347 return Eigen::Vector3d(bodies.reference.segment<3>(3 * k) +
4348 q.segment<3>(3 * k) /
4349 bodies.sqrtMasses[static_cast<size_t>(k)]);
4350 };
4351 for (const auto &q : beads) {
4352 for (long k = 0; k < nAtoms; ++k) {
4353 const double m = bodies.sqrtMasses[static_cast<size_t>(k)] *
4354 bodies.sqrtMasses[static_cast<size_t>(k)];
4355 centre += m * position(q, k);
4356 total += m;
4357 }
4358 }
4359 centre /= total;
4360 Eigen::Matrix3d inertia = Eigen::Matrix3d::Zero();
4361 for (const auto &q : beads) {
4362 for (long k = 0; k < nAtoms; ++k) {
4363 const double m = bodies.sqrtMasses[static_cast<size_t>(k)] *
4364 bodies.sqrtMasses[static_cast<size_t>(k)];
4365 const Eigen::Vector3d x = position(q, k) - centre;
4366 inertia += m * (x.squaredNorm() * Eigen::Matrix3d::Identity() -
4367 x * x.transpose());
4368 }
4369 }
4370 std::vector<int> axes;
4371 for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
4372 if (bodies.rotations[static_cast<size_t>(c)]) {
4373 axes.push_back(c);
4374 }
4375 }
4376 MatrixXd sub(static_cast<long>(axes.size()), static_cast<long>(axes.size()));
4377 for (size_t a = 0; a < axes.size(); ++a) {
4378 for (size_t b = 0; b < axes.size(); ++b) {
4379 sub(static_cast<long>(a), static_cast<long>(b)) =
4380 inertia(axes[a], axes[b]);
4381 }
4382 }
4383 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> es(sub, Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
4384 const VectorXd &moments = es.eigenvalues();
4385 const double largest = moments.size() > 0 ? moments.maxCoeff() : 0.0;
4386 std::vector<double> out;
4387 for (long i = 0; i < moments.size(); ++i) {
4388 if (moments(i) > 1e-8 * largest) {
4389 out.push_back(moments(i));
4390 }
4391 }
4392 return out;
4393}

4395} // namespace
4396
4397double logRotationalRatio(const std::vector<VectorXd> &beads,
4398 const RingRigidBodies &bodies) {
4399 const long nAtoms = static_cast<long>(bodies.sqrtMasses.size());
4400 const bool anyFree =
4401 bodies.rotations[0] || bodies.rotations[1] || bodies.rotations[2];
4402 if (nAtoms == 0 || !anyFree || beads.empty()) {
4403 return 0.0;
4404 }
4405 if (bodies.reference.size() != 3 * nAtoms) {
4406 throw std::invalid_argument(
4407 "logRotationalRatio: the reference needs three coordinates per atom");
4408 }
4409 for (const auto &q : beads) {
4410 if (q.size() != 3 * nAtoms) {
4411 throw std::invalid_argument(
4412 "logRotationalRatio: a bead needs three coordinates per atom");
4413 }
4414 }
4415 const std::vector<double> ring = rotationMoments(beads, bodies);
4416 const std::vector<double> reactant = rotationMoments(
4417 std::vector<VectorXd>(beads.size(), VectorXd::Zero(3 * nAtoms)), bodies);
4418 if (ring.size() != reactant.size()) {
4419 throw std::runtime_error("logRotationalRatio: the beads turn about " +
4420 std::to_string(ring.size()) +
4421 " axes and the reactant about " +
4422 std::to_string(reactant.size()));
4423 }
4424 double out = 0.0;
4425 for (size_t i = 0; i < ring.size(); ++i) {
4426 out += 0.5 * (std::log(ring[i]) - std::log(reactant[i]));
4427 }
4428 return out;
4429}
4430
4431double closedRingPotential(const std::vector<VectorXd> &beads, double spring,
4432 const BatchPotential &potential,
4433 const std::vector<double> &discretization) {
4434 if (beads.size() < 2 || !(spring > 0.0)) {
4435 throw std::invalid_argument(
4436 "closedRingPotential: need two beads and a positive spring");
4437 }
4438 return evaluateRing(beads, spring, potential, 0.0, {}, discretization).u;
4439}

4441namespace {
4442
4443// The quadratic bath is K=T^T F^* Omega F T. Applying its gradient to
4444// coordinate basis vectors retains the same finite operator as the energy.
4445MatrixXd finiteBathKernel(long n, const std::vector<double> &eta,
4446 double &symmetryResidual) {
4447 MatrixXd kernel = MatrixXd::Zero(n, n);
4448 for (long col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
4449 std::vector<VectorXd> q(static_cast<size_t>(n), VectorXd::Zero(1));
4450 std::vector<VectorXd> g = q;
4451 q[static_cast<size_t>(col)](0) = 1.0;
4452 double energy = 0.0;
4453 addFrictionBath(q, energy, g, eta);
4454 for (long row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
4455 kernel(row, col) = g[static_cast<size_t>(row)](0);
4456 }
4457 }
4458 symmetryResidual = (kernel - kernel.transpose()).cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4459 const double tolerance = 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() * n *
4460 kernel.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4461 if (!kernel.allFinite() || symmetryResidual > tolerance) {
4462 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: asymmetric finite bath kernel");
4463 }
4464 return (0.5 * (kernel + kernel.transpose())).eval();
4465}
4466
4467void bathFluctuations(RateInstanton &inst,
4468 const std::vector<MatrixXd> &physical,
4469 const std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> &rigid,
4470 const VectorXd &reactantValues,
4471 const std::vector<bool> &rigidReactant, double vReactant,
4472 double c) {
4473 const long n = static_cast<long>(inst.beads.size());
4474 const long f = inst.beads.front().size();
4475 const long dim = n * f;
4476 const double bnh = inst.betaN * kHbar;
4477 if (!(bnh > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(bnh) || !(inst.beta > 0.0) ||
4478 !std::isfinite(inst.beta)) {
4479 throw std::invalid_argument(
4480 "instantonRate: finite positive bath inverse temperature required");
4481 }
4482 if (!reactantValues.allFinite()) {
4483 throw std::runtime_error(
4484 "instantonRate: non-finite bath reactant spectrum");
4485 }
4486 MatrixXd bead = finiteBathKernel(n, inst.bathEta, inst.bathSymmetryResidual);
4487 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
4488 const long k = (j + 1) % n;
4489 const double w = inst.discretization.empty()
4490 ? 1.0
4491 : inst.discretization[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
4492 const double link = c / w;
4493 bead(j, j) += link;
4494 bead(k, k) += link;
4495 bead(j, k) -= link;
4496 bead(k, j) -= link;
4497 }
4498 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> eb(bead);
4499 if (eb.info() != Eigen::Success || !eb.eigenvalues().allFinite()) {
4500 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: bath bead eigensolver failed");
4501 }
4502 const double beadScale = bead.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4503 const double beadTol =
4504 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() * n * beadScale;
4505 if (eb.eigenvalues()(0) < -beadTol) {
4506 throw std::runtime_error(
4507 "instantonRate: bath bead operator is not positive semidefinite");
4508 }
4509 // The reactant Hessian is constant over beads, so its eigenvalues add
4510 // to the exact eigenvalues of the scalar bead operator, including K.
4511 double reactantLogDet = 0.0;
4512 long reactantDim = 0;
4513 for (long k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
4514 const double mu = std::max(0.0, eb.eigenvalues()(k));
4515 for (long m = 0; m < f; ++m) {
4516 if (k == 0 && rigidReactant[static_cast<size_t>(m)]) {
4517 continue;
4518 }
4519 const double curvature =
4520 rigidReactant[static_cast<size_t>(m)] ? 0.0 : reactantValues(m);
4521 if ((!rigidReactant[static_cast<size_t>(m)] && !(curvature > 0.0)) ||
4522 !(curvature + mu > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(curvature + mu)) {
4523 throw std::runtime_error(
4524 "instantonRate: bath reactant curvature is not positive");
4525 }
4526 reactantLogDet += std::log(curvature + mu);
4527 ++reactantDim;
4528 }
4529 }
4530 inst.bathReactantLogAbsDet = reactantLogDet;
4531 inst.logZr = -inst.beta * vReactant - reactantDim * std::log(bnh) -
4532 0.5 * reactantLogDet;
4533
4534 ColMajorXd full = ColMajorXd::Zero(dim, dim);
4535 const MatrixXd eye = MatrixXd::Identity(f, f);
4536 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
4537 for (long k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
4538 full.block(j * f, k * f, f, f) = bead(j, k) * eye;
4539 }
4540 if (!physical[static_cast<size_t>(j)].allFinite()) {
4541 throw std::runtime_error(
4542 "instantonRate: non-finite physical bead Hessian");
4543 }
4544 full.block(j * f, j * f, f, f) += physical[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
4545 }
4546 // Only declared physical rigid generators leave this operator.
4547 ColMajorXd quotient = ColMajorXd::Identity(dim, dim);
4548 if (!rigid.empty()) {
4549 ColMajorXd generators(dim, static_cast<long>(rigid.size()));
4550 for (long j = 0; j < generators.cols(); ++j) {
4551 generators.col(j) = packBeads(rigid[static_cast<size_t>(j)]);
4552 }
4553 Eigen::ColPivHouseholderQR<ColMajorXd> qr(generators);
4554 if (qr.rank() != generators.cols()) {
4555 throw std::runtime_error(
4556 "instantonRate: dependent declared rigid generators");
4557 }
4558 const ColMajorXd q = qr.householderQ() * ColMajorXd::Identity(dim, dim);
4559 quotient = q.rightCols(dim - generators.cols());
4560 }
4561 const double fullResidual = (full - full.transpose()).cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4562 const double fullTolerance = 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() *
4563 dim * full.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4564 if (!full.allFinite() || fullResidual > fullTolerance) {
4565 throw std::runtime_error(
4566 "instantonRate: asymmetric bath fluctuation operator");
4567 }
4568 const ColMajorXd reducedRaw = quotient.transpose() * full * quotient;
4569 const double reducedResidual =
4570 (reducedRaw - reducedRaw.transpose()).cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4571 const double reducedTolerance =
4572 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() * reducedRaw.rows() *
4573 reducedRaw.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4574 if (!reducedRaw.allFinite() || reducedResidual > reducedTolerance) {
4575 throw std::runtime_error(
4576 "instantonRate: asymmetric reduced bath fluctuation operator");
4577 }
4578 inst.bathSymmetryResidual =
4579 std::max({inst.bathSymmetryResidual, fullResidual, reducedResidual});
4580 const ColMajorXd reduced =
4581 (0.5 * (reducedRaw + reducedRaw.transpose())).eval();
4582 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(reduced);
4583 if (es.info() != Eigen::Success || !es.eigenvalues().allFinite()) {
4584 throw std::runtime_error(
4585 "instantonRate: bath fluctuation eigensolver failed");
4586 }
4587 const VectorXd values = es.eigenvalues();
4588 const double span = values.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4589 const double zeroTol =
4590 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() * values.size() * span;
4591 inst.bathRoundoffScale = zeroTol;
4592 inst.bathSignedCurvatures.assign(values.data(),
4593 values.data() + values.size());
4594 inst.negativeModes = 0;
4595 long nulls = 0;
4596 for (long i = 0; i < values.size(); ++i) {
4597 inst.negativeModes += values(i) < -zeroTol ? 1 : 0;
4598 nulls += std::abs(values(i)) <= zeroTol ? 1 : 0;
4599 }
4600 inst.negativeEigenvalue = std::min(0.0, values(0));
4601 VectorXd cycle = quotient.transpose() * timeTranslation(inst.beads);
4602 const double cycleNorm = cycle.norm();
4603 long phase = -1;
4604 double bestOverlap = 0.0;
4605 if (cycleNorm > 1e-8) {
4606 cycle /= cycleNorm;
4607 for (long i = 0; i < values.size(); ++i) {
4608 const double overlap = std::abs(es.eigenvectors().col(i).dot(cycle));
4609 if (std::abs(values(i)) <= zeroTol && overlap > 0.9 &&
4610 overlap > bestOverlap) {
4611 phase = i;
4612 bestOverlap = overlap;
4613 }
4614 }
4615 }
4616 // Integer bead shifts are a discrete symmetry, not a continuous zero mode.
4617 bool circulant = true;
4618 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
4619 for (long k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
4620 circulant =
4621 circulant &&
4622 std::abs(bead(j, k) - bead((j + 1) % n, (k + 1) % n)) <= beadTol;
4623 }
4624 }
4625 inst.phaseEigenResidual = phase >= 0
4626 ? (reduced * es.eigenvectors().col(phase) -
4627 values(phase) * es.eigenvectors().col(phase))
4628 .norm()
4629 : std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
4630 inst.phaseZeroVerified = phase >= 0 && nulls == 1 && circulant &&
4631 inst.phaseEigenResidual <= zeroTol;
4632 inst.zeroEigenvalue = phase >= 0 ? values(phase) : 0.0;
4633 inst.bathLogAbsDet = 0.0;
4634 for (long i = 0; i < values.size(); ++i) {
4635 if (std::abs(values(i)) > zeroTol) {
4636 inst.bathLogAbsDet += std::log(std::abs(values(i)));
4637 }
4638 }
4639 // This absolute Gaussian integral excludes contour and rate normalization.
4640 inst.logAbsoluteGaussianWeight =
4641 nulls == 0 ? -inst.betaN * inst.ringPotential -
4642 values.size() * std::log(bnh) - 0.5 * inst.bathLogAbsDet
4643 : std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
4644 inst.rateValid =
4645 inst.converged && inst.phaseZeroVerified && inst.negativeModes == 1;
4646 inst.rateValidity =
4647 !inst.converged
4648 ? "unconverged_bath_ring"
4649 : (nulls > 1
4650 ? "additional_bath_null_modes"
4651 : (!circulant
4652 ? "bead_dependent_operator_no_continuous_phase"
4653 : (inst.negativeModes != 1
4654 ? "non_index_one_bath_ring"
4655 : (inst.phaseZeroVerified
4656 ? "numerically_null_collective_phase"
4657 : "resolved_finite_bead_phase"))));
4658 if (!inst.rateValid) {
4659 const double invalid = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
4660 inst.logRateTimesZr = inst.logRate = inst.rate = inst.effectiveBarrier =
4661 invalid;
4662 return;
4663 }
4664 const long kept = values.size() - 1;
4665 const double logProd = kept * std::log(bnh) + 0.5 * inst.bathLogAbsDet;
4666 inst.logRateTimesZr = -std::log(bnh) +
4667 0.5 * std::log(inst.bN / (2.0 * std::numbers::pi *
4668 inst.betaN * kHbar * kHbar)) -
4669 logProd - inst.betaN * inst.ringPotential;
4670 inst.logRate = inst.logRateTimesZr - inst.logZr;
4671 inst.rate = std::exp(inst.logRate) / kTimeUnitSeconds;
4672 inst.effectiveBarrier =
4673 -std::log(2.0 * std::numbers::pi * kHbar * inst.beta) / inst.beta -
4674 inst.logRate / inst.beta;
4675 if (!std::isfinite(inst.logRateTimesZr) || !std::isfinite(inst.logZr) ||
4676 !std::isfinite(inst.logRate)) {
4677 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: non-finite bath prefactor");
4678 }
4679}
4680
4681void physicalBathFluctuations(RateInstanton &inst,
4682 const std::vector<MatrixXd> &physical,
4683 const MatrixXd &reactant, double vReactant,
4684 double c) {
4685 const long n = inst.beads.size(), f = inst.beads.front().size(), dim = n * f;
4686 const auto bath = inst.physicalBath->evaluate(inst.beads, c, true);
4687 const std::vector<VectorXd> qr(n, VectorXd::Zero(f));
4688 const auto referenceBath = inst.physicalBath->evaluate(qr, c, true);
4689 ColMajorXd h = bath.hessian, hr = referenceBath.hessian;
4690 const MatrixXd eye = MatrixXd::Identity(f, f);
4691 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
4692 const long next = (j + 1) % n;
4693 h.block(j * f, j * f, f, f) += physical[j];
4694 hr.block(j * f, j * f, f, f) += reactant;
4695 for (auto *matrix : {&h, &hr}) {
4696 matrix->block(j * f, j * f, f, f) += c * eye;
4697 matrix->block(next * f, next * f, f, f) += c * eye;
4698 matrix->block(j * f, next * f, f, f) -= c * eye;
4699 matrix->block(next * f, j * f, f, f) -= c * eye;
4700 }
4701 }
4702 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(0.5 * (h + h.transpose()));
4703 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> er(0.5 *
4704 (hr + hr.transpose()));
4705 if (es.info() != Eigen::Success || er.info() != Eigen::Success ||
4706 !es.eigenvalues().allFinite() || !er.eigenvalues().allFinite() ||
4707 !(er.eigenvalues().minCoeff() > 0))
4708 throw std::runtime_error(
4709 "physical bath: invalid fluctuation or reactant spectrum");
4710 const VectorXd values = es.eigenvalues();
4711 const double zeroTol = 64 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() * dim *
4712 values.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4713 inst.bathRoundoffScale = zeroTol;
4714 inst.bathSignedCurvatures.assign(values.data(),
4715 values.data() + values.size());
4716 inst.bathSymmetryResidual = (h - h.transpose()).cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4717 inst.negativeModes = 0;
4718 long zeros = 0, phase = -1;
4719 double overlap = 0;
4720 const VectorXd tau = timeTranslation(inst.beads);
4721 if (tau.size() != dim)
4722 throw std::runtime_error("physical bath: collapsed ring");
4723 for (long k = 0; k < dim; ++k) {
4724 inst.negativeModes += values[k] < -zeroTol;
4725 zeros += std::abs(values[k]) <= zeroTol;
4726 const double candidate = std::abs(es.eigenvectors().col(k).dot(tau));
4727 if (candidate > overlap) {
4728 overlap = candidate;
4729 phase = k;
4730 }
4731 }
4732 inst.negativeEigenvalue = values[0];
4733 inst.zeroEigenvalue = values[phase];
4734 inst.phaseEigenResidual = (h * es.eigenvectors().col(phase) -
4735 values[phase] * es.eigenvectors().col(phase))
4736 .norm();
4737 inst.phaseZeroVerified = zeros == 1 && std::abs(values[phase]) <= zeroTol &&
4738 overlap > 0.9 && inst.phaseEigenResidual <= zeroTol;
4739 const long bathDimension = inst.physicalBath->curvatures.size();
4740 double phaseMetric = 1.0, fullBN = inst.bN;
4741 const VectorXd retainedPhase = es.eigenvectors().col(phase);
4742 Eigen::MatrixXd sourceVariation(n * bathDimension, 1);
4743 for (long l = 0; l < n; ++l)
4744 sourceVariation.middleRows(l * bathDimension, bathDimension) =
4745 bath.sourceJacobians[l] * retainedPhase.segment(l * f, f);
4746 const Eigen::MatrixXd lifted = -bath.solveBath(sourceVariation);
4747 phaseMetric += lifted.squaredNorm();
4748 for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
4749 fullBN +=
4750 (bath.bathPositions[(j + 1) % n] - bath.bathPositions[j]).squaredNorm();
4751 }
4752 if (!(fullBN > 0) || !std::isfinite(fullBN) || !std::isfinite(phaseMetric))
4753 throw std::runtime_error("physical bath: invalid lifted phase measure");
4754 EONC_LOG_INFO(
4755 "[Instanton] physical bath phase measure: bN_full {:.17g}, bN_retained "
4756 "{:.17g}, lift_metric {:.17g}, effective_bN {:.17g}",
4757 fullBN, inst.bN, phaseMetric, fullBN / phaseMetric);
4758 double logPrime = 0;
4759 for (long k = 0; k < dim; ++k)
4760 if (k != phase)
4761 logPrime += std::log(std::abs(values[k]));
4762 const double referenceDet = er.eigenvalues().array().log().sum();
4763 const double fullDimension = n * (f + inst.physicalBath->curvatures.size());
4764 const double logMeasure = fullDimension * std::log(inst.betaN * kHbar);
4765 inst.bathLogAbsDet =
4766 logPrime + bath.bathLogDeterminant + std::log(phaseMetric);
4767 inst.bathReactantLogAbsDet = referenceDet + referenceBath.bathLogDeterminant;
4768 inst.logZr =
4769 -inst.beta * vReactant - logMeasure - 0.5 * inst.bathReactantLogAbsDet;
4770 // For an exact phase zero, det' H_full=det D_bath det' S times
4771 // ||u_full||^2/||u_retained||^2. Use the full primitive link measure
4772 // with this lifted pseudodeterminant. At finite N the link measure
4773 // and the phase-eigenvector metric are distinct quadratures.
4774 inst.logRateTimesZr =
4775 -logMeasure +
4776 0.5 * std::log(fullBN /
4777 (2 * std::numbers::pi * inst.betaN * kHbar * kHbar)) -
4778 0.5 * inst.bathLogAbsDet - inst.betaN * inst.ringPotential;
4779 inst.rateValid =
4780 inst.converged && inst.phaseZeroVerified && inst.negativeModes == 1;
4781 inst.rateValidity =
4782 !inst.converged
4783 ? "unconverged_physical_bath_ring"
4784 : (!inst.phaseZeroVerified
4785 ? "unverified_physical_bath_phase"
4786 : (inst.negativeModes != 1 ? "non_index_one_physical_bath_ring"
4787 : "physical_quadratic_bath"));
4788 if (!inst.rateValid) {
4789 const double invalid = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
4790 inst.logRateTimesZr = inst.logRate = inst.rate = inst.effectiveBarrier =
4791 invalid;
4792 return;
4793 }
4794 inst.logRate = inst.logRateTimesZr - inst.logZr;
4795 inst.rate = std::exp(inst.logRate) / kTimeUnitSeconds;
4796 inst.effectiveBarrier =
4797 -std::log(2 * std::numbers::pi * kHbar * inst.beta) / inst.beta -
4798 inst.logRate / inst.beta;
4799 inst.classicalRate = inst.classicalLogRate =
4800 std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
4801}

4803} // namespace
4804
4805void instantonRate(RateInstanton &inst, const RingBeadHessian &hessian,
4806 const MatrixXd &hessReactant, double vReactant,
4807 const MatrixXd &hessSaddle, double vSaddle, long rigidModes,
4808 long denseLimit, const RingRigidBodies &rigidBodies) {
4809 const long N = static_cast<long>(inst.beads.size());
4810 if (N < 4 || !(inst.betaN > 0.0)) {
4811 throw std::invalid_argument("instantonRate: no optimised ring");
4812 }
4813 const long f = inst.beads.front().size();
4814 if (rigidModes < 0 || rigidModes > f) {
4815 throw std::invalid_argument(
4816 "instantonRate: rigidModes exceeds the degrees of freedom");
4817 }
4818 const double bnh = inst.betaN * kHbar;
4819 const double c = 1.0 / (bnh * bnh);
4820 const MatrixXd eye = MatrixXd::Identity(f, f);
4821 const std::vector<double> *linkWeight =
4822 inst.discretization.empty() ? nullptr : &inst.discretization;
4823
4824 std::vector<MatrixXd> hBead(static_cast<size_t>(N));
4825 for (long j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
4826 const MatrixXd h = hessian(j, inst.beads[static_cast<size_t>(j)]);
4827 if (h.rows() != f || h.cols() != f) {
4828 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: bead Hessian size");
4829 }
4830 const double hTolerance = 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() *
4831 f * h.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4832 if (!h.allFinite() ||
4833 (h - h.transpose()).cwiseAbs().maxCoeff() > hTolerance) {
4834 throw std::runtime_error(
4835 "instantonRate: asymmetric physical bead Hessian");
4836 }
4837 hBead[static_cast<size_t>(j)] = 0.5 * (h + h.transpose());
4838 }
4839 const std::vector<MatrixXd> diag = ringDiagonal(hBead, c, false, linkWeight);
4840
4841 if (inst.physicalBath) {
4842 if (rigidModes || !inst.discretization.empty() || !inst.bathEta.empty())
4843 throw std::invalid_argument(
4844 "physical bath fluctuations require retained coordinates and uniform "
4845 "links without scalar friction");
4846 physicalBathFluctuations(inst, hBead, hessReactant, vReactant, c);
4847 return;
4848 }
4849
4850 if (hessReactant.rows() != f || hessReactant.cols() != f ||
4851 !hessReactant.allFinite()) {
4852 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: invalid reactant Hessian");
4853 }
4854 const double reactantTolerance = 64.0 *
4855 std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() * f *
4856 hessReactant.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
4857 if ((hessReactant - hessReactant.transpose()).cwiseAbs().maxCoeff() >
4858 reactantTolerance) {
4859 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: asymmetric reactant Hessian");
4860 }
4861 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<MatrixXd> er(
4862 0.5 * (hessReactant + hessReactant.transpose()));
4863 if (er.info() != Eigen::Success || !er.eigenvalues().allFinite()) {
4864 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: reactant eigensolver failed");
4865 }
4866 const VectorXd &lr = er.eigenvalues();
4867 const std::vector<bool> rigidR = nearestZero(lr, rigidModes);
4868 MatrixXd nullBasis(f, 0);
4869 // The rigid vectors leave the product whether or not every bead Hessian
4870 // annihilates them exactly; a finite-difference Hessian never does, and
4871 // the reactant side drops the same modes at k = 0.
4872 for (long m = 0; m < lr.size(); ++m) {
4873 if (!rigidR[static_cast<size_t>(m)]) {
4874 continue;
4875 }
4876 nullBasis.conservativeResize(f, nullBasis.cols() + 1);
4877 nullBasis.col(nullBasis.cols() - 1) = er.eigenvectors().col(m);
4878 }
4879 if (rigidModes >= f) {
4880 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: every direction is a rigid mode");
4881 }
4882 // det' through the block chain: the cyclic zero mode and the rigid null
4883 // vectors leave the product by the determinant lemma, the inertia comes
4884 // from the Schur complements, and the N f by N f matrix is never formed.
4885 std::vector<VectorXd> cycle = beadVelocities(inst.beads, linkWeight);
4886 const double cycleNorm = dot(cycle, cycle);
4887 if (!(cycleNorm > 0.0)) {
4888 throw std::runtime_error(
4889 "instantonRate: the beads coincide, so the ring has collapsed");
4890 }
4891 scale(cycle, 1.0 / std::sqrt(cycleNorm));
4892 // The rigid null vectors, orthonormal.
4893 std::vector<std::vector<VectorXd>> rigid;
4894 if (!rigidBodies.sqrtMasses.empty()) {
4895 // The ring's own rigid motions; the lemma needs an orthonormal basis of
4896 // the null space, not the generators themselves.
4897 rigid = ringRigidBasis(inst.beads, rigidBodies.sqrtMasses,
4898 rigidBodies.reference, rigidBodies.rotations);
4899 if (static_cast<long>(rigid.size()) != nullBasis.cols()) {
4900 throw std::runtime_error("instantonRate: the ring has " +
4901 std::to_string(rigid.size()) +
4902 " rigid motions and the reactant " +

4954 // eigenvalue, and lifting tau would leave out cos^2 of their angle

4957 // when the iteration fails or wanders off it.

4961 linkWeight);

4986 // eigenvector of lambda.

5003 phaseResidualSquared +=
5004 (phaseProduct[j] - inst.zeroEigenvalue * cycle[j]).squaredNorm();
5005 const double offDiagonal =
5006 linkWeight ? c / (*linkWeight)[j] + c / (*linkWeight)[(j + N - 1) % N]
5007 : 2.0 * c;
5008 phaseOperatorBound =
5009 std::max(phaseOperatorBound,
5010 diag[j].cwiseAbs().rowwise().sum().maxCoeff() + offDiagonal);
5011 }
5012 inst.phaseEigenResidual = std::sqrt(phaseResidualSquared);
5013 const double phaseRoundoff = 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() *
5014 N * f * phaseOperatorBound;

5016 inst.phaseEigenResidual <= phaseRoundoff;

5022 // the inertia and the lowest mode directly, and check the block chain.
5023 ColMajorXd full = ColMajorXd::Zero(dim, dim);
5024 for (long j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
5025 full.block(j * f, j * f, f, f) = diag[static_cast<size_t>(j)];
5026 const long k = (j + 1) % N;
5027 full.block(j * f, k * f, f, f) -= c * eye;
5028 full.block(k * f, j * f, f, f) -= c * eye;
5029 }
5030 for (size_t d = 0; d < dropped.size(); ++d) {
5031 VectorXd u(dim);
5032 for (long j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
5033 u.segment(j * f, f) = dropped[d][static_cast<size_t>(j)];
5034 }
5035 full += kappas[d] * u * u.transpose();

5037 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(full,
5038 Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);

5040 const double inertiaTol = 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() *
5041 dim * lam.cwiseAbs().maxCoeff();
5042 double dense = 0.0, scaleSum = 0.0;
5043 long negative = 0;
5044 for (long i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {
5045 const double l = std::abs(lam(i));
5046 dense += std::log(l);
5047 scaleSum += std::abs(std::log(l));
5048 negative += lam(i) < -inertiaTol ? 1 : 0;
5049 }
5050 if (!(std::abs(dense - logAbsDet) <= 1e-6 * std::max(1.0, scaleSum))) {

5052 "instantonRate: the block-chain determinant disagrees with the "
5053 "dense ring Hessian");

5057 inst.negativeModes = negative;

5060 auto applyFull = [&](const std::vector<VectorXd> &vec) {
5061 return applyDiagonal(diag, c, true, vec, linkWeight);
5062 };

5064 std::vector<VectorXd> start = cycle;
5065 std::uint64_t h = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;
5066 for (auto &bead : start) {
5067 for (long a2 = 0; a2 < bead.size(); ++a2) {
5068 h ^= h << 13;
5069 h ^= h >> 7;
5070 h ^= h << 17;
5071 bead(a2) += 0.1 * (static_cast<double>(h >> 11) * 0x1.0p-53 - 0.5);
5072 }

5075 lowestRingModes(applyFull, std::move(start), steps);

5084 // account for numerical zeros outside the declared lifted directions.
5085 double operatorBound = 2.0 * c;
5086 for (const auto &block : diag) {
5087 operatorBound = std::max(
5088 operatorBound, block.cwiseAbs().rowwise().sum().maxCoeff() + 2.0 * c);
5089 }
5090 const double inertiaTol =
5091 64.0 * std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon() * dim * operatorBound;
5092 long numericalZeros = 0;
5093 for (const auto &mode : modes) {
5094 bool lifted = false;
5095 for (const auto &direction : dropped) {
5096 lifted = lifted || std::abs(dot(mode.vector, direction)) > 0.5;
5097 }
5098 if (!lifted && mode.theta < 0.0 && std::abs(mode.theta) <= inertiaTol &&
5099 mode.residual <= inertiaTol) {
5100 ++numericalZeros;
5101 }
5102 }
5103 inst.negativeModes = std::max(0L, inst.negativeModes - numericalZeros);
5104 }
5105 // Along an eigenvector the lift adds c to its eigenvalue, so it comes off
5106 // as c + lambda_0 for the cycle (lambda_0 is not zero on a discrete ring)
5107 // and as c for the exact rigid zeros.
5108 const double logDetPrime = logAbsDet -
5109 std::log(std::abs(c + inst.zeroEigenvalue)) -
5110 static_cast<double>(nDrop - 1) * std::log(c);
5111 const double logProd =
5112 static_cast<double>(N * f - nDrop) * std::log(bnh) + 0.5 * logDetPrime;

5114 inst.logRateTimesZr = -std::log(bnh) +
5115 0.5 * std::log(inst.bN / (2.0 * std::numbers::pi *
5116 inst.betaN * kHbar * kHbar)) -
5117 logProd - inst.betaN * inst.ringPotential;

5119 inst.logRateTimesZr += inst.logRotationRatio;

5121 for (long m = 0; m < lr.size(); ++m) {
5122 if (!rigidR[static_cast<size_t>(m)] && !(lr(m) > 0.0)) {
5123 throw std::runtime_error(
5124 "instantonRate: the reactant Hessian is not positive definite");
5125 }
5126 }
5127 // The rigid modes leave the centroid (k = 0) factor, as the ring's own
5128 // rigid modes leave its product; both carry them as free particles for
5129 // k > 0.
5130 double logZr = -inst.beta * vReactant;
5131 for (long k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
5132 const double sk = std::sin(std::numbers::pi * static_cast<double>(k) /
5133 static_cast<double>(N));
5134 for (long m = 0; m < lr.size(); ++m) {
5135 if (k == 0 && rigidR[static_cast<size_t>(m)]) {
5136 continue;
5137 }
5138 const double l = rigidR[static_cast<size_t>(m)] ? 0.0 : lr(m);
5139 logZr -= std::log(bnh) + 0.5 * std::log(l + 4.0 * c * sk * sk);
5140 }
5141 }
5142 inst.logZr = logZr;
5143 inst.rateValid = inst.converged && inst.negativeModes == 1;
5144 inst.rateValidity = !inst.converged
5145 ? "unconverged_ring"
5146 : (inst.negativeModes == 1 ? "collective_coordinate"
5147 : "non_index_one_ring");

5149 inst.rate = std::exp(inst.logRate) / kTimeUnitSeconds;
5150 inst.effectiveBarrier =
5151 -std::log(2.0 * std::numbers::pi * kHbar * inst.beta) / inst.beta -
5152 inst.logRate / inst.beta;

5154 // diagnostic; rateValid prevents its use as a stationary physical rate.
5155 if (inst.negativeModes != 1) {
5156 const double invalid = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
5157 inst.logRateTimesZr = inst.logRate = inst.rate = inst.effectiveBarrier =
5158 invalid;
5159 }
5160
5161 if (hessSaddle.size() > 0) {
5162 inst.classicalLogRate = harmonicTstLogRate(
5163 hessReactant, hessSaddle, inst.beta, vSaddle - vReactant, rigidModes);
5164 if (rigidBodies.saddle.size() > 0) {
5165 inst.classicalLogRate +=
5166 logRotationalRatio({rigidBodies.saddle}, rigidBodies);
5167 }
5168 inst.classicalRate = std::exp(inst.classicalLogRate) / kTimeUnitSeconds;
5169 }
5170}
5171
5172RotationZeroModes rotationZeroModes(const MatrixXd &hess,
5173 const MatrixXd &generators,
5174 double fraction) {
5175 RotationZeroModes out;
5176 const long n = hess.rows();
5177 if (hess.cols() != n || generators.rows() != n || generators.cols() != 6) {
5178 throw std::invalid_argument(
5179 "rotationZeroModes: need a square Hessian and six generators");
5180 }
5181 const ColMajorXd h = 0.5 * (hess + hess.transpose());
5182 const ColMajorXd g = generators;
5183 const Eigen::ColPivHouseholderQR<ColMajorXd> qr(g);
5184 const long rank = qr.rank();
5185 if (rank >= n) {
5186 return out;
5187 }
5188 const ColMajorXd q = qr.householderQ() * ColMajorXd::Identity(n, n);
5189 const ColMajorXd z = q.rightCols(n - rank);
5190 const ColMajorXd reduced = z.transpose() * h * z;
5191 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(
5192 0.5 * (reduced + reduced.transpose()), Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
5193 out.softestVibration = es.eigenvalues()(0);
5194 for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
5195 const VectorXd r = generators.col(3 + c);
5196 const double rr = r.squaredNorm();
5197 if (!(rr > 0.0)) {
5198 continue;
5199 }
5200 const double rq = r.dot(h * r) / rr;
5201 if (out.softestVibration > 0.0) {
5202 out.residual[static_cast<size_t>(c)] = rq / out.softestVibration;
5203 out.zero[static_cast<size_t>(c)] =
5204 std::abs(rq) <= fraction * out.softestVibration;
5205 } else {
5206 out.residual[static_cast<size_t>(c)] =
5207 std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
5208 }
5209 }
5210 return out;
5211}

5217
5218RingChannel ringChannel(const std::vector<VectorXd> &beads,
5219 const VectorXd &saddle, const VectorXd &mode) {
5220 RingChannel out;
5221 const double mn = mode.norm();
5222 if (beads.size() < 2 || !(mn > 0.0)) {
5223 return out;
5224 }
5225 const VectorXd n = mode / mn;
5226 const size_t nb = beads.size();
5227 std::vector<double> s(nb);
5228 size_t jLo = 0, jHi = 0;
5229 for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {
5230 s[j] = (beads[j] - saddle).dot(n);
5231 if (s[j] < s[jLo]) {
5232 jLo = j;
5233 }
5234 if (s[j] > s[jHi]) {
5235 jHi = j;
5236 }
5237 }
5238 out.sMin = s[jLo];
5239 out.sMax = s[jHi];
5240 const VectorXd chord = beads[jHi] - beads[jLo];
5241 const double cn = chord.norm();
5242 out.chordOverlap = cn > 0.0 ? std::abs(chord.dot(n)) / cn : 0.0;
5243 bool crossed = false;
5244 for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {
5245 const size_t k = (j + 1) % nb;
5246 if ((s[j] < 0.0) == (s[k] < 0.0)) {
5247 continue;
5248 }
5249 const double t = s[j] / (s[j] - s[k]);
5250 const VectorXd p = beads[j] + t * (beads[k] - beads[j]) - saddle;
5251 const VectorXd across = p - p.dot(n) * n;
5252 out.crossingOffset = std::max(out.crossingOffset, across.norm());
5253 crossed = true;
5254 }
5255 out.belongs = crossed && out.sMin < 0.0 && out.sMax > 0.0 &&
5256 out.chordOverlap >= 0.5 &&
5257 out.crossingOffset <= out.sMax - out.sMin;
5258 return out;
5259}
5260
5261double parabolicFactor(double temperature, double crossover) {
5262 if (!(temperature > 0.0) || !(crossover > 0.0)) {
5263 throw std::invalid_argument(
5264 "parabolicFactor: temperature and crossover must be positive");
5265 }
5266 if (!(temperature > crossover)) {
5267 throw std::invalid_argument(
5268 "parabolicFactor: T is at or below the crossover; the factor "
5269 "diverges there");
5270 }
5271 // beta hbar omega_b / 2 = pi T_c / T, since T_c = hbar omega_b / (2 pi kB).
5272 const double phase = std::numbers::pi * crossover / temperature;
5273 const double s = std::sin(phase);
5274 if (!(s > 0.0)) {
5275 throw std::invalid_argument(
5276 "parabolicFactor: the sine of the barrier phase is not positive");
5277 }
5278 return phase / s;
5279}

5283struct HarmonicSpectrum {
5284 VectorXd reactant;
5285 VectorXd saddle;
5286 std::vector<bool> rigidReactant;
5287 std::vector<bool> rigidSaddle;
5288};
5289
5290HarmonicSpectrum harmonicSpectrum(const MatrixXd &hessReactant,
5291 const MatrixXd &hessSaddle, double beta,
5292 double barrier, long rigidModes) {
5293 if (!(beta > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(beta) || !std::isfinite(barrier) ||
5294 hessReactant.size() == 0 || hessSaddle.size() == 0 ||
5295 hessReactant.rows() != hessReactant.cols() ||
5296 hessSaddle.rows() != hessSaddle.cols() ||
5297 hessReactant.rows() != hessSaddle.rows() || rigidModes < 0 ||
5298 rigidModes >= hessReactant.rows() || !hessReactant.allFinite() ||
5299 !hessSaddle.allFinite()) {
5300 throw std::invalid_argument(
5301 "harmonic TST: need finite beta > 0 and barrier, matching finite "
5302 "square Hessians, and fewer rigid modes than degrees of freedom");
5303 }
5304 if (beta > 1.0 &&
5305 std::abs(barrier) > std::numeric_limits<double>::max() / beta) {
5306 throw std::overflow_error("harmonic TST: beta times barrier overflows");
5307 }
5308 const ColMajorXd hr = 0.5 * hessReactant + 0.5 * hessReactant.transpose();
5309 const ColMajorXd hs = 0.5 * hessSaddle + 0.5 * hessSaddle.transpose();
5310 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> er(hr,
5311 Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
5312 const Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<ColMajorXd> es(hs,
5313 Eigen::EigenvaluesOnly);
5314 if (er.info() != Eigen::Success || es.info() != Eigen::Success ||
5315 !er.eigenvalues().allFinite() || !es.eigenvalues().allFinite()) {
5316 throw std::runtime_error("harmonic TST: Hessian eigensolver failed");
5317 }
5318 HarmonicSpectrum out{er.eigenvalues(), es.eigenvalues(), {}, {}};
5319 if (!(out.saddle(0) < 0.0)) {
5320 throw std::invalid_argument(
5321 "harmonic TST: the saddle Hessian has no negative eigenvalue");
5322 }
5323 out.rigidReactant = nearestZero(out.reactant, rigidModes);
5324 out.rigidSaddle = nearestZero(out.saddle, rigidModes, 1);
5325 for (long m = 0; m < out.reactant.size(); ++m) {
5326 if (!out.rigidReactant[static_cast<size_t>(m)] &&
5327 !(out.reactant(m) > 0.0)) {
5328 throw std::invalid_argument(
5329 "harmonic TST: the reactant Hessian has a non-positive "
5330 "vibrational eigenvalue");
5331 }
5332 }
5333 for (long m = 1; m < out.saddle.size(); ++m) {
5334 if (!out.rigidSaddle[static_cast<size_t>(m)] && !(out.saddle(m) > 0.0)) {
5335 throw std::invalid_argument(
5336 "harmonic TST: the saddle Hessian has a non-positive "
5337 "vibrational eigenvalue besides its unstable mode");
5338 }
5339 }
5340 return out;
5341}
5342
5343double finiteHarmonicLogRate(double rate) {
5344 if (!std::isfinite(rate)) {
5345 throw std::overflow_error("harmonic TST: non-finite logarithmic rate");
5346 }
5347 return rate;
5348}

5350} // namespace
5351
5352double harmonicTstLogRate(const MatrixXd &hessReactant,
5353 const MatrixXd &hessSaddle, double beta,
5354 double barrier, long rigidModes) {
5355 const HarmonicSpectrum spectrum =
5356 harmonicSpectrum(hessReactant, hessSaddle, beta, barrier, rigidModes);
5357 const VectorXd &lr = spectrum.reactant;
5358 const VectorXd &ls = spectrum.saddle;
5359 double logRatio = 0.0;
5360 for (long m = 0; m < lr.size(); ++m) {
5361 if (!spectrum.rigidReactant[static_cast<size_t>(m)]) {
5362 logRatio += 0.5 * std::log(lr(m));
5363 }
5364 }
5365 // Eigenvalue 0 is the unstable mode, the most negative.
5366 for (long m = 1; m < ls.size(); ++m) {
5367 if (!spectrum.rigidSaddle[static_cast<size_t>(m)]) {
5368 logRatio -= 0.5 * std::log(ls(m));
5369 }
5370 }
5371 return finiteHarmonicLogRate(logRatio - std::log(2.0 * std::numbers::pi) -
5372 beta * barrier);
5373}
5374
5375double quantumHarmonicTstLogRate(const MatrixXd &hessReactant,
5376 const MatrixXd &hessSaddle, double beta,
5377 double barrier, long rigidModes) {
5378 const HarmonicSpectrum spectrum =
5379 harmonicSpectrum(hessReactant, hessSaddle, beta, barrier, rigidModes);
5380 const VectorXd &lr = spectrum.reactant;
5381 const VectorXd &ls = spectrum.saddle;
5382 const double bh = beta * kHbar;
5383 if (!(bh > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(bh)) {
5384 throw std::overflow_error(
5385 "harmonic TST: beta hbar is not finite and positive");
5386 }
5387 // ln(2 sinh(x / 2)) without overflow for large x, and without the
5388 // cancellation of 1 - exp(-x) for small x.
5389 auto logTwoSinhHalf = [bh](double omega) {
5390 if (omega > 1.0 && bh > std::numeric_limits<double>::max() / omega) {
5391 throw std::overflow_error("harmonic TST: beta hbar omega overflows");
5392 }
5393 const double x = bh * omega;
5394 if (!(x > 0.0)) {
5395 throw std::underflow_error("harmonic TST: beta hbar omega underflows");
5396 }
5397 return 0.5 * x + std::log(-std::expm1(-x));
5398 };
5399 double logRatio = 0.0;
5400 for (long m = 0; m < lr.size(); ++m) {
5401 if (!spectrum.rigidReactant[static_cast<size_t>(m)]) {
5402 logRatio += logTwoSinhHalf(std::sqrt(lr(m)));
5403 }
5404 }
5405 for (long m = 1; m < ls.size(); ++m) {
5406 if (!spectrum.rigidSaddle[static_cast<size_t>(m)]) {
5407 logRatio -= logTwoSinhHalf(std::sqrt(ls(m)));
5408 }
5409 }
5410 return finiteHarmonicLogRate(logRatio - std::log(2.0 * std::numbers::pi) -
5411 std::log(bh) - beta * barrier);
5412}
